zh: 6)  将离心管保持在磁力架上，室温风干 5-8 min，直至磁珠表面无反光、无开裂；
en: 6) Keep the centrifuge tube on the magnetic stand and air-dry at room temperature for 5-8 min, until the surface of the magnetic beads shows no reflection or cracking;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 7) 先加 22 μL Nuclease-Free Water 回溶，震荡混匀后室温静置 5 min，瞬时离心，磁力架静置 3-5 min，直至液体变澄清；
en: 7) Add 22 μL of Nuclease-Free Water to resuspend, vortex to mix, incubate at room temperature for 5 min, centrifuge briefly, and place on a magnetic rack for 3-5 min until the liquid becomes clear;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 8) 将上清（~21 μL cDNA）转移到新的 0.2 mL PCR 管中；
en: 8) Transfer the supernatant (~21 μL of cDNA) to a new 0.2 mL PCR tube;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 9) 再将 22 μL Nuclease-Free Water 加入步骤 7） 磁珠中二次回溶，震荡混匀后室温静置 5 min，瞬时离心，磁力架静置 3-5 min，直至液体变澄清；
en: 9) Add another 22 μL of Nuclease-Free Water to the magnetic beads from step 7) to resuspend again, vortex to mix, incubate at room temperature for 5 min, centrifuge briefly, and place on a magnetic rack for 3-5 min until the liquid becomes clear;
source_manual: Stereo-CITE_蛋白转录组试剂套装使用说明书-A

zh: 10) 将上清（~21 μL cDNA）转移至步骤 8） 所示的 PCR 管中，合并总体积~42 μL。
en: 10) Transfer the supernatant (~21 μL of cDNA) to the PCR tube indicated in step 8), combining for a total volume of ~42 μL.

zh: 移液器吸头应在远离磁力架的管壁上操作，请勿吸打、搅动磁珠；如果管盖上有泡沫，建议用 80% 乙醇清洗并将液体加回离心管。

zh: 使用空气罐尽可能地吹去垫圈、上盖、底座、芯片载体表面的杂质或碎屑，确保物料表面无肉眼可见灰尘、颗粒等污染物，避免后续组装时影响密封性或损坏芯片。（图1 以清洁芯片载体为例）
en: Use an air duster to blow away any impurities or debris from the surfaces of the gasket, top cover, base, and chip slide as thoroughly as possible. Ensure that the surfaces of these components are free of any visible dust, particles, or other contaminants to avoid compromising the seal or damaging the chip during subsequent assembly. (Figure 1 shows the cleaning of the chip slide as an example.)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 将垫圈的定位孔与上盖的定位柱对齐，缓慢套合（图2），组成载具上半部分（图 3）。组装过程中需全程观察垫圈状态，确保无扭曲、褶皱或变形，若发现异常需立即调整垫圈，防止后续使用过程中密封不良。
en: Align the positioning holes of the gasket with the positioning posts of the upper cover, and slowly fit them together (Figure 2) to assemble the upper half of the carrier (Figure 3). Observe the state of the gasket throughout the assembly process to ensure there is no twisting, creasing, or deformation. If any abnormality is found, adjust the gasket immediately to prevent poor sealing during subsequent use.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 手持芯片载体侧面（避免触碰芯片表面），芯片表面朝上（图4）。
en: Hold the sides of the chip slide (avoid touching the chip surface), with the chip surface facing up (Figure 4).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 将芯片载体倾斜放置于底座上（图5），随后将大拇指轻放于芯片载体 1、4 位底端侧面（图6）；缓慢推动芯片载体从底座数字端向非数字端移动（图7），直至芯片载体抵住载具底座的两个活动拨片。
en: Place the chip slide at an angle on the base (Figure 5), then gently place your thumbs on the sides of the bottom of the chip slide at positions 1 and 4 (Figure 6); slowly push the chip slide from the numerical end to the non-numerical end of the base (Figure 7) until the chip slide is held against the two movable catches of the carrier base.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 轻轻向下按压芯片载体（图8），使其完全卡入底座卡槽内组成完整的载具下半部分（图9 以Chip N dual 为例 ），注意此过程中勿触碰芯片表面。
en: Gently press down on the chip slide (Figure 8) until it snaps completely into the base slot to form the complete lower part of the carrier (Figure 9, taking Chip N dual as an example). Note: Do not touch the chip surface during this process.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 关键注意事项：卡入后需目视确认芯片载体与底座保持水平平行（图10），若存在倾斜（图11），需取出芯片载体重复载具下半部分组装过程，直至芯片载体安装正确，否则可能误操作导致玻片碎裂。
en: Critical Note: After snapping it into place, visually confirm that the chip slide is horizontally parallel to the base (Figure 10). If it is tilted (Figure 11), remove the chip slide and repeat the lower carrier assembly process until it is installed correctly; otherwise, incorrect operation may lead to slide breakage.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 图11 芯片载体与底座不平行图10 芯片载体与底座平行
en: Figure 11: Chip carrier not parallel to base; Figure 10: Chip carrier parallel to base.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: Stereo-seq V3 载具使用说明书
en: Stereo-seq V3 Carrier User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 请勿在芯片载体上贴附任何包边标签或贴纸，以免因贴合不紧密，导致漏液，或因受力不均，导致芯片载体碎裂。
en: Do not attach any edge labels or stickers to the chip slide to avoid leakage due to poor adhesion, or breakage of the chip slide due to uneven force distribution.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 防护要求：全程避免接触芯片表面，以防损伤探针。
en: Protection requirements: Avoid contact with the chip surface throughout the process to prevent damage to the probes.

zh: Stereo-seq V3 载具使用说明书
en: Stereo-seq V3 Carrier Instruction Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 1）将初步组装好的载具上半部分（图3）与下半部分（图9）数字端的Tab1-3 分别对准（对准规则为：Tab1 对应Tab1-1），图13 。
en: 1) Align the preliminarily assembled upper part of the carrier (Figure 3) with the numeric side of the lower part (Figure 9), aligning Tab1-3 respectively (alignment rule: Tab1 corresponds to Tab1-1), Figure 13.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 2）对准后相互嵌套扣合，确保两者数字端完全匹配，扣合时需再次检查芯片载体与底座的相对位置，确保无偏移、倾斜；该版本载具具有防呆设计，如果误将数字端与非数字端匹配无法安装。扣合过程避免垫圈压到芯片（图14）。
en: 2) Once aligned, nest and snap them together, ensuring that the numeric sides of both parts fully match. During the snapping process, re-check the relative position of the chip slide and the base to ensure there is no offset or tilting. This version of the carrier features a fool-proof design; it cannot be installed if the numeric side is incorrectly matched with the non-numeric side. During the snapping process, avoid the gasket pressing onto the chip (Figure 14).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: Stereo-seq V3 载具使用说明书
en: Stereo-seq V3 Carrier Instruction Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 3）当载具上半部分与载具下半部分扣合过程中呈图15 的状态时，垫圈与玻片基本完全贴合。
en: 3) During the process of engaging the upper part of the carrier with the lower part, when it is in the state shown in Figure 15, the gasket and the slide are almost fully in contact.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 4）当继续扣合载具上半部分与下半部受到阻力时，双手大拇指按压载具非数字端（图16），直至听到“咔哒”一声，表明扣合到位。扣合后需检查三个卡扣处是否均完全扣合，防止使用时出现漏液、密封性不良或载具中途弹开等问题。装好后整体四个反应槽朝上（图17）。
en: 4) When you continue to engage the upper and lower parts of the carrier and encounter resistance, use both thumbs to press the non-numbered end of the carrier (Figure 16) until you hear a "click," which indicates that it is fully engaged. After engagement, check that all three snaps are fully engaged to prevent issues such as leakage, poor sealing, or the carrier popping open during use. Once assembled, the unit should be positioned with the four reaction wells facing upward (Figure 17).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 如果扣合困难，先检查底座与芯片载体是否安装止确，安装不正确需调整后扣合( 否则玻片碎裂)；安装正确仍无法扣合，借助辅助工具或置于桌上扣合。
en: If it is difficult to snap together, first check whether the base and the chip slide are installed correctly. If installed incorrectly, adjust them before snapping together (otherwise the slide will break); if they are installed correctly but still cannot be snapped together, use assistive tools or place them on a table to snap them together.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 如V3 载具将用于Go Spatial 设备，则完成载具整体组装后即可上机，无需进行第三章的操作。
en: If the V3 carrier is to be used for the Go Spatial device, it can be loaded onto the instrument after the overall assembly of the carrier is completed, and the operations in Chapter 3 are not required.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: Stereo-seq V3 载具使用说明书
en: Stereo-seq V3 Carrier Instruction Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 按需向应反应槽内添加对应试剂。添加试剂过程需确保不干扰其他反应槽；试剂铺满芯片；试剂无溅出（更详细的操作参考对应试剂盒内说明书）。
en: Add the corresponding reagents into the reaction wells as needed. During the reagent addition process, ensure no interference with other reaction wells; the reagent should cover the chip surface; and there should be no splashing of reagents (refer to the manual provided with the corresponding kit for more detailed operating procedures).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 加液过程：向反应槽内加液时为避免液体聚集在芯片单侧，采取分别向芯片上、下两侧加入二分之一总体积量的试剂，加液时移液器与芯片距离较近，注意不要划伤组织，避免高速加液冲击芯片表面，确保试剂覆盖全芯片（图18）。
en: Liquid addition process: To avoid liquid accumulation on one side of the chip when adding reagents to the reaction chamber, dispense one-half of the total reagent volume onto the upper and lower sides of the chip, respectively. Keep the pipette close to the chip during dispensing, taking care not to scratch the tissue. Avoid high-speed dispensing that impacts the chip surface, and ensure the reagent covers the entire chip (Fig. 18).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 贴合操作：将压敏膜的白色背纸剥离后迅速对准载具上盖（图19 左），一次性贴合到位，确保压敏膜完全覆盖载具，且与载具四周紧密贴合。注意压敏膜居中贴合，尽量使其边缘超出载具上盖凸台（避免使用过程中反应槽试剂过量挥发）。贴合后压敏膜与载具上盖存在较多气泡，可见明显反光（图19 右）。
en: Bonding operation: After peeling off the white backing paper from the pressure-sensitive film, quickly align it with the carrier cover (Fig. 19, left) and bond it in place in one motion. Ensure the pressure-sensitive film completely covers the carrier and fits tightly around its perimeter. Note that the film should be centered, and try to have its edges extend beyond the raised rim of the carrier cover (to prevent excessive evaporation of reagents from the reaction chamber during use). After bonding, numerous bubbles may exist between the pressure-sensitive film and the carrier cover, appearing as distinct reflections (Fig. 19, right).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 2. 压敏膜贴合
en: 2. Pressure-sensitive film lamination
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 图19 左图19 右
en: Figure 19 Left, Figure 19 Right
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: Stereo-seq V3 载具使用说明书
en: Stereo-seq V3 Carrier User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 将压敏膜与载具间的气泡尽可能完全排出，确保反应槽腔体内处于相对隔绝状态，防止不同芯片相互干扰。气泡基本去除后反光点消失（图 21）。
en: Remove bubbles between the pressure-sensitive film and the carrier as completely as possible to ensure that the reaction chamber is in a relatively isolated state, preventing interference between different chips. Once bubbles are mostly removed, the reflective spots should disappear (Figure 21).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 孵育过程中需保持载具放置平稳，禁止碰撞、晃动载具。
en: During the incubation process, the carrier must be placed stably; do not bump or shake the carrier.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 孵育结束后小心取出载具，用手指捏住压敏膜的一角，缓慢、平稳地向一侧撕扯，过程中另一只手固定载具保持载具稳定（图22）。确保反应试剂不溅出，避免污染或试剂损失。
en: After incubation, carefully remove the chip slide. Pinch a corner of the pressure-sensitive film with your fingers and slowly and steadily peel it off to one side, while using the other hand to secure the chip slide and keep it stable (Figure 22). Ensure that the reaction reagent does not splash to avoid contamination or reagent loss.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 4. 压敏膜移除
en: 4. Pressure-Sensitive Film Removal
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 气泡去除：使用干净的平面状物体（如硅胶刮板、塑料卡片；禁止使用尖锐物体，防止压敏膜破损，导致密封失效），从载具中心向四周缓慢刮动（图20）。
en: Bubble removal: Use a clean, flat object (e.g., silicone squeegee, plastic card; do not use sharp objects to prevent damage to the pressure-sensitive film, which could lead to seal failure) and slowly scrape from the center of the carrier towards the edges (Figure 20).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: Stereo-seq V3 载具使用说明书
en: Stereo-seq V3 Carrier User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 使用移液枪将载具反应槽内试剂的试剂尽可能吸出，避免枪头触碰芯片。
en: Use a pipette to aspirate as much reagent as possible from the carrier's reaction well, avoiding contact between the pipette tip and the chip.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 如需拆卸载具，可在试剂移除后进行，防止拆卸过程试剂飞溅。
en: If it is necessary to disassemble the carrier, do so after reagent removal to prevent reagent splashing during the disassembly process.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 如需按照流程进行后续孵育，载具更换试剂按照“三. 载具使用”过程中1-5 的步骤操作，直至最终反应结束。
en: If subsequent incubation is required according to the protocol, follow steps 1-5 in "III. Carrier Usage" to exchange reagents for the carrier until the final reaction is complete.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 残胶处理：载具经过高/ 低温孵育，压敏膜可能残留胶迹在载具表面，导致后续使用过程密封性能降低，此时可用尖头镊子去除残胶，清洁过程中需避开反应槽，防止向槽内引入污染。
en: Residual Adhesive Removal: After the cassette has undergone high/low-temperature incubation, residue from the pressure-sensitive film may remain on the cassette surface, resulting in reduced sealing performance during subsequent use. In this case, use pointed tweezers to remove the residual adhesive. During the cleaning process, avoid the reaction wells to prevent introducing contamination into them.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: Stereo-seq V3 载具使用说明书
en: Stereo-seq V3 Chip Slide User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 将载具整体倒扣于手掌心，确保载具稳定，芯片载体朝下（避免直接接触手掌），如图24 所示。
en: Invert the entire carrier onto your palm, ensuring it is stable and the chip slide is facing down (to avoid direct contact with the palm), as shown in Figure 24.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 推荐采购Stereo-seq V3 载具拆卸工具【货号：303TA30011】（图26），使用拆卸辅助工具操作。
en: It is recommended to purchase the Stereo-seq V3 Cassette Disassembly Tool [Cat. No.: 303TA30011] (Figure 26) and use the disassembly aid tool for operation.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 用其余四指分别扣住载具非数字端Tab4-6 处的上盖与底座间隙，手指缓慢弯曲，将上盖部分向外抠，见图25 所示。过程中会听到卡扣脱离的 “哒哒” 声，持续操作直至三个卡扣均完全脱离。
en: Use the remaining four fingers to hook the gap between the Stereo-seq V3 Cassette Lid and the Stereo-seq V3 Cassette Base at Tabs 4-6 on the non-numeric end of the cassette. Slowly curl your fingers and pry the lid section outwards, as shown in Figure 25. During the process, you will hear a "click-click" sound as the snaps disengage. Continue until all three snaps are completely disengaged.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 1. 载具上盖与底座拆卸
en: 1. Disassembly of the Stereo-seq V3 Cassette
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 1.1 拆卸方式一：徒手操作
en: 1.1 Disassembly Method 1: Manual Operation
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 1.2 拆卸方式二：借助拆卸工具（可选）
en: 1.2 Disassembly Method 2: Using Disassembly Tools (Optional)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: Stereo-seq V3 载具使用说明书
en: Stereo-seq V3 Carrier User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 使用方式如下：载具倒扣于桌面，将拆卸工具垂直嵌入底座非数字端扣合处（Tab4-6），注意需要将拆卸工具的齿分别与Tab4-6 对准，如图27 所示。
en: Usage instructions are as follows: Place the carrier upside down on the table and insert the disassembly tool vertically into the engagement points on the non-numbered side of the base (Tab4-6). Note that the teeth of the disassembly tool must be aligned with Tab4-6 respectively, as shown in Figure 27.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 手握住拆卸工具上方，手掌用力向下按压拆卸工具，拆卸工具完全压入后即可取出拆卸工具（图28）。上盖与底座已分离。
en: Hold the top of the disassembly tool, use your palm to press it down firmly, and then remove the disassembly tool once it is fully inserted (Figure 28). The top cover and the base are now separated.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: Stereo-seq V3 载具使用说明书
en: Stereo-seq V3 Chip Slide User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 分离保护：Tab4-6 完全脱离后，小心将载具翻转为正面朝上（芯片表面朝上），缓慢分离上盖与底座（图29）。
en: Separation protection: After Tab 4-6 are completely disengaged, carefully turn the carrier over so that the front side is facing up (chip surface facing up), and slowly separate the top cover from the base (Figure 29).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 分离保护：Tab4-6 完全脱离后，小心将载具翻转为正面朝上（芯片表面朝上），缓慢分离上盖与底座。过程中，左手食指轻轻抵住芯片载体手柄端侧面（图31），分离时避免芯片载体与底座脱离，芯片载体掉落损伤芯片。
en: Separation protection: After Tab 4-6 are completely disengaged, carefully turn the carrier over so that the front side is facing up (chip surface facing up), and slowly separate the top cover from the base. During this process, gently press your left index finger against the side of the handle end of the chip slide (Figure 31) to prevent the chip slide from separating from the base and falling, which could damage the chip.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 芯片载体与垫圈黏附较紧，分离后芯片载体会附着在载具上半部分。小心将垫圈从上盖取出后，一手按压住芯片载体，一手将垫圈与芯片载体分离。避免接触到芯片表面。
en: The chip slide is adhered tightly to the gasket, and after separation, the chip slide will remain attached to the upper part of the carrier. After carefully removing the gasket from the top cover, use one hand to press down on the chip slide and the other hand to separate the gasket from the chip slide. Avoid touching the chip surface.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 2.1 （加热后）垫圈与芯片载体玻片黏附较紧的情况下拆卸
en: 2.1 Disassembly when the gasket is firmly adhered to the chip slide slide (after heating)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 2.2 （室温孵育下）垫圈与芯片载体无黏附情况下拆卸
en: 2.2 Disassembly when the gasket is not adhered to the chip slide (under room temperature incubation)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 图31  拆卸过程左手食指抵住芯片载体图示
en: Figure 31 Illustration of the left index finger holding against the chip slide during the disassembly process
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 注意事项：需根据实际情况调整拆卸方式，确保芯片表面无损伤。
en: Precautions: The disassembly method must be adjusted based on the actual situation to ensure that the chip surface is not damaged.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: Stereo-seq V3 载具使用说明书
en: Stereo-seq V3 Carrier Instructions for Use
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 载具下半部分拆分：双手持载具下半部分，大拇指于芯片载体1，4 位底部侧面推动芯片载体从数字端向非数字端移动，使芯片载体从底座中的玻片卡槽中脱离。小心取出芯片载体（手持芯片载体手柄端，防止污染芯片）
en: Disassembling the lower part of the carrier: Hold the lower part of the carrier with both hands, use your thumbs to push the chip slide at the bottom side of positions 1 and 4, moving it from the digital end towards the non-digital end to release it from the slide slot in the base. Carefully remove the chip slide (hold the chip slide by its handle to avoid contaminating the chip).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: Stereo-seq V3 载具使用说明书
en: Stereo-seq V3 Cassette User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 当流程中需要更换 V3 垫圈时，按照 “四、拆卸流程 ” 中“1”步骤操作，将V3 载具拆分为上半部分与下半部分，将载具上半部分的旧垫圈移除，需对上盖进行清洁，操作步骤如下：
en: When it is necessary to replace the V3 gasket during the process, follow the operations in step '1' of 'IV. Disassembly Procedure' to disassemble the V3 carrier into upper and lower parts, remove the old gasket from the upper part of the carrier, and clean the upper cover. The operation steps are as follows:
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 1. 75% 乙醇擦拭上盖去除表面残留试剂，使用洁净气瓶吹净表面残留75% 乙醇与杂质（该过程需避免在芯片载体上方操作）。
en: 1. Wipe the upper cover with 75% ethanol to remove residual reagents from the surface, and use a clean air duster to blow away any residual 75% ethanol and impurities on the surface (this process should be performed away from above the chip slide).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 2. 再根据“安装流程”更换新垫圈并重新组装即可，更换后需再次确认垫圈无变形、贴合紧密。
en: 2. Then, replace with a new gasket according to the "Installation Procedure" and reassemble. After replacement, ensure again that the gasket is not deformed and fits tightly.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: Stereo-seq V3 载具使用说明书
en: Stereo-seq V3 Chip User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: V3 载具中可重复使用的部分为上盖与底座。转录组及透化套装内含不同规格的载具包，请使用套装内的载具进行实验。载具上盖、底架随试剂盒复用，禁止跨试剂盒/跨批次复用。
en: The reusable components of the V3 chip are the lid and the base. The Transcriptome and Tissue Optimization Kit contains chip packs of various specifications. Please use the chips included in the kit for experiments. The chip lid and base are to be reused only with the kit provided; cross-kit or cross-batch reuse is prohibited.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 如需重复使用，需对上盖与底座进行如下的清洁操作：
en: For reuse, the cover and base must be subjected to the following cleaning procedures:
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 1. 首先使用75% 乙醇浸泡10 min；
en: 1. First, immerse in 75% ethanol for 10 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 2. 使用RO 水浸泡载具2 min；
en: 2. Immerse the carrier in RO water for 2 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 3. 将浸泡后载具使用55℃烘箱干燥或者气瓶吹干残余水分；
en: 3. Dry the carrier after soaking using a 55℃ oven or blow dry residual moisture with an air gun;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 4. 将清洁好的上盖、底座装入配件包或干净的自封袋，记录使用状态及日期。
en: 4. Place the cleaned upper cover and base into an accessory bag or a clean ziplock bag, and record the usage status and date.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_V3载具使用说明书

zh: 示例一，2 文库数/lane( 参考方法1) 操作方法：1. 分别取12.5 μL PCR Barcode Primer Mix 1 和2，等体积混合成Mix 后加入到文库1 中；2. 再分别取12.5  μL PCR Barcode Primer Mix 3 和4，等体积混合成Mix 后加入到文库2中。
en: Example 1, 2 libraries/lane (refer to Method 1) Procedure: 1. Take 12.5 μL of PCR Barcode Primer Mix 1 and 2 respectively, mix them in equal volumes to form a Mix, then add to Library 1; 2. Then take 12.5 μL of PCR Barcode Primer Mix 3 and 4 respectively, mix them in equal volumes to form a Mix, then add to Library 2.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_建库试剂盒使用说明书-C

zh: 示例二，13 文库数/lane 操作方法：1. 取25 μL PCR Barcode Primer Mix 1 加入文库1 中，取25 μL PCR Barcode Primer Mix 2 加入文库2 中，，取25 μL PCR Barcode Primer Mix 12 加入文库12 中；2. 再分别取6.25  μL PCR Barcode Primer Mix 13、14、15 和16，等体积混合成Mix 后加入到文库13 中。
en: Example 2: Operating method for 13 libraries/lane: 1. Add 25 μL of PCR Barcode Primer Mix 1 to library 1, add 25 μL of PCR Barcode Primer Mix 2 to library 2, ..., add 25 μL of PCR Barcode Primer Mix 12 to library 12; 2. Take 6.25 μL each of PCR Barcode Primer Mix 13, 14, 15, and 16, mix them in equal volumes to form a Mix, and add it to library 13.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_建库试剂盒使用说明书-C

zh: 示例：有9 个文库 pooling 于一条 lane 中，其中有 1 个文库要求数据量为 30%，此时需采用如下方案：如其他8 个文库分别使用PCR Barcode Primer Mix 1~8，则这一个文库不可使用单一PCR Barcode Primer Mix，而是要使用不重复且成组的PCR Barcode Primer Mix 9~12 或13~16。
en: Example: There are 9 libraries pooled in one lane, among which 1 library requires 30% of the data volume. In this case, the following scheme should be adopted: if the other 8 libraries use PCR Barcode Primer Mix 1-8 respectively, then this library cannot use a single PCR Barcode Primer Mix, but must use a non-repeating and grouped set of PCR Barcode Primer Mix 9-12 or 13-16.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_建库试剂盒使用说明书-C

zh: STOmics® Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版）是用于构建组织切片全转录本 3'端文库的试剂套装。本试剂套装采用的 Stereo-seq 时空转录组技术，是一种基于DNBSEQ 高通量测序技术开发的、具有高分辨大视场特点的原位全转录组信息捕获技术。Stereo-seq 芯片 T（时空 poly-T 芯片）上载有具有空间坐标信息的捕获探针，与组织切片结合后通过探针原位抓取组织内的mRNA 分子并进行cDNA 合成。研究人员通过DNBSEQ 测序和STOmics® 配套的可视化分析工具，可获取特定样本超高分辨率下的空间转录组信息。
en: The STOmics® Stereo-seq Transcriptome Kit (Carrier Version) is a kit designed for the construction of whole-transcriptome 3'-end libraries from tissue sections. The Stereo-seq spatial transcriptomics technology employed in this kit is an in situ whole-transcriptome capture technology characterized by high resolution and a large field of view, developed based on DNBSEQ high-throughput sequencing technology. The Stereo-seq Chip T (spatial poly-T chip) is loaded with capture probes containing spatial coordinate information. Upon binding with tissue sections, these probes capture mRNA molecules within the tissue in situ to perform cDNA synthesis. By utilizing DNBSEQ sequencing and the accompanying STOmics® visualization analysis tools, researchers can obtain spatial transcriptomic information for specific samples at ultra-high resolution.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 结合H&E 染色，研究人员可以更清晰地观察到组织形态学信息，在时空病理研究与应用中更准确地判断组织分型及获取特定组织区域的表达信息，针对选定区域进行下游差异分析和富集分析。
en: Combined with H&E staining, researchers can more clearly observe tissue morphological information, more accurately determine tissue classification in spatial pathology research and applications, obtain expression information from specific tissue regions, and perform downstream differential expression and enrichment analysis on selected regions.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 本试剂套装中提供的所有试剂都经过严格的质量控制和功能验证，最大程度上保证了文库制备的稳定性和重复性。

zh: g.  先将芯片载体卡进夹具下方4 个卡扣。双手中指支撑夹具的正面，左手拇指放在tab 1 和tab 2 之间，右手拇指放在tab 3 和tab 4 之间，拇指匀力向下按压芯片载体，直至听到“咔”的一声。双手食指用力向下按压夹具顶部边缘，将载体卡进夹具上方4 个卡扣;
en: g. First, snap the chip slide into the 4 lower clips of the fixture. Support the front of the fixture with the middle fingers of both hands, place the left thumb between tab 1 and tab 2, and the right thumb between tab 3 and tab 4. Press down on the chip slide with even force using your thumbs until you hear a "click." Press down firmly on the top edge of the fixture with the index fingers of both hands to snap the carrier into the 4 upper clips of the fixture;

zh: •	 本说明书提供的实验流程是通用的，实际操作中可根据具体的实验设计、样本特征、测序应用和设备进行实验流程、反应参数的调整，以优化性能和效率。
en: • The experimental procedures provided in this manual are general guidelines. In practice, adjustments to experimental workflows and reaction parameters may be made based on specific experimental design, sample characteristics, sequencing applications, and equipment to optimize performance and efficiency.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: •	 推荐使用前将各试剂组分提前取出，将酶类组分瞬时离心后置于冰上备用，并将其他组分置于室温解冻。解冻后轻柔地上下颠倒数次使其充分混匀，瞬时离心后置于冰上备用。
en: • It is recommended to take out the reagent components in advance before use. Briefly centrifuge the enzyme components and place them on ice for later use, and thaw the other components at room temperature. After thawing, gently invert the tubes several times to ensure they are thoroughly mixed, then briefly centrifuge them and place them on ice for later use.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: •	 为避免样本交叉污染，推荐使用带滤芯的吸头，吸取不同样本时请更换吸头。
en: • To avoid cross-contamination of samples, it is recommended to use pipette tips with filters and change tips when aspirating different samples.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: •	 推荐把PCR 仪温度预热至反应温度。
en: • It is recommended to preheat the PCR instrument to the reaction temperature.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: •	 应避免皮肤和眼睛直接接触样本及试剂，切勿吞咽样本及试剂，一旦发生意外请立即用大量清水冲洗并及时就医。
en: • Avoid direct contact of samples and reagents with skin and eyes; do not swallow samples or reagents. In case of an accident, rinse immediately with plenty of water and seek medical advice promptly.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: •	 所有样本和各种废弃物均应按相关法规规定处理。

zh: a1. 提前准备一泡沫箱碎冰并将OCT 放在冰上预冷10 min；
en: a1. Prepare a foam box with crushed ice in advance and place the OCT on the ice to pre-cool for 10 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: a2. 根据组织大小提前准备两个合适大小的金属包埋盒A 和B（B 的尺寸需略大于A）；
en: a2. Prepare two metal embedding cassettes, A and B, of suitable sizes in advance based on the tissue size (the dimensions of B should be slightly larger than A);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: a5. 准备一泡沫箱干冰；
en: a5. Prepare a foam box of dry ice;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: a6. 准备具有平整面的金属块，金属块面积需大于金属包埋盒A，用于平放金属包埋盒；
en: a6. Prepare a metal block with a flat surface, the area of which must be larger than metal embedding cassette A, to be used for placing the metal embedding cassette flat;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: a3. 提前将预冷好的OCT 填充金属包埋盒A 的2/3 左右，并放置在冰上预冷10 min 以上（可使用注射器吸弃产生的气泡）；
en: a3. Fill about 2/3 of metal embedding mold A with pre-cooled OCT in advance, and place on ice to pre-cool for at least 10 minutes (a syringe can be used to remove any air bubbles);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: a4. 在平皿中加满OCT，提前预冷10 min（可使用注射器吸弃产生的气泡）；
en: a4. Fill the petri dish with OCT and pre-cool for 10 minutes (a syringe can be used to remove any air bubbles produced);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: a7. 将金属块平整面向上放置到干冰中，预冷5 min 以上；a8. 将金属包埋盒B 放置于干冰中预冷5 min 以上。
en: a7. Place the metal block on dry ice with the flat side facing up and pre-cool for at least 5 minutes; a8. Place metal embedding cassette B on dry ice and pre-cool for at least 5 minutes.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: b.  新鲜组织离体30 min 内，用无菌无纺布或无尘纸擦干组织表面液体，以避免在组织表面形成冰块，影响后续包埋切片；
en: b. Within 30 min after tissue excision, blot dry the surface liquid of the tissue using a sterile non-woven cloth or dust-free paper to avoid the formation of ice crystals on the tissue surface, which could affect subsequent embedding and sectioning;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 2. 样本准备Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装 （载体版兼容 H&E）使用说明书
en: 2. Sample Preparation Stereo-seq Transcriptomics Kit (Chip-compatible with H&E) User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: c.  将组织放入在冰上预冷的OCT 中，在不产生气泡的前提下用药匙使组织被OCT 包裹（可使用注射器吸弃产生的气泡）；
en: c. Place the tissue into OCT that has been pre-cooled on ice, and use a spatula to ensure the tissue is encased in OCT without forming any air bubbles (a syringe can be used to aspirate any bubbles that may form);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: d.  将组织的拟切面朝下，放入冰上预冷的金属包埋盒A 中，使组织接触到金属包埋盒A 的底部。在不产生气泡的前提下用预冷的 OCT 填满金属包埋盒A，直至将组织完全覆盖（可使用注射器吸弃产生的气泡）；
en: d. Place the tissue with the intended cutting surface facing down into a metal embedding cassette A pre-cooled on ice, ensuring the tissue contacts the bottom of the cassette. Fill the metal embedding cassette A with pre-cooled OCT without forming air bubbles until the tissue is completely covered (a syringe can be used to aspirate any bubbles that may form);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: e.  将装有组织的金属包埋盒A，水平放置在干冰预冷的金属块上；
en: e. Place the metal embedding cassette A containing the tissue horizontally onto a metal block pre-cooled on dry ice;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: f.  预冷的金属包埋盒B（作为盖子）开口向上，轻轻加盖于装有组织块的金属包埋盒A 上方，并在其开口中放置碎干冰，使干冰尽可能充分覆盖金属包埋盒表面，形成较为封闭的速冻空间；
en: f. Place the pre-cooled metal embedding cassette B (as a lid) with the opening facing upward, gently cover it over the metal embedding cassette A containing the tissue block, and place crushed dry ice into its opening, ensuring the dry ice covers the surface of the metal embedding cassette as completely as possible to form a relatively enclosed quick-freezing space;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 2. 样本准备Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装 （载体版兼容 H&E）使用说明书
en: 2. Sample Preparation Stereo-seq Transcriptomics Reagent Kit (Slide-compatible with H&E) Instruction Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: g.  冷冻5 min 后，移去金属包埋盒B，检查OCT 是否完全凝固且变成白色不透明状, 若未完全冷冻好，则重复f；
en: g. After freezing for 5 minutes, remove the metal embedding cassette B and check if the OCT has completely solidified and turned white and opaque; if it is not fully frozen, repeat step f;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: h.  如果组织块完全凝固并变成白色不透明状，用手轻掰金属包埋盒A 两侧，即可使OCT 包埋组织块从金属包埋盒A中脱模；
en: h. If the tissue block has completely solidified and turned white and opaque, gently pull apart the sides of metal embedding cassette A to demold the OCT-embedded tissue block from the cassette;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: i.  检查包埋块底部是否被完全覆盖, 如未完全覆盖，则将组织块放置在金属块上，底部向上，在表面涂上少量OCT，待OCT 完全凝固且不透明，在包埋块切面位置做好标记。
en: i. Check if the bottom of the embedding block is fully covered; if not, place the tissue block on a metal block with the bottom facing up, apply a small amount of OCT to the surface, wait for the OCT to fully solidify and turn opaque, and then mark the sectioning face of the embedding block.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 将组织包埋块使用锡纸包裹，并做好标记放入自封袋，在自封袋上做好记录，放入−80℃冰箱长期保存。如需邮寄，可选干冰邮寄。
en: Wrap the tissue blocks in aluminum foil, label them clearly, and place them into a self-sealing bag. Record the necessary information on the bag and store it long-term in a -80°C freezer. If shipping is required, dry ice can be used.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 3. 操作流程Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容 H&E）使用说明书
en: 3. Operation Procedure for Stereo-seq Transcriptome Reagent Kit (Slide version compatible with H&E) User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 本实验用于稀释试剂的液体，除特殊说明外，均使用Nuclease - Free Water。
en: Unless otherwise specified, Nuclease-Free Water is used as the liquid for diluting reagents in this experiment.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 准备试剂准备流程  保存条件
en: Preparation Reagent Preparation Procedure Storage Conditions
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 0.1X SSC 取20X SSC 100 μL 稀释到20 mL取20X SSC 250 μL 稀释到50 mL    室温
en: 0.1X SSC: Take 100 μL of 20X SSC and dilute to 20 mL; take 250 μL of 20X SSC and dilute to 50 mL. Room temperature.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: Wash Buffer取25 μL RI 加入475 μL 0.1X SSC 中，用量至少为500 μL/ 芯片 冰上备用
en: Wash Buffer: Take 25 μL RI and add to 475 μL 0.1X SSC; usage at least 500 μL/chip. Keep on ice for use.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 0.01N HCl按照HCl 浓度梯度稀释到0.01N，pH 值准确到2（确保pH 值在1.9-2.1 范围内；至少2 mL/ 样本）   室温48 hr
en: Dilute HCl to 0.01N according to the concentration gradient, with the pH value accurately adjusted to 2 (ensure the pH value is within the range of 1.9-2.1; at least 2 mL/sample), at room temperature for 48 hr.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 0.01N HCl (pH = 2.0 ) 需现配现用。对于预制的0.1N HCl 和新购买的HCl，实验前请检查pH 值。
en: 0.01N HCl (pH = 2.0) should be prepared fresh before use. For pre-made 0.1N HCl and newly purchased HCl, please check the pH value before the experiment.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 储存时间超过48 hr 将影响预期pH 值，请在配制后48 hr 内使用。
en: Storage for more than 48 hr will affect the expected pH value; please use it within 48 hr after preparation.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 10X 透化试剂储存液用1 mL 新鲜配制的0.01N HCl 将PR Enzyme（红盖，粉末状）溶解后，通过移液器吹打混匀（可分装成若干份）  −20℃
en: To prepare 10X Permeabilization Reagent stock solution, dissolve PR Enzyme (red cap, powder) with 1 mL of freshly prepared 0.01N HCl, and mix by pipetting up and down (can be aliquoted into multiple portions) at −20℃.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 不要涡旋透化酶，可通过移液器吹打混匀。建议对配制好的10X 透化试剂储存液进行分装，避免反复冻融。
en: Do not vortex the permeabilization enzyme; mix by pipetting up and down. It is recommended to aliquot the prepared 10X Permeabilization Reagent stock solution to avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 1X 透化试剂工作液用0.01N HCl 将10X 透化试剂储存液 10 μL 稀释到100 μL（至少100 μL/ 芯片）   冰上备用6 hr
en: To prepare 1X Permeabilization Reagent working solution, dilute 10 μL of 10X Permeabilization Reagent stock solution with 0.01N HCl to 100 μL (at least 100 μL/chip); prepare on ice and use within 6 hr.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 醇溶伊红溶液取 0.013 g Eosin Y 粉末溶于 25 mL 甲醇中，用封口膜封口保存室温 1 个月
en: For the alcohol-soluble Eosin Y solution, dissolve 0.013 g of Eosin Y powder in 25 mL of methanol, seal with Parafilm, and store at room temperature for 1 month.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: RT Oligo短暂离心，加入79 μL TE buffer 重悬。盖紧盖子后最大速度涡旋15 s，然后短暂离心−80℃
en: Briefly centrifuge the RT Oligo, add 79 μL of TE buffer to resuspend. Tighten the lid, vortex at maximum speed for 15 s, then briefly centrifuge and store at -80°C.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 可分装未使用的RT Oligo，并保存于−80℃，以避免反复冻融。
en: Unused RT Oligo can be aliquoted and stored at -80°C to avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: H&E 封片剂（H&E Mounting Medium）每张芯片用量 3.5 μL室温
en: H&E Mounting Medium: 3.5 μL per chip at room temperature
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: PR Rinse Buffer（含5% RI）
en: PR Rinse Buffer (containing 5% RI)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 每张芯片至少准备 200 μL（190 μL PR Rinse Buffer + 10 μL RI）。配制后置于冰上备用，使用前室温平衡 5 min
en: Prepare at least 200 μL per chip (190 μL PR Rinse Buffer + 10 μL RI). Keep on ice after preparation, and equilibrate to room temperature for 5 min before use.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 冰上备用，使用前室温平衡5 min
en: Keep on ice; equilibrate to room temperature for 5 min before use.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

en: b. Pre-cool the cryostat chamber to −20°C and the specimen head to −15°C to −10°C (adjust according to the actual operation process);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: c. 提前将毛刷、刀片和镊子等置于箱体预冷；
en: c. Place brushes, blades, forceps, etc., in the chamber in advance to pre-cool;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: d. 将OCT 包埋的组织块从−80℃冰箱取出，放在冷冻切片机内平衡30 min；
en: d. Remove the OCT-embedded tissue block from the -80°C freezer and place it in the cryostat to equilibrate for 30 minutes;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: e. 使用OCT 将组织块固定到样品托上；
en: e. Mount the tissue block onto the specimen chuck using OCT;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: f. 将组织块修剪成合适的尺寸（切面小于 0.9 cm × 0.9 cm），切去组织块周围过多的OCT，保留一部分OCT，方便转移组织；
en: f. Trim the tissue block to an appropriate size (cutting surface smaller than 0.9 cm × 0.9 cm), remove excess OCT around the tissue block, and retain a small amount of OCT to facilitate tissue transfer;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: g. 根据需要对组织块做最后地修剪，以确保组织切片能更好地适配芯片，随后可进行冷冻切片。
en: g. Perform final trimming of the tissue block as needed to ensure the tissue section fits better onto the specimen holder, and then proceed to cryosectioning.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 样本头温度过低会导致切片出现裂纹，样本头温度过高会导致切片出现褶皱，请根据样本情况将冻头调
en: If the specimen head temperature is too low, it will cause cracks in the sections; if the temperature is too high, it will cause wrinkles. Please adjust the specimen head
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 样本头温度过低会导致切片出现裂纹，样本头温度过高会导致切片出现褶皱，请根据样本情况将冻头调
en: If the specimen head temperature is too low, it will cause cracks in the sections, while if it is too high, it will cause wrinkles; please adjust the freezing head
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 3. 操作流程Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容 H&E）使用说明书
en: 3. Operational Workflow Stereo-seq Transcriptomics Reagent Kit (Slide Version Compatible with H&E) Instruction Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: a. 取芯片：从真空干燥铝箔袋中取出 Stereo-seq 芯片T 载体，记录芯片背面的编号；注意不要触碰芯片正面；
en: a. Remove the chip: Remove the Stereo-seq chip T-carrier from the vacuum-dried aluminum foil bag and record the serial number on the back of the chip; be careful not to touch the front of the chip;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: b. 将载体置于桌面上复温1 min，观察芯片表面是否有杂质，如芯片上存在杂质，使用100 μL Nuclease-Free Water 清洗2 次（或在含40-50 mL Nuclease Free Water 的离心管中清洗2 次 )；
en: b. Place the carrier on the desktop to equilibrate to room temperature for 1 min, then observe whether there are impurities on the chip surface. If impurities are present on the chip, wash it twice with 100 μL Nuclease-Free Water (or wash twice in a centrifuge tube containing 40-50 mL Nuclease-Free Water);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 打开后，请检查玻片盒中的所有的 Stereo-seq 芯片载体是否正确定位在插槽中，载体上的芯片是否正面
en: After opening, please check if all Stereo-seq chip slides in the slide box are correctly positioned in the slots and if the chips on the carriers are facing up.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 朝上。芯片的正面为亮光面，正面含有用于 mRNA 捕获的探针。请勿触碰到芯片表面。
en: Face up. The front side of the chip is the glossy side, which contains probes for mRNA capture. Do not touch the chip surface.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: c. 清洗后用气瓶吹干芯片四周及表面，再用无尘纸吸干载玻片背面和周围多余的液体；
en: c. After washing, blow-dry the periphery and surface of the chip with a gas cylinder, then use lint-free paper to absorb any excess liquid on the back of the slide and around it;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: d. 当芯片表面无杂质、无明显痕迹、无任何液体残留、无波纹状纹理，即可准备贴片；
en: d. When the chip surface is free of impurities, visible marks, any liquid residue, or wavy textures, it is ready for mounting;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: e. 预冷甲醇和醇溶伊红溶液：准备3 个玻片盒或者50 mL 离心管作为固定容器，在其中两个容器中加入足量甲醇，另外一个容器中加入足量醇溶伊红溶液，确保液体体积足够浸没过所有芯片（可将一张普通载玻片放入容器中，查看加入液体的体积是否足够）。盖紧上盖，提前预冷（−20℃）5-30 min；
en: e. Pre-cooling methanol and alcohol-soluble eosin solution: Prepare 3 slide boxes or 50 mL centrifuge tubes as fixation containers. Add a sufficient amount of methanol to two of the containers and a sufficient amount of alcohol-soluble eosin solution to the other, ensuring that the volume of liquid is enough to immerse all chips (you can place a standard microscope slide into the container to check if the volume of the added liquid is sufficient). Tighten the lids and pre-cool at −20°C for 5–30 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: f. 将组织包埋块固定至冻头上，修片；
en: f. Fix the tissue embedding block to the cryo-chuck and trim the block;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: g. 组织贴片有两种操作方式可选：热贴（A）和冷贴（B）。根据需求选择切片厚度，通常为10 μm。
en: g. There are two optional methods for tissue mounting: heat mounting (A) and cold mounting (B). Select the section thickness according to requirements, typically 10 μm.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 1）连续切取组织切片，将切片移到切片台右侧靠近边缘处，然后用预冷的毛刷轻轻拨动切片周围的OCT 使切片铺平，每张切片放置间隔距离大于载体宽度；
en: 1) Continuously cut tissue sections, move them to the right edge of the sectioning stage, then use a pre-cooled brush to gently manipulate the OCT around the sections to flatten them, ensuring the spacing between each section is greater than the width of the carrier;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 2）拿起载体的一边，使芯片正面朝下，对准切片；
en: 2) Pick up one side of the carrier, position the chip side facing down, and align it with the section;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 3）轻轻一压，肉眼可见切片已经吸附到芯片表面；
en: 3) Gently press down; the slice can be seen with the naked eye to have adsorbed onto the chip surface;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 4）重复 2）-3）步骤操作，直至全部组织切片吸附到芯片表面（贴片时间控制在1 min 以内）；
en: 4) Repeat steps 2)-3) until all tissue slices are adsorbed onto the chip surface (control the mounting time to within 1 min);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 5）将芯片正面朝上，快速将载体置于提前平衡温度的PCR 适配器上，37℃孵育5 min，无需盖PCR 热盖。
en: 5) With the chip facing upward, quickly place the carrier onto a pre-equilibrated PCR adapter and incubate at 37°C for 5 min; do not close the PCR lid.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 3. 操作流程Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容 H&E）使用说明书
en: 3. Workflow - Stereo-seq Transcriptomics Reagent Kit (Carrier-compatible with H&E) Instruction Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: a.	 将上一步烤干的芯片立即放于−20℃下预冷的第一个存放甲醇的容器中固定17 min，确保甲醇浸没过所有芯片（可根据实验调整固定时间，固定时间控制在17-27 min 的范围内）；
en: a. Immediately place the slide dried in the previous step into the first container of methanol pre-cooled at −20°C to fix for 17 min, ensuring that the methanol covers all slides (the fixation time can be adjusted according to the experiment, controlled within the range of 17-27 min);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: b.	 将芯片转移到-20℃预冷的醇溶伊红溶液中染色3 min，确保伊红溶液浸没过所有芯片（可根据组织着色均匀情况调整，染色时间控制在 3-5 min 的范围内）；
en: b. Transfer the chip to -20°C pre-cooled alcohol-soluble eosin solution and stain for 3 min, ensuring the eosin solution fully covers all chips (the duration can be adjusted based on the uniformity of tissue staining; keep the staining time within the 3–5 min range);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: c.	 醇溶伊红染色结束以后，将芯片转移回第一个存放甲醇的容器中，继续−20℃固定10 min；
en: c. Once alcohol-soluble eosin staining is finished, transfer the chip back to the first container containing methanol and continue fixation at -20°C for 10 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: d.	 再次固定结束以后，将芯片转移到−20℃预冷的新的存放甲醇的容器中继续固定1 min；
en: d. Once this secondary fixation is finished, transfer the chip to a new container containing -20°C pre-cooled methanol and continue fixation for 1 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: e.	 将容器转移到通风橱中，从容器中取出载体，用无尘纸吸干载玻片背面和周围多余的甲醇，确保无液体残留；
en: e. Transfer the container to the fume hood, remove the carrier from the container, and use lint-free paper to blot dry the back and surroundings of the slide to remove excess methanol, ensuring no liquid residue remains;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: f.	将载体竖立放在载玻片染色架上，在通风柜中通风4-6 min，让甲醇充分挥发；
en: f. Place the carrier upright on a slide staining rack and allow it to air-dry in the fume hood for 4-6 minutes to ensure complete evaporation of the methanol;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: g.	 甲醇挥发干后，肉眼可见表面变干，将载体转移至实验台上，准备下一步染色。
en: g. Once the methanol has evaporated and the surface appears dry to the naked eye, transfer the carrier to the laboratory bench in preparation for the next staining step.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 1)  将玻片正面朝上置于切片机中，预冷1-6 min；
en: 1) Place the glass slide face up in the cryostat and pre-cool for 1-6 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 2）进行冷冻切片，然后用预冷的毛刷轻轻拨动切片周围的OCT 使切片铺平。用镊子和毛刷将切片小心覆盖在芯片正中央并铺平，注意毛刷不要触碰到组织。尽量一次贴片成功，确保组织切片完整，无褶皱；
en: 2) Perform cryosectioning, then gently manipulate the OCT around the section with a pre-cooled brush to flatten the section. Carefully cover the chip with the section in the center using tweezers and a brush and flatten it, taking care that the brush does not touch the tissue. Try to complete the mounting in one attempt, ensuring the tissue section is intact and free of wrinkles;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 3）立即拿起芯片载体，用指腹放在载体背面加温几秒钟，直至切片贴合；
en: 3) Immediately pick up the chip slide and warm the back of the carrier with your fingertip for a few seconds until the section adheres;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 4）重复上述操作，直至所有切片贴片完成，建议组织切片贴片控制在5 min 内；
en: 4) Repeat the above steps until all sections are mounted; it is recommended to complete section mounting within 5 minutes;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 5）快速将载体置于PCR 适配器上37℃孵育5 min，无需盖PCR 热盖。
en: 5) Quickly place the carrier on a PCR adapter and incubate at 37°C for 5 minutes; do not close the PCR heated lid.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 预冷时间不可过长，以免玻片表面产生水雾；预冷时间不可太短，以免玻片无法达到预冷温度。
en: The pre-cooling time must not be too long to avoid condensation on the slide surface; it must not be too short, which would prevent the slide from reaching the target pre-cooling temperature.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 同一组织建议保持染色时间统一。
en: For the same tissue, it is recommended to keep the staining time consistent.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 进行冷贴时需控制好每张切片贴片时间，间隔时间太大，组织贴片会皱缩。
en: When performing cold mounting, the time taken to mount each section must be controlled; an excessive interval will cause the tissue section to wrinkle.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: （可选暂停点）将孵育好的芯片载体放于玻片盒或者50 mL 离心管，用干冰快速转移到−80℃冰箱，最长可于−80℃保存一个月。
en: (Optional pause point) Place the incubated chip slide into a slide box or 50 mL centrifuge tube, transfer it quickly on dry ice to a −80°C freezer, and store it at −80°C for up to one month.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 继续实验时，使用干冰将玻片盒或者50 mL 离心管转移，取出贴有组织的芯片载体，快速置于PCR 适配器上37℃孵育5 min。
en: To continue the experiment, transfer the slide box or 50 mL centrifuge tube using dry ice, remove the chip slide with tissue attached, and quickly place it on a PCR adapter to incubate at 37°C for 5 min.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 准备步骤 3.5 所需要的试剂，计算好用量备用，在使用前再加入RI，混匀后再使用；此时可检查显微镜已经打开并切换到（落射明场（彩色拍照），BF-Epi 通道模式）。
en: Prepare the reagents required for step 3.5, calculate the required amounts for standby, add RI just before use, and mix well before using; at this time, check that the microscope is turned on and switched to (reflected brightfield (color photography), BF-Epi channel mode).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 3. 操作流程Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容 H&E）使用说明书
en: 3. Operational Procedures - Stereo-seq Transcriptomics Reagent Kit (Chip Version Compatible with H&E) User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: a.	 根据【实验前准备】，提前配制2 mL 0.01N HCl；参考表格3-1 提前配制好试剂；
en: a. According to [Pre-experiment Preparation], prepare 2 mL of 0.01N HCl in advance; refer to Table 3-1 to prepare the reagents in advance;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: b.	 在芯片表面滴加苏木素染色液100 μL（含5% RI）。先在芯片的每个角加入一滴染色液，然后将其余染色液加到芯片中央，使所有染色液融合，确保染色液均匀覆盖全芯片，室温孵育时间根据选择苏木素不同品牌调整；
en: b. Apply 100 μL of hematoxylin staining solution (containing 5% RI) onto the chip surface. First, add one drop of staining solution to each corner of the chip, then add the remaining staining solution to the center of the chip to allow all the solution to merge, ensuring that the staining solution evenly covers the entire chip. Incubate at room temperature, with the incubation time adjusted according to the specific brand of hematoxylin used;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: c.	 倾斜载体，用移液器从芯片一角吸弃苏木素染色液，尽量减少表面液体残留；
en: c. Tilt the carrier and use a pipette to aspirate and discard the hematoxylin staining solution from one corner of the chip, minimizing any residual liquid on the surface;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: d.	 用100 μL Wash Buffer 清洗3 次，每次清洗时可以轻微倾斜芯片（倾斜角度小于60°），直接将芯片表面液体倾倒在无尘纸上，最后一次清洗尽量减少芯片表面液体残留( 可用无尘纸吸去流出芯片的液体)；
en: d. Wash 3 times with 100 μL of Wash Buffer. During each wash, the chip may be slightly tilted (tilt angle less than 60°), and the liquid on the chip surface can be directly poured onto dust-free paper. Minimize residual liquid on the chip surface after the last wash (dust-free paper may be used to absorb the liquid flowing out of the chip);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: e.	 将Bluing Buffer（返蓝染色液，含 5% RI）滴加在到芯片上，用量为100 μL/ 芯片。先在芯片的每个角加入一滴染色液，然后将其余染色液加到芯片中央，使所有染色液融合，确保染色液均匀覆盖全芯片，室温孵育 2 min；
en: e. Add 100 μL/chip of Bluing Buffer (containing 5% RI) to the chip. Apply one drop of the staining solution to each corner of the chip first, then add the remaining solution to the center so that all solution merges, ensuring it evenly covers the entire chip. Incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: f.	倾斜载体，用移液器从芯片一角吸弃返蓝染色液，尽量减少表面液体残留；
en: f. Tilt the carrier and use a pipette to aspirate and discard the Bluing Buffer from one corner of the chip, minimizing residual liquid on the surface.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: g.	 向芯片加入Wash Buffer 进行清洗，用量为100 μL/ 芯片，清洗后直接将芯片表面液体倾倒在无尘纸上，尽量减少芯片表面液体残留；
en: g. Add 100 μL/chip of Wash Buffer to the chip for cleaning. After washing, immediately pour the liquid off the chip surface onto dust-free paper, minimizing residual liquid on the chip surface.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: h.	 将芯片转移至无尘纸上，一只手固定载体，另一只手持空气罐，出气口距离芯片一角 2-3 cm 位置，以大概30°倾角快速吹干芯片，注意吹干载玻片表面以及芯片与载玻片缝隙的液体，可用无尘纸擦掉芯片周围的液体；
en: h. Transfer the chip onto a lint-free wipe. Steady the carrier with one hand, and hold the air duster in the other hand. Position the nozzle 2-3 cm from one corner of the chip and quickly blow-dry the chip at an angle of approximately 30°, ensuring the liquid on the slide surface and in the gap between the chip and the slide is dried. Any liquid around the chip can be wiped off with a lint-free wipe.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: i.	用移液器缓慢吸取3.5 μL H&E Mounting Medium 滴加到组织中央，避免产生气泡;
en: i. Use a pipette to slowly draw 3.5 μL of H&E Mounting Medium and dispense it onto the center of the tissue, avoiding the formation of air bubbles.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: j.	用镊子夹取盖玻片，小心将盖玻片的一端放在芯片边上，同时握住另一端，然后
en: j. Use tweezers to pick up the coverslip. Carefully place one end of the coverslip at the edge of the chip while holding the other end, then
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 苏木素在使用前需要使用0.22 μm 的滤膜（即为针筒式过滤器配套一次性无菌注射器） 过滤。
en: Hematoxylin needs to be filtered using a 0.22 μm filter membrane (i.e., a syringe filter with a disposable sterile syringe) before use.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 先提前分装好染液的用量，染色前5 min 加入5% 体积的RI，震荡混匀后即可使用。
en: Aliquot the required amount of staining solution in advance, add 5% (v/v) RI 5 minutes before staining, shake to mix well, and then it is ready for use.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 推荐的Sigma 苏木素染色时间为7 min，Solarbio 苏木素染色时间为3 min。
en: The recommended staining time for Sigma hematoxylin is 7 minutes, and for Solarbio hematoxylin is 3 minutes.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 请保证芯片与载玻片缝隙无液体残留，否则滴加 H&E Mounting Medium 后可能引起伊红晕开。
en: Please ensure there is no residual liquid in the gap between the chip and the slide; otherwise, applying the H&E Mounting Medium may cause the eosin to bleed.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 滴加 H&E Mounting Medium 以后，建议立刻封片。
en: After applying the H&E Mounting Medium, it is recommended to mount the slide immediately.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 表格 3-1 染液及 Bluing Buffer 用量
en: Table 3-1 Staining Reagent and Bluing Buffer Volumes
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 准备试剂准备流程储存
en: Preparation, Reagent Preparation Procedure, Storage
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 苏木素染色液（含 5%RI）每张芯片至少准备 100 μL（95 μL 苏木素 + 5 μL RI）室温 5 min
en: Hematoxylin Staining Solution (containing 5% RI): Prepare at least 100 μL per chip (95 μL Hematoxylin + 5 μL RI), keep at room temperature for 5 min.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: Bluing Buffer（含 5%RI）每张芯片至少准备 100 μL（95 μL Bluing Buffer + 5 μL RI）室温 5 min
en: Bluing Buffer (containing 5% RI): Prepare at least 100 μL per chip (95 μL Bluing Buffer + 5 μL RI), keep at room temperature for 5 min.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 3. 操作流程Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容 H&E）使用说明书
en: 3. Operational Procedure - Stereo-seq Transcriptomics Kit (Slide version compatible with H&E) Instruction Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: a.	 在显微镜控制软件中新建文件夹，以芯片号命名，也可适当注明其他相关信息；
en: a. Create a new folder in the microscope control software, name it with the chip ID, and you may also appropriately annotate other relevant information;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: b.	 用显微镜的玻片夹将载玻片固定，如没有玻片夹，则在载物台上滴加1-2 μL 水，将载玻片置于水滴上以起到固定作用；
en: b. Secure the slide using the microscope's slide clips. If slide clips are unavailable, place 1-2 μL of water on the stage and set the slide on top of the water droplet to secure it;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: c.	 模式选择：选择落射明场通道，彩色相机；
en: c. Mode selection: Select the epi-illumination brightfield channel and the color camera;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: d.	 选择4X 物镜，将视野移动至芯片上的组织区域，调节焦距，直至视野内组织和细胞呈清晰状态，判断组织区域颜色是否正确，如果有问题，需要移到芯片空白区域进行白平衡校正;
en: d. Select the 4X objective lens, move the field of view to the tissue area on the chip, and adjust the focus until the tissue and cells within the field of view are clear. Assess whether the color of the tissue area is correct; if there is an issue, move to a blank area of the chip to perform white balance calibration;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: e.	 大致框选芯片区域，要求芯片完全在框选区域内且框选区域略微大于芯片，在4X 物镜下扫描地图，以便确定正式扫描区域（如果显微镜无扫描地图功能，直接跳至步骤f.）；
en: e. Roughly select the chip area, ensuring the chip is completely within the bounding box and the box is slightly larger than the chip. Scan the map under a 4X objective lens to determine the final scanning area (if the microscope lacks a map scanning function, proceed directly to step f.).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: f.	将物镜调节至10X，进一步调整框选区域与芯片边缘重合，先移到组织区域，直至视野内组织和细胞呈清晰状态，选择组织中较关注的区域，微调焦距，在不同区域建立3-5 个建模点；
en: f. Adjust the objective lens to 10X and further refine the bounding box to align with the chip edges. Move to the tissue area and focus until the tissues and cells are clearly visible. Select areas of interest within the tissue, fine-tune the focus, and establish 3-5 modeling points in various regions.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: g.	 再将视野移至芯片空白区域，微调焦距，直至芯片上的Track 线清晰，在芯片不同的空白区域（建议在芯片四个角）建立3-5 个模型点；
en: g. Move the field of view to a blank area on the chip, fine-tune the focus until the track lines on the chip are clear, and establish 3-5 modeling points in different blank areas on the chip (recommended at the four corners of the chip).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: h.	 完成建模后，随即进行拍照；拍照完成后，导出原始 FOV 小图与拼接大图。打开ImageStudio 软件的图像QC 模块，上传H&E 染色图像，并参考软件内置的《ImageStudio 用户手册》来进行图像QC；
en: h. After modeling is completed, immediately proceed to imaging; once imaging is done, export the original FOV small images and the stitched large image. Open the Image QC module in the ImageStudio software, upload the H&E stained image, and refer to the software's built-in "ImageStudio User Manual" to perform image QC.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: i.	拍照后，用镊子将盖玻片轻轻推至载玻片边缘，夹起盖玻片一角；
en: i. After imaging, use tweezers to gently push the coverslip to the edge of the slide, and lift one corner of the coverslip.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: j.	用镊子轻轻地平行移动盖玻片，直到芯片与盖玻片完全分离；
en: j. Gently move the coverslip in parallel using tweezers until the chip and the coverslip are completely separated.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: k.	 将载体置于装有至少 30 mL 0.1X SSC 的 50 mL 离心管中浸泡 3-5 s；
en: k. Place the carrier in a 50 mL centrifuge tube containing at least 30 mL of 0.1X SSC and soak for 3-5 s;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: l.	取出载玻片，用无尘纸擦去载玻片背面及芯片四周的残液，确保无液体残留；
en: l. Remove the slide, wipe off residual liquid from the back of the slide and around the chip with a lint-free tissue, and ensure no liquid remains;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: m.	 在芯片上缓缓滴加 100 μL 0.01N HCl 溶液，从芯片的一角吸弃液体。
en: m. Slowly add 100 μL of 0.01N HCl solution dropwise onto the chip, then aspirate the liquid from one corner of the chip.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 逐渐将盖玻片放低到芯片上直至完全覆盖芯片；
en: Gradually lower the coverslip onto the chip until it completely covers the chip;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: k.	 待H&E Mounting Medium 浸润整张芯片后，立即安排拍照（如果需要重新拍照，建议每张芯片从封片到拍照的总时间不超过30 min）。
en: k. Once the H&E Mounting Medium has fully infiltrated the chip, immediately proceed with imaging (if re-imaging is required, it is recommended that the total time from coverslipping to imaging for each chip does not exceed 30 min).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 请保证盖玻片使用前干净无灰尘，可使用酒精擦拭盖玻片表面或者使用空气罐吹干净。
en: Please ensure the coverslip is clean and free of dust before use; you may wipe the surface of the coverslip with alcohol or use an air duster to blow it clean.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 文件夹名称只使用字母、数字、下划线，禁止使用空格等特殊字符。
en: Folder names must only use letters, numbers, and underscores; special characters such as spaces are prohibited.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 确保芯片全部浸没于溶液中。
en: Ensure the chip is completely submerged in the solution.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 3. 操作流程Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容 H&E）使用说明书
en: 3. Operation Procedure for Stereo-seq Transcriptome Kit (Slide version compatible with H&E)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: a.	 显微镜扫片时请勿触碰显微镜所在平面，周边不能有包括行走的震源;
en: a. When scanning slides with a microscope, do not touch the surface on which the microscope is placed, and ensure there are no nearby sources of vibration, including foot traffic.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: b.	 显微镜扫描染色图像时，尽量避免过曝，可通过图像像素统计情况（如：直方图）来判断，刚好不过曝的情况为：直方图曲率适中不贴边，既直方图横坐标最大值处仅有微小突起;
en: b. When scanning stained images with a microscope, try to avoid overexposure; this can be judged by the image pixel statistics (e.g., a histogram). The condition of being just short of overexposure is: the histogram curvature is moderate and does not touch the edges, meaning there is only a tiny protrusion at the maximum value of the histogram's abscissa.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: c.	 推荐使用手动对焦，按照上文策略在芯片四角和组织内分别定焦，以此同时获得清晰的 Track 线和染色图像（自动对焦模式遵循自动流程即可）；
en: Manual focusing is recommended. Follow the strategy described above to set the focus at the four corners of the chip and within the tissue respectively, in order to simultaneously obtain clear Track lines and stained images (for autofocus mode, simply follow the automatic process);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: d.	 手动定焦拍照过程中先根据组织选定合适的焦面、曝光、灯光参数，再在空白处根据Track 线调整，灯光参数不宜过低或过高，否则会影响染色区域和Track 线的图像质量;
en: During the manual focusing and imaging process, first select appropriate parameters for the focal plane, exposure, and lighting based on the tissue, and then make adjustments in the blank areas based on the Track lines. The lighting parameters should not be too low or too high, as this will affect the image quality of the stained areas and the Track lines;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: e.	 如果在封片过程中，存在较大区域（超过 4 个视野大小）未被H&E Mounting Medium 浸润，则需要对此区域增加建模点;
en: If a large area (exceeding 4 fields of view) is not infiltrated by the H&E Mounting Medium during the mounting process, additional modeling points must be added for this area;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: f.	谨慎使用自动对焦模式，大部分自动对焦策略无法对 Track 线精确定焦，容易造成 QC 失败。
en: f. Use auto-focus mode with caution, as most auto-focus strategies cannot precisely lock focus on the Track line, easily resulting in QC failure.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: •	 图a 为组织外选取的一个对焦点视野窗口截图，应保证 Track 线清晰分明；
en: • Figure a is a screenshot of a focus field window selected outside the tissue; ensure the Track line is clear and distinct.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: •	 图b 为组织内选取的一个对焦点视野窗口截图，应保证组织染色白平衡正常，图像清晰。
en: • Figure b is a screenshot of a focus field-of-view (FOV) window selected within the tissue; ensure that the tissue staining white balance is normal and the image is clear.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: •	 图c 为芯片内选取的一个对焦点视野窗口截图，未正确对焦，导致Track 线模糊；
en: • Figure c is a screenshot of a focus field-of-view (FOV) window selected within the chip, which is not focused correctly, resulting in blurred Track lines;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: •	 图d 为芯片内选取的一个对焦点视野窗口截图，有较多气泡，在气泡内建模为无效 Track 点；
en: • Figure d is a screenshot of a focus field-of-view window selected within the chip, containing many bubbles, where the area within the bubbles is modeled as invalid track points;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: •	 图e 为组织区域框选截图，背景和组织颜色异常，未做好白平衡。
en: • Figure e is a screenshot of the selected tissue area, showing abnormal colors for both the background and the tissue due to improper white balance.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 3. 操作流程Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容 H&E）使用说明书
en: 3. Operational Workflow: Stereo-seq Transcriptomics Reagent Kit (Slide-compatible version with H&E) Instruction Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: a.  根据【实验前准备】，提前准备好1X 透化试剂工作液；
en: a. Prepare the 1X Permeabilization Reagent working solution in advance according to [Preparation Before Experiment];
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: b.  提前将2 台PCR 仪（或1 个PCR 仪、1 个金属浴）温度设置到37℃，热盖温度为42℃，其中一个PCR 仪提前放置PCR 适配器平衡温度；
en: b. Set the temperature of two PCR machines (or one PCR machine and one metal bath) to 37°C in advance, with the lid temperature set to 42°C. Place a PCR adapter in one of the PCR machines in advance to equilibrate the temperature;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 42°C 热盖on-
en: 42°C heated lid on-
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 37°C60 min1
en: 37°C 60 min 1
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 37°CHold-
en: 37°C Hold-
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: c. 提前取出RT Reagent, RT Additive 和 RT Oligo 置于室温解冻，RT Oligo 解冻后置于冰上备用；
en: c. Take out RT Reagent, RT Additive, and RT Oligo in advance and thaw them at room temperature. After thawing, place RT Oligo on ice for later use;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: d. 参考步骤 1.6. 将垫圈与夹具组合成载具（不含芯片载体）。将载具放置于PCR适配器上，盖上PCR 仪盖，37℃孵育10 min，透化工作液使用前置于PCR 仪或者金属浴中37℃孵育10 min（最长时间不超过30 min）；
en: d. Refer to step 1.6 to assemble the gasket and clamp into a carrier (excluding the chip slide). Place the carrier on the PCR adapter, close the PCR machine lid, and incubate at 37°C for 10 min. Incubate the permeabilization working solution in a PCR machine or metal bath at 37°C for 10 min before use (maximum time should not exceed 30 min);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: e. 载具孵育完成后，将载体固定于载具上，组合成手持载具，确保夹具 8 个卡扣扣紧并且载体两侧贴紧夹具两侧；
en: e. After the incubation is complete, fix the support onto the carrier to assemble into a handheld carrier, ensuring the 8 latches of the fixture are securely fastened and both sides of the support are pressed tightly against the sides of the fixture;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: f.  从反应孔的一角加入1X  透化试剂工作液 , 用量为100 μL/ 芯片，用封板膜对手持载具进行封口，无需撕开封板膜粘到载具上，盖上PCR 仪盖，37℃孵育；
en: f. Add 100 μL/chip of 1X permeabilization reagent working solution from one corner of the reaction well, seal the handheld carrier with a plate sealing film (no need to peel off the film and stick it onto the carrier), close the PCR instrument lid, and incubate at 37°C;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 确保芯片被1X 透化试剂工作液完全覆盖。

source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 本试剂套装推荐使用VAHTS DNA Clean Beads 或AMPure® XP（Agencourt, Cat. No. A63882）进行磁珠纯化。如果使用其他品牌的磁珠，纯化条件需要重新摸索。
en: This reagent kit recommends using VAHTS DNA Clean Beads or AMPure® XP (Agencourt, Cat. No. A63882) for magnetic bead purification. If using magnetic beads from other brands, purification conditions need to be re-optimized.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: •	 提前30 min 从4℃取出，涡旋混匀且平衡至室温，有利于保证回收效率。
en: • Take out from 4°C 30 minutes in advance, vortex to mix, and equilibrate to room temperature to help ensure recovery efficiency.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: •	 磁珠每次使用前，需振荡或用移液器上下吸打，确保充分混匀。
en: • Before each use, vortex the magnetic beads or pipette them up and down to ensure they are thoroughly mixed.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: •	 磁珠使用量直接影响纯化得到的DNA 片段分布。磁珠用量越高，纯化得到的DNA 片段的下限长度越小。
en: • The amount of magnetic beads used directly affects the size distribution of the purified DNA fragments. A higher amount of magnetic beads results in a lower size cutoff for the purified DNA fragments.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 磁珠操作注意事项
en: Precautions for Magnetic Bead Handling
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: •	 样本与磁珠充分混匀后置于磁力架上进行分离时，请于溶液彻底澄清后再吸取上清，一般需要2-3 min。但由于磁力架吸力不同等原因，推荐分离时间有时可能需要延长，以液体彻底澄清为准。
en: • When separating the sample on a magnetic rack after thoroughly mixing it with the magnetic beads, please wait until the solution is completely clear before aspirating the supernatant; this generally takes 2-3 minutes. However, due to factors such as differences in magnetic rack strength, the recommended separation time may occasionally need to be extended; complete clarification of the solution should be the final criterion.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: •	 在分离磁珠与液体时，注意吸头不可碰到磁珠，最后可余留2-3 μL 液体，以避免吸到磁珠。若不慎吸到磁珠，可将磁珠与液体全部打回管内，再次分离后再吸取上清。
en: • When separating the magnetic beads from the liquid, take care not to touch the beads with the pipette tip. You may leave 2-3 μL of liquid at the end to avoid aspirating the beads. If you accidentally aspirate any beads, you may dispense all the beads and liquid back into the tube, repeat the separation, and then aspirate the supernatant again.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: •	 磁珠乙醇漂洗应使用新鲜配制并平衡至室温的80% 乙醇。漂洗过程中离心管应始终置于磁力架上，移液器吸头应在远离磁力架的管壁上操作，请勿吸打、搅动磁珠。
en: Use freshly prepared 80% ethanol equilibrated to room temperature for the magnetic bead ethanol wash. Keep the tube on the magnetic rack throughout the washing process. Operate the pipette tip against the wall of the tube away from the magnetic rack, and do not pipet up and down or disturb the magnetic beads.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: •	 第二次乙醇漂洗应尽量吸干管底液体。若有少量液体残留在管壁，可将离心管瞬时离心，在磁力架上分离后，用小量程的移液器把管底液体吸干。
en: Remove as much liquid as possible from the bottom of the tube after the second ethanol wash. If a small amount of liquid remains on the tube wall, briefly spin down the tube, separate on the magnetic rack, and use a low-volume pipette to aspirate the liquid from the bottom of the tube.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: •	 两次乙醇漂洗后，应在室温下充分干燥磁珠。干燥不充分（磁珠表面反光）容易造成乙醇残留，影响后续反应，过度干燥（磁珠开裂）会降低回收得率。通常情况下，室温干燥需要5-10 min，但由于室内温度和湿度的差异，干燥时间可能会不同，应随时观察。直至磁珠表面无反光，即可用TE Buffer 或 Nuclease-Free Water 进行产物洗脱。
en: After two ethanol washes, the magnetic beads should be thoroughly dried at room temperature. Insufficient drying (where the bead surface still reflects light) can easily cause residual ethanol, which may affect subsequent reactions; however, over-drying (where the beads crack) will reduce the recovery yield. Typically, room temperature drying takes 5-10 minutes, but this time may vary depending on indoor temperature and humidity, so you should monitor the beads constantly. Once the bead surface no longer reflects light, the product can be eluted with TE Buffer or Nuclease-Free Water.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: •	 洗脱后吸取上清时，切忌触碰磁珠，若吸到磁珠可能会影响后续的纯化反应。所以，最终吸取的上清可比用于洗脱的TE Buffer 或 Nuclease-Free Water 的体积少~2 μL。
en: • When aspirating the supernatant after elution, avoid disturbing the magnetic beads, as drawing them into the pipette tip may affect downstream purification reactions. Therefore, it is advisable to aspirate a volume of supernatant approximately 2 μL less than the volume of TE Buffer or Nuclease-Free Water used for elution.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: •	 在1.5 mL 磁力架上开关管盖应避免剧烈震动导致磁珠或液体弹出，建议用手指固定住1.5 mL 离心管中下段，然后开盖。
en: • When opening or closing the tube cap while on the 1.5 mL magnetic stand, avoid vigorous movements that could cause the magnetic beads or liquid to splash out. It is recommended to hold the middle to lower part of the 1.5 mL centrifuge tube firmly with your fingers while opening the cap.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: a.  cDNA 回收液如果观察到有白色沉淀析出，可放于 55℃溶解，恢复至室温后进行纯化。提前 30 min 取出磁珠， 平衡至室温；
en: a. If white precipitate is observed in the cDNA recovery solution, it can be dissolved at 55°C and purified after returning to room temperature. Take out the magnetic beads 30 minutes in advance and equilibrate to room temperature;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: b.  1X 磁珠cDNA 纯化步骤;
en: b. 1X magnetic bead cDNA purification steps;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 1）将上一步回收液（450-490 μL）与室温平衡好的磁珠按照1 : 1 混合，震荡混匀，室温孵育10 min；
en: 1) Mix the recovery solution from the previous step (450-490 μL) with the magnetic beads equilibrated to room temperature at a 1:1 ratio, vortex to mix, and incubate at room temperature for 10 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 2）瞬时离心后，将离心管放在磁力架上静置3 min；
en: 2) Briefly centrifuge, then place the centrifuge tube on a magnetic stand and let it stand for 3 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 3）待液体澄清后，用移液器小心去除上清（如果管盖上有泡沫，吸弃泡沫）；
en: 3) After the liquid clears, carefully remove the supernatant with a pipette (if there is foam on the tube lid, aspirate and discard it);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 4）将离心管保持在磁力架上，加入1 mL 80% 乙醇（使用新鲜配制并平衡至室温的80% 乙醇），旋转磁力架上的离心管，待磁珠全部吸附到靠磁力架一侧的管壁，再次旋离心管，让磁珠重新吸附到另一侧来漂洗磁珠。静置30 s，小心吸取并丢弃上清;
en: 4) While keeping the centrifuge tube on the magnetic stand, add 1 mL of 80% ethanol (use freshly prepared 80% ethanol equilibrated to room temperature). Rotate the centrifuge tube on the magnetic stand; once all magnetic beads have adsorbed to the side of the tube wall against the magnetic stand, rotate the tube again to allow the magnetic beads to re-adsorb to the other side to wash the beads. Let stand for 30 s, then carefully aspirate and discard the supernatant;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 5）重复一次步骤4）；
en: 5) Repeat step 4 once;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 6）将离心管保持在磁力架上，室温风干5-8 min，直至磁珠表面无反光、无开裂；
en: 6) Keep the centrifuge tube on the magnetic rack and air-dry at room temperature for 5-8 minutes until the surface of the magnetic beads is non-reflective and crack-free;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 7）先加22 μL Nuclease-Free Water 回溶，震荡混匀后室温静置5 min，瞬时离心，磁力架静置 3-5 min，直至液体变澄清；
en: 7) Add 22 μL of Nuclease-Free Water to resuspend, vortex to mix, incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes, spin down briefly, and place on a magnetic rack for 3-5 minutes until the liquid becomes clear;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 8）将上清（~21 μL cDNA）转移至新的0.2 mL PCR 管中；
en: 8) Transfer the supernatant (~21 μL cDNA) to a new 0.2 mL PCR tube;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 9）再将 22 μL Nuclease-Free Water 加入步骤7 的磁珠中二次回溶，震荡混匀后室温静置 5 min，瞬时离心，磁力架静置 3-5 min，直至液体变澄清；
en: 9) Add 22 μL of Nuclease-Free Water to the magnetic beads from step 7 for a second elution, vortex to mix, incubate at room temperature for 5 min, briefly centrifuge, and place on a magnetic stand for 3-5 min until the liquid becomes clear;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 10）将上清（~21 μL cDNA）转移至步骤8 的 PCR 管中，合并总体积~42 μL。
en: 10) Transfer the supernatant (~21 μL cDNA) to the PCR tube from step 8, combining for a total volume of ~42 μL.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 移液器吸头应在远离磁力架的管壁上操作，请勿吸打、搅动磁珠（如果管盖上有泡沫，建议用 80%乙醇清洗干净）。
en: The pipette tip should be operated against the side of the tube away from the magnetic rack. Do not pipette up and down or agitate the magnetic beads (if foam is present on the tube cap, it is recommended to clean it with 80% ethanol).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: c.  如果上述回收样品不足42 μL，用Nuclease-Free Water 补足。
en: c. If the volume of the recovered sample is less than 42 µL, bring the volume up to 42 µL with Nuclease-Free Water.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 收集了洗脱的cDNA 后，可用40 µL Nuclease-free Water 在4℃保存磁珠，直至cDNA 最终产品QC 通过。
en: After collecting the eluted cDNA, store the magnetic beads in 40 µL of Nuclease-free Water at 4°C until the final cDNA product passes QC.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: e.  对PCR 产物进行 1X 磁珠纯化：
en: e. Perform 1X magnetic bead purification on PCR products:
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 1）将PCR 产物（100 μL）与室温平衡好的磁珠按照1 : 1 混合，震荡混匀，室温孵育10 min；
en: 1) Mix the PCR product (100 μL) with magnetic beads equilibrated to room temperature at a 1:1 ratio, shake to mix, and incubate at room temperature for 10 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 2）瞬时离心后，将PCR 管放在磁力架上静置3 min，待液体澄清后去除上清；
en: 2) After brief centrifugation, place the PCR tube on a magnetic stand and let it stand for 3 minutes until the liquid becomes clear, then remove the supernatant;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 3）将离心管保持在磁力架上，加入200 μL 80% 乙醇漂洗（新鲜配制并平衡至室温的80% 乙醇）。通过旋转磁力架上的离心管来漂洗磁珠。静置30 s，小心吸取并丢弃上清。移液器吸头应在远离磁力架的管壁上操作，请勿吸打、搅动磁珠；
en: 3) Keep the centrifuge tube on the magnetic stand and add 200 μL of 80% ethanol (freshly prepared and equilibrated to room temperature) to wash. Wash the magnetic beads by rotating the centrifuge tube on the magnetic stand. Let it stand for 30 seconds, then carefully aspirate and discard the supernatant. The pipette tip should be operated against the tube wall away from the magnetic stand; do not pipette up and down or disturb the magnetic beads;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 4）重复一次步骤3；
en: 4) Repeat step 3 once;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 5）将离心管保持在磁力架上，打开盖子，室温风干5-8 min，直至磁珠表面无反光、无开裂；
en: 5) Keep the centrifuge tube on the magnetic stand, open the lid, and air-dry at room temperature for 5-8 min until the surface of the magnetic beads is no longer reflective or cracked;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 6）加42 μL 的TE Buffer 回溶，震荡混匀后室温静置5 min，瞬时离心，磁力架静置3-5 min，待液体澄清后将上清（~40 μL）转移到新的1.5 mL离心管中。
en: 6) Add 42 μL of TE Buffer to resuspend, mix by vortexing, then incubate at room temperature for 5 min. Centrifuge briefly, place on the magnetic stand for 3-5 min, and once the liquid is clear, transfer the supernatant (~40 μL) to a new 1.5 mL centrifuge tube.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: f.  取1 μL cDNA 样品，用Qubit dsDNA HS Kit 检测浓度并记录；
en: f. Take 1 μL of the cDNA sample, measure the concentration using the Qubit dsDNA HS Kit, and record the result;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: g.  通过Bioanalyzer、Tapestation (Agilent Technologies)、LabChip® GX、GXII、GX Touch(PerkinElmer)、Fragment AnalyzerTM (Advanced Analytical) 等基于电泳分离原理的设备对cDNA 片段分布进行检测。
en: g. Analyze the cDNA fragment distribution using electrophoretic separation-based instruments, such as Bioanalyzer, Tapestation (Agilent Technologies), LabChip® GX, GXII, GX Touch (PerkinElmer), or Fragment Analyzer™ (Advanced Analytical).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: 纯化后，可用40 µL Nuclease-free Water 在4℃保存磁珠，直至cDNA 最终产物QC 通过。
en: After purification, the beads can be stored in 40 µL of Nuclease-free Water at 4°C until the final cDNA product passes QC.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

en: •	 The purified cDNA product can be stored at −20°C for 1 month.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版兼容_H&E）使用说明书-A

zh: STOmics® Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版）是用于构建组织切片全转录本 3'端文库的试剂套装。本试剂套装采用的 Stereo-seq 时空转录组技术，是一种基于DNBSEQ 高通量测序技术开发的、具有高分辨大视场特点的原位全转录组信息捕获技术。Stereo-seq 芯片 T（时空 poly-T 芯片）上载有具有空间坐标信息的捕获探针，与组织切片结合后通过探针原位抓取组织内的mRNA 分子并进行cDNA 合成。研究人员通过DNBSEQ 测序和STOmics® 配套的可视化分析工具，可获取特定样本超高分辨率下的空间转录组信息。
en: The STOmics® Stereo-seq Transcriptomics Reagent Kit (Slide Version) is a reagent kit designed for constructing whole-transcriptome 3' libraries from tissue sections. The Stereo-seq spatial transcriptomics technology utilized in this kit is an in situ whole-transcriptome information capture technology characterized by high resolution and a large field-of-view, developed based on DNBSEQ high-throughput sequencing technology. Stereo-seq Chip T (spatial poly-T chip) is loaded with capture probes containing spatial coordinate information. After binding to tissue sections, these probes capture mRNA molecules within the tissue in situ for subsequent cDNA synthesis. Researchers can obtain spatial transcriptomics information of specific samples at ultra-high resolution through DNBSEQ sequencing and STOmics® proprietary visualization and analysis tools.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 本试剂套装中提供的所有试剂都经过严格的质量控制和功能验证，最大程度上保证了文库制备的稳定性和重复性。
en: All reagents provided in this kit have undergone rigorous quality control and functional validation, ensuring the stability and reproducibility of library preparation to the greatest extent possible.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 使用本产品构建的测序文库可使用DNBSEQ 测序平台进行测序。详情请参考《Stereo-seq 建库试剂盒使用说明书》。
en: Sequencing libraries constructed using this product can be sequenced on the DNBSEQ sequencing platform. For more details, please refer to the Stereo-seq Library Preparation Kit User Manual.
