zh: Stereo-seq 芯片P/T 载体装于真空密封的铝袋中，冷链运输。收到产品后须立即将未开封的Stereo-seq 芯片P/T 载体储存在−20℃或4℃。若拆袋后未使用，需重新干燥密封并储存在−20℃或4℃。
en: Stereo-seq Chip P/T carriers are packed in vacuum-sealed aluminum bags and transported via cold chain. Upon receipt, unopened Stereo-seq Chip P/T carriers must be stored immediately at −20°C or 4°C. If the bag has been opened and the product is unused, it must be re-dried, sealed, and stored at −20°C or 4°C.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 需在铝制密封袋中放入干燥剂以保持干燥条件。重新密封的芯片不可放置超过两周。
en: Place a desiccant in the aluminum sealed bag to maintain dry conditions. Resealed chips must not be stored for more than two weeks.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书
en: Stereo-seq Transcriptomics Reagent Kit (Chip version) User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a.  从Stereo-seq 载体配件包中取出夹具和垫圈；
en: a. Remove the clamp and gasket from the Stereo-seq Chip Accessory Kit;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: b.  夹具反面朝上，将垫圈插入夹具中，确保夹具和垫圈的孔位切口对齐。按压垫圈，使垫圈和夹具契合在一起；
en: b. With the reverse side of the fixture facing up, insert the gasket into the fixture, ensuring that the hole cutouts of the fixture and the gasket are aligned. Press down on the gasket to ensure it fits securely into the fixture;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: c.  用手指微调垫圈边缘位置，使垫圈与夹具更紧密地契合；
en: c. Use your fingers to slightly adjust the position of the gasket edges for a tighter fit between the gasket and the fixture;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: d.  使用空气罐尽可能地吹去表面的杂质或碎屑；
en: d. Use canned air to blow away as much surface impurity or debris as possible;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: e.   拿起Stereo-seq 芯片载体，芯片面朝下，将芯片载体标签朝夹具的长边卡扣方向；
en: e. Pick up the Stereo-seq chip slide, chip facing down, and orient the chip slide label towards the long side clip of the fixture;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 组装方法视频参考网址:    https://www.stomics.tech/col113/607
en: Video reference for assembly method: https://www.stomics.tech/col113/607
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书
en: Stereo-seq Transcriptome Reagent Kit (Slide version) Instruction Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: h.  沿着夹具卡带两侧按压，确保夹具与芯片载体稳固组装在一起；
en: h. Press along both sides of the fixture cassette to ensure the fixture is securely assembled with the chip slide;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: i.  最后检查组装好的夹具和芯片载体，确保位置正确。
en: i. Finally, inspect the assembled fixture and chip slide to ensure they are correctly positioned.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: g.  先将芯片载体卡进夹具下方4 个卡扣。双手中指支撑夹具的正面，左手拇指放在tab 1 和tab 2 之间，右手拇指放在tab 3 和tab 4 之间，拇指匀力向下按压芯片载体，直至听到“咔”的一声。双手食指用力向下按压夹具顶部边缘，将载体卡进夹具上方4 个卡扣;
en: g. First, snap the chip slide into the 4 clips at the bottom of the fixture. Support the front of the fixture with the middle fingers of both hands, place the left thumb between tab 1 and tab 2, and place the right thumb between tab 3 and tab 4. Press down on the chip slide with the thumbs using even force until a "click" sound is heard. Press down firmly on the top edge of the fixture with the index fingers of both hands to snap the carrier into the 4 clips at the top of the fixture;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: f.  芯片对准垫圈孔位，避免夹具和垫圈接触芯片表面；
en: f. Align the chip with the gasket hole to avoid contact between the fixture and gasket with the chip surface;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: •	 本产品仅适用于科研用途，不可用于临床诊断，使用前请仔细阅读本说明书。
en: • This product is intended for research use only and cannot be used for clinical diagnosis. Please read this manual carefully before use.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: •	 实验前请熟悉需使用的各种仪器的注意事项并掌握其操作方法。
en: • Please familiarize yourself with the precautions and master the operation methods of all instruments to be used before the experiment.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: •	 本说明书提供的实验流程是通用的，实际操作中可根据具体的实验设计、样本特征、测序应用和设备进行实验流程、反应参数的调整，以优化性能和效率。
en: • The experimental procedures provided in this manual are general. In actual operation, the experimental procedures and reaction parameters can be adjusted according to specific experimental designs, sample characteristics, sequencing applications, and equipment to optimize performance and efficiency.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: •	 推荐使用前将各试剂组分提前取出，将酶类组分瞬时离心后置于冰上备用，并将其他组分置于室温解冻。解冻后轻柔地上下颠倒数次使其充分混匀，瞬时离心后置于冰上备用。
en: It is recommended to take out the reagent components in advance. Briefly centrifuge the enzyme components and keep them on ice, while thawing the other components at room temperature. After thawing, gently invert the tubes several times to mix thoroughly, then briefly centrifuge and keep them on ice before use.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: •	 为避免样本交叉污染，推荐使用带滤芯的吸头，吸取不同样本时请更换吸头。
en: To avoid sample cross-contamination, it is recommended to use filter tips and to change the tip when pipetting different samples.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: •	 推荐把PCR 仪温度预热至反应温度。
en: It is recommended to preheat the PCR thermal cycler to the reaction temperature.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: •	 应避免皮肤和眼睛直接接触样本及试剂，切勿吞咽样本及试剂，一旦发生意外请立即用大量清水冲洗并及时就医。
en: • Avoid direct contact of samples and reagents with skin and eyes. Do not swallow samples or reagents. In case of accidental contact, rinse immediately with plenty of water and seek medical attention promptly.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: •	 所有样本和各种废弃物均应按相关法规规定处理。
en: • All samples and various types of waste should be disposed of in accordance with relevant regulations.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a.  将夹具翻转过来，用力按压夹具上方卡带，使芯片载体从夹具中脱离。用大拇指稍微挡住载体背面，避免载体弹出；

zh: 为保证样本质量，降低实验风险，建议切取10-20 片10 μm 厚的组织片，存放至−20℃下预冷的1.5 mL EP 管中，然后进行Total RNA 的提取和质量检测。
en: To ensure sample quality and reduce experimental risks, it is recommended to cut 10-20 sections, each 10 μm thick, store them in a 1.5 mL EP tube pre-cooled at −20°C, and then perform total RNA extraction and quality control.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 强烈建议只对RIN ≥7 的组织样本进行后续实验操作。
en: It is strongly recommended to proceed with subsequent experimental operations only on tissue samples with RIN ≥7.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 实验室条件下严格保证新鲜样本在离体30 min 内进行直接包埋处理，以最大程度避免组织内部RNA 降解。
en: Under laboratory conditions, strictly ensure that fresh samples are directly embedded within 30 minutes of excision to minimize RNA degradation within the tissue.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 组织尺寸不应超过 0.9 cm × 0.9 cm × 2 cm，组织切片/ 芯片面积不应超过80%。
en: The tissue size should not exceed 0.9 cm × 0.9 cm × 2 cm, and the area of the tissue section/chip should not exceed 80%.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

en: 2. Sample Preparation Stereo-seq Transcriptomics Reagent Kit (Chip Version) User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a1. 提前准备一泡沫箱碎冰并将OCT 放在冰上预冷10 min；
en: a1. Prepare a foam box of crushed ice in advance and place the OCT on the ice to pre-chill for 10 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a2. 根据组织大小提前准备两个合适大小的金属包埋盒A 和B（B 的尺寸需略大于A）；
en: a2. Prepare two metal embedding cassettes of appropriate sizes, A and B (the dimensions of B should be slightly larger than those of A), in advance according to the size of the tissue.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a5. 准备一泡沫箱干冰；
en: a5. Prepare a foam box of dry ice.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a6. 准备具有平整面的金属块，金属块面积需大于金属包埋盒A，用于平放金属包埋盒；
en: a6. Prepare a metal block with a flat surface, the area of which must be larger than that of metal embedding cassette A, to be used for placing the metal embedding cassette flat.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a3. 提前将预冷好的OCT 填充金属包埋盒A 的2/3 左右，并放置在冰上预冷10 min 以上（可使用注射器吸弃产生的气泡）；
en: a3. In advance, fill approximately 2/3 of the metal embedding mold A with pre-cooled OCT, and place it on ice to pre-cool for at least 10 minutes (a syringe can be used to remove any air bubbles generated);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a4. 在平皿中加满OCT，提前预冷10 min（可使用注射器吸弃产生的气泡）；
en: a4. Fill the petri dish with OCT and pre-cool for 10 minutes (a syringe can be used to aspirate any air bubbles that form);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a7. 将金属块平整面向上放置到干冰中，预冷5 min 以上；a8. 将金属包埋盒B 放置于干冰中预冷5 min 以上。
en: a7. Place the metal block into dry ice with the flat surface facing up and pre-cool for at least 5 minutes; a8. Place the metal embedding mold B into dry ice and pre-cool for at least 5 minutes.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: b.  新鲜组织离体30 min 内，用无菌无纺布或无尘纸擦干组织表面液体，以避免在组织表面形成冰块，影响后续包埋切片；
en: b. Within 30 min of tissue excision, blot the liquid on the tissue surface dry using sterile non-woven fabric or dust-free paper to avoid the formation of ice crystals on the tissue surface, which affects subsequent embedding and sectioning;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 2. 样本准备Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书
en: 2. Sample Preparation Stereo-seq Transcriptomics Reagent Kit (Carrier version) Instruction Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: c.  将组织放入在冰上预冷的OCT 中，在不产生气泡的前提下用药匙使组织被OCT 包裹（可使用注射器吸弃产生的气泡）；
en: Place the tissue into OCT that has been pre-cooled on ice, and use a spatula to ensure the tissue is covered by OCT without creating air bubbles (a syringe can be used to aspirate any generated air bubbles);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: d.  将组织的拟切面朝下，放入冰上预冷的金属包埋盒A 中，使组织接触到金属包埋盒A 的底部。在不产生气泡的前提下用预冷的 OCT 填满金属包埋盒A，直至将组织完全覆盖（可使用注射器吸弃产生的气泡）；
en: Place the tissue with the intended cutting surface facing down into the ice-precooled metal embedding mold A, ensuring the tissue makes contact with the bottom of the mold. Fill the metal embedding mold A with pre-cooled OCT without creating air bubbles until the tissue is completely covered (a syringe can be used to aspirate any generated air bubbles);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: e.  将装有组织的金属包埋盒A，水平放置在干冰预冷的金属块上；
en: Place the metal embedding mold A containing the tissue horizontally onto a metal block pre-cooled with dry ice;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: f.  预冷的金属包埋盒B（作为盖子）开口向上，轻轻加盖于装有组织块的金属包埋盒A 上方，并在其开口中放置碎干冰，使干冰尽可能充分覆盖金属包埋盒表面，形成较为封闭的速冻空间；
en: f. Place the pre-cooled metal embedding cassette B (as a lid) with its opening facing upward gently on top of the metal embedding cassette A containing the tissue block, and place crushed dry ice into its opening, so that the dry ice covers the surface of the metal embedding cassette as fully as possible to form a relatively enclosed rapid-freezing space;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 2. 样本准备Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书
en: 2. Sample Preparation Stereo-seq Transcriptomics Reagent Kit (Slide Version) User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: g.  冷冻5 min 后，移去金属包埋盒B，检查OCT 是否完全凝固且变成白色不透明状, 若未完全冷冻好，则重复f；
en: g. After freezing for 5 min, remove metal embedding mold B and check if the OCT is completely solidified and has turned white and opaque; if not fully frozen, repeat step f.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: h.  如果组织块完全凝固并变成白色不透明状，用手轻掰金属包埋盒A 两侧，即可使OCT 包埋组织块从金属包埋盒A中脱模；
en: h. If the tissue block is completely solidified and has turned white and opaque, gently flex both sides of metal embedding mold A with your hands to release the OCT-embedded tissue block from the mold.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: i.  检查包埋块底部是否被完全覆盖, 如未完全覆盖，则将组织块放置在金属块上，底部向上，在表面涂上少量OCT，待OCT 完全凝固且不透明，在包埋块切面位置做好标记。
en: i. Check if the bottom of the embedding block is completely covered; if not, place the tissue block on a metal block with the bottom facing up, apply a small amount of OCT to the surface, wait until the OCT is completely solidified and opaque, and mark the cutting face of the embedding block.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 将组织包埋块使用锡纸包裹，并做好标记放入自封袋，在自封袋上做好记录，放入−80℃冰箱长期保存。如需邮寄，可选干冰邮寄。
en: Wrap the tissue embedding blocks with aluminum foil, label them, place them into a self-sealing bag, record the information on the bag, and store them in a -80°C freezer for long-term preservation. If shipping is required, dry ice can be used for transport.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 3. 操作流程Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书
en: 3. Operational Procedure: Stereo-seq Transcriptomics Reagent Kit (Chip version) User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 本实验用于稀释试剂的液体，除特殊说明外，均使用Nuclease - Free Water。
en: Unless otherwise specified, Nuclease-Free Water is used for all liquids used to dilute reagents in this experiment.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 准备试剂准备流程  保存条件
en: Reagent Preparation Workflow  Storage Conditions
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 5X SSC取20X SSC 5 mL 稀释到20 mL   室温
en: 5X SSC: Take 5 mL of 20X SSC and dilute to 20 mL.  Room temperature.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 0.1X SSC 取20X SSC 100 μL 稀释到20 mL取20X SSC 250 μL 稀释到50 mL    室温
en: 0.1X SSC: Take 100 μL of 20X SSC and dilute to 20 mL, or take 250 μL of 20X SSC and dilute to 50 mL.  Room temperature.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: Wash Buffer取5 μL RI 加入95 μL 0.1X SSC 中，用量至少为100 μL/ 芯片 冰上备用
en: For the Wash Buffer, take 5 μL of RI and add it to 95 μL of 0.1X SSC; use at least 100 μL per chip and keep on ice for use.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 0.01N HCl按照HCl 浓度梯度稀释到0.01N，pH 值准确到2（确保pH 值在1.9-2.1 范围内；至少2 mL/ 样本）   室温48 hr
en: Dilute the HCl to 0.01N to prepare 0.01N HCl, ensuring an accurate pH of 2 (pH range 1.9–2.1; at least 2 mL per sample); store at room temperature for 48 hours.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 0.01N HCl (pH = 2.0 ) 需现配现用。对于预制的0.1N HCl 和新购买的HCl，实验前请检查pH 值。
en: 0.01N HCl (pH = 2.0) must be prepared freshly before use. For pre-prepared 0.1N HCl and newly purchased HCl, please check the pH value before the experiment.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 储存时间超过48 hr 将影响预期pH 值，请在配制后48 hr 内使用。
en: Storage for more than 48 hours will affect the expected pH value; please use within 48 hours of preparation.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 10X 透化试剂储存液用1 mL 新鲜配制的0.01N HCl 将PR Enzyme（红盖，粉末状）溶解后，通过移液器吹打混匀（可分装成若干份）  −20℃
en: To prepare the 10X Permeabilization Reagent stock, dissolve the PR Enzyme (red cap, powder) with 1 mL of freshly prepared 0.01N HCl and mix by pipetting (it can be aliquoted into smaller portions and stored at −20°C).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 不要涡旋透化酶，可通过移液器吹打混匀。建议对配制好的10X 透化试剂储存液进行分装，避免反复冻融。
en: Do not vortex the permeabilization enzyme; mix by pipetting instead. It is recommended to aliquot the prepared 10X Permeabilization Reagent stock to avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 1X 透化试剂工作液用0.01N HCl 将10X 透化试剂储存液 15 μL 稀释到150 μL（至少150 μL/ 芯片）   冰上备用6 hr
en: 1X Permeabilization Reagent Working Solution: Dilute 15 μL of 10X Permeabilization Reagent Stock Solution to 150 μL with 0.01N HCl (at least 150 μL per chip). Keep on ice and use within 6 hr.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: RT Oligo短暂离心，加入79 μL TE buffer 重悬。盖紧盖子后最大速度涡旋15 s，然后短暂离心−80℃
en: Briefly centrifuge the RT Oligo, and add 79 μL of TE buffer to resuspend. Cap tightly, vortex at maximum speed for 15 s, then briefly centrifuge. Store at −80℃.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 可分装未使用的RT Oligo，并保存于−80℃，以避免反复冻融。
en: Unused RT Oligo can be aliquoted and stored at −80℃ to avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: Glycerol使用前，至少提前 5 min 取出，平衡至室温室温
en: Take out Glycerol at least 5 minutes before use and equilibrate to room temperature.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: PR Rinse Buffer（含5% RI）
en: PR Rinse Buffer (containing 5% RI)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 每张芯片至少准备 200 μL（190 μL PR Rinse Buffer + 10 μL RI）。配制后置于冰上备用，使用前室温平衡 5 min
en: Prepare at least 200 μL for each chip (190 μL PR Rinse Buffer + 10 μL RI). Keep on ice after preparation and equilibrate at room temperature for 5 minutes before use.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 冰上备用，使用前室温平衡5 min
en: Keep on ice; equilibrate to room temperature for 5 min before use.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 3. 操作流程Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书
en: 3. Operation Workflow for Stereo-seq Transcriptome Reagent Kit (Carrier Version) User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 准备仪器准备流程备注
en: Instrument preparation procedure notes
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 按顺序依次设定：
en: Configure in order:
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 37℃用于烤片和透化（热盖42℃）
en: 37°C for slide baking and permeabilization (heated lid 42°C)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 42℃用于反转录（热盖47℃）
en: 42°C for reverse transcription (heated lid 47°C)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 55℃用于组织移除（热盖60℃）
en: 55°C for tissue removal (heated lid 60°C)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 检查PCR 仪是否有异常，必要时更换
en: Check the PCR instrument for any abnormalities; replace if necessary.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 金属浴37℃用于透化酶预热-
en: Dry bath at 37°C for preheating the permeabilizing enzyme-
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 荧光显微镜  FITC 通道-
en: Fluorescence microscope, FITC channel-
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 准备试剂准备流程  保存条件
en: Reagent preparation procedure Storage conditions
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 80% 乙醇无水乙醇稀释到80%   室温1 天
en: 80% Ethanol (dilute absolute ethanol to 80%) Room temperature for 1 day
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 磁珠 提前取出，室温放置30 min 平衡    4℃
en: Magnetic beads Remove in advance, place at room temperature for 30 min to equilibrate 4℃
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a. 提前将PCR 仪温度设置到37℃，热盖温度为42℃，放置PCR 适配器平衡温度；
en: a. Set the PCR instrument temperature to 37°C and the lid temperature to 42°C in advance, and place the PCR adapter to equilibrate the temperature;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: b. 冷冻切片机箱体预冷至−20℃，样本头预冷至−15℃~ −10℃（根据实际操作过程调整）；
en: b. Pre-cool the cryostat chamber to −20°C and the specimen head to −15°C to −10°C (adjust according to the actual operation process);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: c. 提前将毛刷、刀片和镊子等置于箱体预冷；
en: c. Place brushes, blades, tweezers, and other tools in the chamber in advance to pre-cool;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: d. 将OCT 包埋的组织块从−80℃冰箱取出，放在冷冻切片机内平衡30 min；
en: d. Remove the OCT-embedded tissue block from the -80°C freezer and equilibrate it in the cryostat for 30 minutes;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: e. 使用OCT 将组织块固定到样品托上；
en: e. Mount the tissue block onto the specimen holder using OCT;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: f. 将组织块修剪成合适的尺寸（切面小于 0.9 cm × 0.9 cm），切去组织块周围过多的OCT，保留一部分OCT，方便转移组织；
en: f. Trim the tissue block to an appropriate size (cross-section smaller than 0.9 cm × 0.9 cm), remove excess OCT around the tissue block, and leave a portion of OCT to facilitate tissue transfer;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: g. 根据需要对组织块做最后地修剪，以确保组织切片能更好地适配芯片，随后可进行冷冻切片。
en: g. Trim the tissue block as necessary to ensure the tissue section properly fits the chip, then proceed with frozen sectioning.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 样本头温度过低会导致切片出现裂纹，样本头温度过高会导致切片出现褶皱，请根据样本情况将冻头调
en: If the specimen chuck temperature is too low, it will cause cracks in the sections; if the temperature is too high, it will cause folds. Please adjust the
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 样本头温度过低会导致切片出现裂纹，样本头温度过高会导致切片出现褶皱，请根据样本情况将冻头调
en: Too low a specimen head temperature will cause cracks in the sections, while too high a specimen head temperature will cause wrinkles; please adjust the freezing head
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 3. 操作流程Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书
en: 3. Operation Workflow: User Manual for Stereo-seq Transcriptomics Reagent Kit (Chip Version)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a. 取芯片：从真空干燥铝箔袋中取出 Stereo-seq 芯片T 载体，记录芯片背面的编号；注意不要触碰芯片正面；
en: a. Take out the chip: Remove the Stereo-seq chip T-carrier from the vacuum-dried aluminum foil bag, and record the serial number on the back of the chip; be careful not to touch the front side of the chip;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: b. 将载体置于桌面上复温1 min，观察芯片表面是否有杂质，如芯片上存在杂质，使用100 μL Nuclease-Free Water 清洗2 次（或在含40-50 mL NF water 的离心管中清洗2 次 )；
en: b. Place the carrier on the desktop to equilibrate to room temperature for 1 min, and observe if there are any impurities on the chip surface. If there are impurities on the chip, wash it 2 times with 100 μL Nuclease-Free Water (or wash 2 times in a centrifuge tube containing 40-50 mL NF water);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 打开后，请检查玻片盒中的所有的 Stereo-seq 芯片载体是否正确定位在插槽中，载体上的芯片是否正面
en: After opening, please check whether all Stereo-seq chip slides in the slide box are correctly positioned in the slots, and whether the chips on the carriers are facing up.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 朝上。芯片的正面为亮光面，正面含有用于 mRNA 捕获的探针。请勿触碰到芯片表面。
en: Face up. The front of the chip is the glossy side and contains probes for mRNA capture. Do not touch the chip surface.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: c. 清洗后用气瓶吹干芯片四周及表面，再用无尘纸吸干载玻片背面和周围多余的液体；
en: c. After washing, use a gas duster to blow dry the perimeter and surface of the chip, then use lint-free paper to absorb excess liquid from the back and around the slide;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: d. 当芯片表面无杂质、无明显痕迹、无任何液体残留、无波纹状纹理，即可准备贴片；
en: d. Once the chip surface is free of impurities, visible marks, liquid residue, and ripple-like textures, it is ready for mounting;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: e. 预冷甲醇：在玻片盒或50 mL 离心管中加入足量甲醇，确保甲醇足够浸没所有芯片（可将一张普通载玻片放入容器中，查看甲醇的体积是否足够）。扣紧盖子，提前放入切片机中（−20℃）预冷5-30 min；
en: e. Pre-cool methanol: Add sufficient methanol to a slide box or 50 mL centrifuge tube, ensuring enough methanol to submerge all chips (a regular glass slide can be placed into the container to verify that the methanol volume is adequate). Secure the cap tightly and pre-cool in the cryostat (-20°C) for 5-30 min beforehand.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: f. 将组织包埋块固定至冻头上，修片；
en: f. Secure the tissue embedding block onto the cryostat chuck and trim the block.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: g. 组织贴片有两种操作方式可选：热贴（A）和冷贴（B）。根据需求选择切片厚度，通常为10 μm。
en: g. There are two optional methods for mounting tissue sections: warm mounting (A) and cold mounting (B). Choose the section thickness based on requirements, usually 10 μm.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 1）连续切取组织切片，将切片移到切片台右侧靠近边缘处，然后用预冷的毛刷轻轻拨动切片周围的OCT 使切片铺平，每张切片放置间隔距离大于载体宽度；
en: 1) Continuously cut tissue sections, move the sections to the right side of the cryostat stage near the edge, then use a pre-cooled brush to gently manipulate the OCT around the sections to flatten them, ensuring the spacing between each section is greater than the width of the carrier;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 2）拿起载体的一边，使芯片正面朝下，对准切片；
en: 2) Pick up one side of the carrier, face the chip side down, and align it with the section;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 3）轻轻一压，肉眼可见切片已经吸附到芯片表面；
en: 3) Press gently, and the tissue section will be visibly adsorbed onto the chip surface;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 4）重复 2）-3）步骤操作，直至全部组织切片吸附到芯片表面（贴片时间控制在1 min 以内）；
en: 4) Repeat steps 2)-3) until all tissue sections are adsorbed onto the chip surface (the mounting time should be kept within 1 min);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 5）将芯片正面朝上，快速将载体置于提前平衡温度的PCR 适配器上，37℃孵育5 min，无需盖PCR 热盖。
en: 5) Place the chip face up, quickly place the carrier onto a pre-equilibrated PCR adapter, and incubate at 37°C for 5 min; it is not necessary to close the PCR thermal lid.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 3. 操作流程Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书
en: 3. Operational Procedures for Stereo-seq Transcriptomics Reagent Kit (Array Version) User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 固定期间可参考表格3-1 提前配置组织荧光染色液，室温避光保存备用。
en: During the fixation period, refer to Table 3-1 to prepare the tissue fluorescent staining solution in advance, and store it at room temperature, protected from light, for later use.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a.	 载体孵育结束后，立即置于−20℃预冷的甲醇中，确保甲醇浸没载体上的所有芯片，固定30 min；
en: a. After the carrier incubation is complete, immediately place it in methanol pre-cooled to −20°C, ensuring that the methanol covers all chips on the carrier, and fix for 30 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: b.	 固定结束后，将玻片盒或50 mL 离心管转移至通风橱中；
en: b. After fixation is complete, transfer the slide box or 50 mL centrifuge tube to a fume hood;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: c.	 将载体从玻片盒或50 mL 离心管中取出，用无尘纸吸干载玻片背面和周围多余的甲醇，确保无液体残留；
en: c. Remove the carrier from the slide box or 50 mL centrifuge tube, and use lint-free paper to blot away excess methanol from the back and surroundings of the slide, ensuring no liquid residue remains;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: d.	 将载体竖立放在载玻片染色架上，置于通风橱中晾干4-6 min，让甲醇充分挥发；
en: d. Place the carrier upright on a slide staining rack and air-dry it in a fume hood for 4-6 min to ensure the methanol evaporates completely;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: e.	 甲醇挥发完全后，肉眼可见组织变白，将载体转移至实验台上进行下一步。
en: e. Once the methanol has completely evaporated, the tissue will be visibly white; transfer the carrier to the laboratory bench for the next step.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

en: Component 1X (µL) 2X + 10% (µL) 3X + 10% (µL) 4X + 10% (µL)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D
Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: Qubit ssDNA Reagent 0.51.11.62.2
en: Qubit ssDNA Reagent 0.5 1.1 1.6 2.2
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 表格3-1  组织荧光染色液
en: Table 3-1 Tissue Fluorescent Staining Solution
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 1)  将玻片正面朝上置于切片机中，预冷1-6 min；
en: 1) Place the glass slide face up in the cryostat and pre-cool for 1-6 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 2）进行冷冻切片，然后用预冷的毛刷轻轻拨动切片周围的OCT 使切片铺平。用镊子和毛刷将切片小心覆盖在芯片正中央并铺平，注意毛刷不要触碰到组织。尽量一次贴片成功，确保组织切片完整，无褶皱；
en: 2) Perform cryosectioning, then use a pre-cooled brush to gently manipulate the OCT around the section to flatten it. Carefully use tweezers and a brush to place the section in the exact center of the chip and flatten it, taking care that the brush does not touch the tissue. Try to mount the section successfully in one attempt, ensuring the tissue section is complete and free of wrinkles;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 3）立即拿起芯片载体，用指腹放在载体背面加温几秒钟，直至切片贴合；
en: 3) Immediately pick up the chip slide and warm the back of the carrier with your fingertip for a few seconds until the section adheres;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 4）重复上述操作，直至所有切片贴片完成，建议组织切片贴片控制在5 min 内；
en: 4) Repeat the above operation until all sections are mounted; it is recommended to complete the tissue section mounting within 5 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 5）快速将载体置于PCR 适配器上37℃孵育5 min，无需盖PCR 热盖。
en: 5) Quickly place the carrier on a PCR adapter and incubate at 37°C for 5 min; there is no need to close the PCR heated lid.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 预冷时间不可过长，以免玻片表面产生水雾；预冷时间不可太短，以免玻片无法达到预冷温度。
en: The pre-cooling time should not be too long to avoid water fog on the slide surface; nor should it be too short, as the slide might not reach the pre-cooling temperature.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 进行冷贴时需控制好每张切片贴片时间，间隔时间太大，组织贴片会皱缩。
en: When performing cold mounting, the mounting time for each section must be well-controlled; if the interval is too long, the tissue will shrink.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: （可选暂停点）将孵育好的芯片载体放于玻片盒或者50 mL 离心管，用干冰快速转移到−80℃冰箱，最长可于−80℃保存一个月。
en: (Optional stopping point) Place the incubated chip slide in a slide box or a 50 mL centrifuge tube, transfer it rapidly to a −80°C freezer using dry ice, and it can be stored at −80°C for up to one month.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 继续实验时，使用干冰将玻片盒或者50 mL 离心管转移，取出贴有组织的芯片载体，快速置于PCR 适配器上37℃孵育5 min。
en: Continue the experiment by using dry ice to transfer the slide box or 50 mL centrifuge tube; remove the chip slide with the attached tissue, and quickly place it on the PCR adapter to incubate at 37°C for 5 min.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 3. 操作流程Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书
en: 3. Operation Procedure Stereo-seq Transcriptomics Reagent Kit (Chip Version) Instruction Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a.	 将组织荧光染色液加到芯片上，用量为100 μL/ 芯片。先在芯片的每个角加入一滴染色液，然后将其余染色液加到芯片中央，使所有染色液融合，确保染色液均匀覆盖全芯片，室温避光染色5 min；
en: a. Add the tissue fluorescent staining solution to the chip at a volume of 100 μL/chip. First add one drop of the staining solution to each corner of the chip, then add the remaining solution to the center of the chip so that all the solution coalesces, ensuring the entire chip is evenly covered; stain at room temperature for 5 min in the dark.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: b.	 染色期间分别配置100 μL/ 芯片的Wash Buffer 和200 μL/ 芯片的PR Rinse Buffer（含5% RI）；
en: b. During the staining period, prepare 100 μL/chip of Wash Buffer and 200 μL/chip of PR Rinse Buffer (containing 5% RI), respectively.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: c.	 倾斜载体，用移液器从芯片一角吸去组织荧光染色液，尽量减少表面液体；
en: c. Tilt the carrier and use a pipette to aspirate the tissue fluorescent staining solution from one corner of the chip to minimize residual surface liquid.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: d.	 向芯片加入Wash Buffer，用量为100 μL/ 芯片；
en: d. Add 100 μL of Wash Buffer to the chip;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: e.	 倾斜载体，用移液器从芯片一角吸弃Wash Buffer，尽量减少表面液体；
en: e. Tilt the carrier, use a pipette to aspirate and discard the Wash Buffer from one corner of the chip, minimizing residual surface liquid;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: f.	将载体转移至无尘纸上，一手固定载体，另一手持空气罐，出气口距离芯片一角 2-3 cm 位置，以 大概30°倾角缓慢吹气，从芯片角落起始顺序推进，吹干芯片表面液体，勿使气流过猛；
en: f. Transfer the carrier onto lint-free paper; fix the carrier with one hand, hold an air duster in the other, and position the nozzle 2-3 cm away from one corner of the chip; blow air slowly at an angle of approximately 30°, advancing sequentially from the corner of the chip to dry the surface liquid; do not use excessive airflow;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: g.	 （可选操作）使用载玻片离心机（微型玻片离心机LX-700）离心10 s 甩干芯片上液体；
en: g. (Optional) Use a slide centrifuge (micro slide centrifuge LX-700) to centrifuge for 10 s to spin off liquid from the chip;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: h.	 Glycerol 使用前离心，用移液器缓慢吸取5 μL Glycerol 甘油滴加到组织中央，避免产生气泡；
en: h. Centrifuge glycerol before use; use a pipette to slowly draw 5 μL of glycerol and dispense it onto the center of the tissue, avoiding the formation of air bubbles;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: i.	用镊子夹取盖玻片，小心将盖玻片的一端放在芯片边上，同时握住另一端，然后逐渐将盖玻片放低到芯片上直至完全覆盖芯片；待甘油浸润整张芯片后，立即拍照，避免荧光猝灭。
en: i. Use tweezers to pick up a coverslip. Carefully place one end of the coverslip at the edge of the chip while holding the other end, then gradually lower the coverslip onto the chip until it completely covers it. After the glycerol has spread over the entire chip, take photos immediately to avoid fluorescence quenching.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 提前将Glycerol 置于室温平衡5 min，确保芯片完全被组织荧光染色液覆盖。
en: Pre-equilibrate the Glycerol to room temperature for 5 minutes, and ensure the chip is completely covered by the tissue fluorescent staining solution.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 确保芯片上没有残留的染色液。
en: Ensure there is no residual staining solution on the chip.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 请保证盖玻片使用前干净无灰尘，可使用酒精擦拭盖玻片表面或者使用空气罐吹干净。
en: Please ensure the coverslip is clean and dust-free before use; you may wipe the surface of the coverslip with alcohol or use an air duster to blow it clean.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 3. 操作流程Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书
en: 3. Operation Procedure for Stereo-seq Transcriptome Reagent Kit (Chip Version) User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 成像过程需要保证染色通道的Track 线和组织区域同时清晰且组织区域不过曝。
en: During the imaging process, it must be ensured that the Track lines in the staining channel and the tissue area are simultaneously clear, and that the tissue area is not overexposed.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a.	 在连接荧光显微镜的电脑中新建文件夹，以芯片号命名，也可适当注明其他相关信息；
en: a. Create a new folder on the computer connected to the fluorescence microscope, named after the chip number; other relevant information may also be added appropriately.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: b.	 在载物台上滴加1-2 μL 水，将Stereo-seq 芯片载体转移到显微镜载物台上，取下遮光罩。选择落射荧光扫描模式，FITC 通道，10 倍镜；
en: b. Add 1-2 μL of water onto the stage, transfer the Stereo-seq chip slide to the microscope stage, and remove the light shield. Select the epifluorescence scanning mode, FITC channel, and 10x objective lens;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: c.	 框选视野：框选芯片，减少芯片外区域；
en: c. Field of View Selection: Frame the chip to reduce the area outside the chip;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: d.	 对焦策略：在芯片四角方向（如图：组织外有 track 线的区域）分别记录焦点，对 Track 线定焦。组织区域内每平方厘米选择 2-4 个点对组织定焦（如果组织起伏较大，可以酌情增加定焦点）；对于仅支持自动对焦策略的显微镜无需考虑本策略；
en: d. Focusing Strategy: Record the focal point at each of the four corners of the chip (as shown in the figure: the area outside the tissue with track lines) to focus on the track lines. Within the tissue area, select 2-4 points per square centimeter to focus on the tissue (if the tissue topography varies significantly, the number of focal points can be increased as appropriate); this strategy is not required for microscopes that only support automatic focusing;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: e.	 最终成像：Track 建模点完成后，将增益（Gain）调至最小，参考拍照注意事项 e 确定最终拍照参数后开始成像，待成像完成，保存整个文件夹（原始 FOV 小图与拼接大图）；
en: e. Final Imaging: After the track modeling points are completed, set the gain to the minimum, determine the final imaging parameters by referring to imaging note e, and then start imaging. Once imaging is complete, save the entire folder (raw FOV thumbnails and stitched large images);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: f.	打开ImageStudio 软件的图像QC 模块，上传ssDNA 染色图，并参考软件内置的《ImageStudio 用户手册》来进行图像QC；
en: f. Open the image QC module of the ImageStudio software, upload the ssDNA staining image, and perform image QC by referring to the "ImageStudio User Manual" built into the software;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: g.	 拍照后，用镊子将盖玻片轻轻推至载玻片边缘，夹在盖玻片一角；
en: g. After taking the photo, gently push the coverslip to the edge of the slide with tweezers and grip it at one corner;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: h.	 用镊子轻轻地平行移动盖玻片，直到芯片与盖玻片完全分离；
en: h. Gently move the coverslip in parallel with tweezers until the chip and the coverslip are completely separated;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: i.	将载体置于装有30 mL 0.1X SSC 的50 mL 离心管中浸泡3-5 s；
en: i. Place the carrier in a 50 mL centrifuge tube containing 30 mL of 0.1X SSC and soak for 3-5 s;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: j.	取出载玻片，用无尘纸擦去载玻片背面及芯片四周的残液，确保无液体残留。
en: j. Remove the slide, wipe off any residual liquid on the back of the slide and around the chip using dust-free paper, and ensure no liquid remains.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 文件夹名称只使用字母、数字、下划线，禁止使用空格等特殊字符。 例：B00249A1
en: Folder names should only use letters, numbers, and underscores; spaces and other special characters are prohibited. Example: B00249A1
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 获得的 ssDNA 染色图需要通过 QC 才能开展进一步的图像分析(register)。
en: The obtained ssDNA staining images must pass QC before further image analysis (registration) can be conducted.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 确保芯片全部浸没于溶液中。
en: Ensure the chip is fully immersed in the solution.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 如果QC 失败，请仔细检查图像清晰度，调整拍照方法进行二次拍照以确保可以获得清晰的组织及Track 线图像。若二次拍照QC 仍失败，继续实验。实验结束可联系FAS 帮助排查问题。
en: If QC fails, please carefully check the image clarity, adjust the imaging method, and retake the images to ensure clear tissue and track line images can be obtained. If QC still fails after retaking, proceed with the experiment. You may contact the FAS for troubleshooting assistance after the experiment is completed.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 3. 操作流程Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书
en: 3. Operational Workflow for Stereo-seq Transcriptomics Reagent Kit (Slide Version) User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a.	 显微镜扫片时请勿触碰显微镜所在平面，周边不能有包括行走的震源;
en: a. Do not touch the surface where the microscope is located during scanning, and there should be no vibration sources in the vicinity, including walking.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: b.	 显微镜扫描荧光染色图像时，尽量避免过曝，可通过图像像素统计情况（如：直方图）来判断，刚好不过曝情况为：直方图曲率适中不贴边，既直方图横坐标最大值处仅有微小突起;
en: b. When scanning fluorescently stained images with a microscope, try to avoid overexposure, which can be judged by image pixel statistics (e.g., histogram). The state of being just not overexposed is: the histogram curve is moderate and does not touch the edges, meaning there is only a slight protrusion at the maximum value of the histogram's x-axis.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: c.	 在拍照过程中请勿将贴有组织的芯片长时间照射荧光，非拍照时间关闭激光，避免长时间照射;
en: c. Do not expose the chip with attached tissue to fluorescence for a long time during the imaging process; turn off the laser when not capturing images to avoid prolonged exposure.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: d.	 推荐使用手动对焦，按照上文策略在芯片四角和组织内分别定焦，以此同时获得清晰的 Track 线和染色图像;
en: d.	 Manual focusing is recommended; follow the strategy described above to set focus separately at the four corners of the chip and within the tissue to simultaneously obtain clear Track lines and stained images;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: e.	 手动定焦拍照过程中有多次曝光和灯光强度参数调整，为进行 Track 线对焦，可以拉高增益（Gain）和灯光强度。Track 线选点之后，对组织进行对焦时，将增益降到最低，灯光强度降低到组织区域不过曝（参考注意事项 b）。在整体扫描前，选择图像上占据较大面积，又较亮的区域（如图红色框内区域），调节曝光时间（不超过 500 ms）和灯光强度（在 500 ms 曝光不能满足需求时增大光强）使该区域刚好不过曝( 参考注意事项 b)，以保证在能够获取 Track 线情况下仅有少量区域过曝；
en: e.	 During manual focusing for imaging, multiple adjustments to exposure and light intensity parameters are involved. To focus on the Track lines, gain and light intensity can be increased. After selecting the Track line points, when focusing on the tissue, reduce the gain to the minimum and lower the light intensity until the tissue area is not overexposed (refer to Note b). Before full-scan, select a relatively bright area that occupies a large portion of the image (as shown in the red box in the figure), and adjust the exposure time (not exceeding 500 ms) and light intensity (increase light intensity if 500 ms exposure is insufficient) so that the area is just not overexposed (refer to Note b), ensuring that only a small area is overexposed while still being able to capture the Track lines;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: f.	如果在甘油封片过程中，存在较大区域（超过 4 个视野大小）未被甘油浸润，则需要对此区域增加建模点;
en: f.	 If, during the glycerin mounting process, there is a large area (exceeding 4 fields of view) that is not infiltrated by glycerin, it is necessary to add modeling points to this area;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: g.	 谨慎使用自动对焦模式，大部分自动对焦策略无法对 Track 线精确定焦，容易造成 QC 失败，同时还有可能造成荧光淬灭。
en: g. Use autofocus mode with caution; most autofocus strategies cannot focus precisely on the Track line, which easily leads to QC failure and may also cause fluorescence quenching.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 3. 操作流程Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书
en: 3. Operation Workflow: Stereo-seq Transcriptomics Reagent Kit (Chip Version) User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a.  根据【实验前准备】，提前配制2 mL 0.01N HCl，准备好1X 透化试剂工作液；
en: a. In accordance with [Experimental Preparation], prepare 2 mL of 0.01N HCl in advance and prepare the 1X permeabilization working solution;

en: b. Set the temperature of 2 PCR instruments (or 1 PCR instrument and 1 metal bath) to 37°C in advance, with a hot lid temperature of 42°C, and place a PCR adapter in one of the PCR instruments beforehand to equilibrate the temperature;

zh: 42°C 热盖on-
en: 42°C heated lid on-

zh: 37°C60 min1
en: 37°C 60 min 1

zh: •	 图a 为组织外选取的一个对焦点视野窗口截图，应保证 Track 线清晰分明；
en: • Figure a is a screenshot of a focus point field-of-view window selected outside the tissue; ensure the Track line is clear and distinct.

en: Figure b is a screenshot of a selected focus point field of view within the tissue; ensure the nuclear staining image is clear and not overexposed.

zh: •	 图c 为组织内选取的一个对焦点视野窗口截图，过曝时图像及像素统计状态（图右侧）；
en: Figure c is a screenshot of a selected focus point field of view within the tissue, showing the image and pixel statistics status under overexposure (on the right side of the figure);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: •	 图d 为组织内选取的一个对焦点视野窗口截图，欠曝时图像及像素统计状态（图右侧）；
en: •	 Figure d is a screenshot of a selected focal point field-of-view window within the tissue, showing the image and pixel statistics status under underexposure (right side of the figure);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 3. 操作流程Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书
en: 3. Operating Procedure: User Manual for Stereo-seq Transcriptomics Reagent Kit (Carrier Version)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: c. 提前取出RT Reagent, RT Additive 和 RT Oligo 置于室温解冻，RT Oligo 解冻后置于冰上备用；
en: c. Take out RT Reagent, RT Additive, and RT Oligo in advance to thaw at room temperature. Keep RT Oligo on ice after thawing for later use;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: d. 参考步骤 1.6. 将垫圈与夹具组合成载具（不含芯片载体）。将载具放置于PCR适配器上，盖上PCR 仪盖，37℃孵育10 min，透化工作液使用前置于PCR 仪或者金属浴中37℃孵育10 min（最长时间不超过30 min）；
en: d. Refer to step 1.6 to assemble the gasket and clamp into a carrier (without the chip slide). Place the carrier on the PCR adapter, close the PCR instrument lid, and incubate at 37°C for 10 min. Incubate the permeabilization working solution in the PCR instrument or a dry bath at 37°C for 10 min before use (the maximum time must not exceed 30 min);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: e. 载具孵育完成后，将载体固定于载具上，组合成手持载具，确保夹具 8 个卡扣扣紧并且载体两侧贴紧夹具两侧；
en: e. After the carrier incubation is complete, fix the substrate onto the carrier to assemble the handheld carrier assembly, ensuring that the 8 clips of the fixture are securely fastened and both sides of the substrate are flush against the sides of the fixture;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: f.  从反应孔的一角加入1X  透化试剂工作液 , 用量为150 μL/ 芯片，用封板膜对手持载具进行封口，无需撕开封板膜粘到载具上，盖上PCR 仪盖，37℃孵育；
en: f. Add 150 μL/chip of 1X permeabilization reagent working solution from a corner of the reaction well, seal the handheld carrier with a sealing film (no need to peel the backing of the sealing film to adhere it to the carrier), close the PCR instrument lid, and incubate at 37°C;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 确保芯片被1X 渗透试剂工作液完全覆盖。
en: Ensure the chip is completely covered by the 1X permeabilization reagent working solution.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 最佳透化时间通过Stereo-seq 透化测试实验预先确定，详情请参考使用说明书。
en: The optimal permeabilization time is pre-determined through Stereo-seq permeabilization test experiments; please refer to the instruction manual for details.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

en: Component 1X (µL) 2X + 10% (µL) 3X + 10% (µL) 4X + 10% (µL)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: RT Reagent160352528704
en: RT Reagent 160352528704
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 表格3-2 RT Mix
en: Table 3-2 RT Mix
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: g.  在等待透化期间，参考表格3-2 配制RT Mix, 放置于冰上，使用前需提前置于室温平衡5 min；
en: g. During the permeabilization incubation, prepare the RT Mix according to Table 3-2, place it on ice, and equilibrate it at room temperature for 5 min before use;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: h.  将另一PCR 仪反应温度调节至42℃，热盖温度为47℃，放置另一个PCR 适配器平衡温度；
en: h. Adjust the reaction temperature of another PCR instrument to 42°C and the lid temperature to 47°C, and place another PCR adapter to equilibrate the temperature;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: i.  透化结束后，将手持载具从PCR 仪（37℃）中取出；
en: i. After permeabilization is complete, remove the handheld carrier from the PCR instrument (37°C);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: j. 倾斜角度小于20°，用移液器从反应孔的一角吸掉透化试剂，避免接触芯片正面；
en: j. Tilt at an angle of less than 20°, and use a pipette to remove the permeabilization reagent from one corner of the reaction well, avoiding contact with the front surface of the chip;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: k. 加入PR Rinse Buffer 溶液（含5%RI，用量为200 μL/ 芯片）；
en: k. Add PR Rinse Buffer solution (containing 5% RI, volume: 200 μL/chip);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: l.  微微倾斜手持载具，用移液器在芯片一角吸弃PR Rinse Buffer 溶液，保持芯片湿润。
en: l. Slightly tilt the handheld carrier, and use a pipette to aspirate the PR Rinse Buffer solution from one corner of the chip, keeping the chip moist.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 避免芯片完全干燥。
en: Avoid allowing the chip to dry out completely.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 在组装载具时避免接触到芯片正面。
en: Avoid contact with the face of the chip when assembling the carrier.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 3. 操作流程Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书
en: 3. Operation Procedure for Stereo-seq Transcriptome Reagent Kit (Chip Version) User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a.  取出配制好的RT Mix 吹打混匀后瞬时离心，在芯片一角加入200 μL/ 芯片的RT Mix，确保RT Mix 均匀覆盖全芯片；
en: a. Take out the prepared RT Mix, mix by pipetting, and centrifuge briefly. Add 200 μL/chip of RT Mix to one corner of the chip, ensuring the RT Mix covers the entire chip uniformly;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: b.   使用封板膜将手持载具封口，放置于PCR 仪（42℃）的PCR 适配器上，盖上PCR 仪盖子，PCR 仪设定以下程序，反应3 hr 或以上，最长不超过16 hr。
en: b. Seal the handheld carrier with a sealing film, place it on the PCR adapter of the PCR instrument (42°C), and close the lid of the PCR instrument. Set the PCR instrument to the following program and react for 3 hours or more, up to a maximum of 16 hours.

en: 47°C heated lid on-

Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 60°C 热盖on-
en: 60°C, Hot Lid on-

en: 55°C 10 min 1

en: 55°C Hold-

zh: a.  提前将另一台PCR 仪反应温度调节至55℃，PCR 仪热盖温度为60℃，放置PCR适配器平衡温度；
en: a. Adjust the reaction temperature of another PCR instrument to 55°C in advance, set the PCR instrument heated lid temperature to 60°C, and place the PCR adapter to equilibrate the temperature;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: b.  反转录反应结束后，将手持载具从 PCR 仪（42℃）中取出；
en: b. After the reverse transcription reaction is completed, remove the handheld carrier from the PCR instrument (42°C);

zh: c.  微微倾斜手持载具，用移液器从反应孔的一角吸弃芯片表面的RT Mix；
en: c. Slightly tilt the handheld carrier and use a pipette to aspirate and discard the RT Mix from the chip surface from one corner of the reaction well;

zh: d.  加入TR Buffer（用量为400 μL / 芯片），然后放置于PCR 仪（55℃）的PCR 适配器上反应10 min；

source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 本试剂套装推荐使用VAHTS DNA Clean Beads 或AMPure® XP（Agencourt, Cat. No. A63882）进行磁珠纯化。如果使用其他品牌的磁珠，纯化条件需要重新摸索。
en: This reagent kit recommends using VAHTS DNA Clean Beads or AMPure® XP (Agencourt, Cat. No. A63882) for bead purification. If using magnetic beads from other brands, the purification conditions need to be re-optimized.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: •	 提前30 min 从4℃取出，涡旋混匀且平衡至室温，有利于保证回收效率。
en: • Take out from 4°C 30 minutes in advance, vortex to mix, and equilibrate to room temperature to help ensure recovery efficiency.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: •	 磁珠每次使用前，需振荡或用移液器上下吸打，确保充分混匀。
en: • Before each use, the magnetic beads must be vortexed or pipetted up and down to ensure they are fully mixed.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: •	 磁珠使用量直接影响纯化得到的DNA 片段分布。磁珠用量越高，纯化得到的DNA 片段的下限长度越小。
en: • The amount of magnetic beads used directly affects the fragment distribution of the purified DNA. The higher the amount of magnetic beads used, the smaller the lower limit of the length of the purified DNA fragments.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 磁珠操作注意事项
en: Precautions for Magnetic Bead Operation
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: •	 样本与磁珠充分混匀后置于磁力架上进行分离时，请于溶液彻底澄清后再吸取上清，一般需要2-3 min。但由于磁力架吸力不同等原因，推荐分离时间有时可能需要延长，以液体彻底澄清为准。
en: • After fully mixing the sample with the magnetic beads, place the tube on a magnetic rack for separation. Wait until the solution is completely clear before aspirating the supernatant; this typically requires 2–3 minutes. However, because magnetic racks vary in strength, the recommended separation time may occasionally need to be extended; ensure the liquid is completely clear.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: •	 在分离磁珠与液体时，注意吸头不可碰到磁珠，最后可余留2-3 μL 液体，以避免吸到磁珠。若不慎吸到磁珠，可将磁珠与液体全部打回管内，再次分离后再吸取上清。
en: • When separating magnetic beads from the liquid, ensure the pipette tip does not touch the beads. You may leave 2–3 μL of liquid behind to avoid aspirating any beads. If beads are accidentally aspirated, dispense the beads and liquid back into the tube, perform the separation again, and then aspirate the supernatant.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: •	 磁珠乙醇漂洗应使用新鲜配制并平衡至室温的80% 乙醇。漂洗过程中离心管应始终置于磁力架上，移液器吸头应在远离磁力架的管壁上操作，请勿吸打、搅动磁珠。
en: • For magnetic bead ethanol washing, use freshly prepared 80% ethanol that has been equilibrated to room temperature. During the washing process, the centrifuge tube should always be placed on the magnetic rack. Operate the pipette tip on the tube wall away from the magnetic rack; do not pipette up and down or stir the magnetic beads.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: •	 第二次乙醇漂洗应尽量吸干管底液体。若有少量液体残留在管壁，可将离心管瞬时离心，在磁力架上分离后，用小量程的移液器把管底液体吸干。
en: • For the second ethanol wash, remove as much liquid from the bottom of the tube as possible. If a small amount of liquid remains on the tube wall, briefly centrifuge the tube, separate it on the magnetic rack, and then use a small-volume pipette to aspirate the liquid from the bottom of the tube.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: •	 两次乙醇漂洗后，应在室温下充分干燥磁珠。干燥不充分（磁珠表面反光）容易造成乙醇残留，影响后续反应，过度干燥（磁珠开裂）会降低回收得率。通常情况下，室温干燥需要5-10 min，但由于室内温度和湿度的差异，干燥时间可能会不同，应随时观察。直至磁珠表面无反光，即可用TE Buffer 或 Nuclease-Free Water 进行产物洗脱。
en: • After two ethanol washes, the magnetic beads should be fully dried at room temperature. Insufficient drying (where the bead surface is reflective) can easily cause residual ethanol, affecting subsequent reactions, while over-drying (bead cracking) will reduce the recovery yield. Typically, room temperature drying takes 5-10 minutes, but the drying time may vary due to differences in indoor temperature and humidity; therefore, monitor continuously. Once there is no reflection on the surface of the magnetic beads, the product can be eluted using TE Buffer or Nuclease-Free Water.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: •	 洗脱后吸取上清时，切忌触碰磁珠，若吸到磁珠可能会影响后续的纯化反应。所以，最终吸取的上清可比用于洗脱的TE Buffer 或 Nuclease-Free Water 的体积少~2 μL。
en: • When aspirating the supernatant after elution, do not touch the magnetic beads, as doing so may interfere with subsequent purification reactions. Therefore, the final volume of aspirated supernatant can be ~2 μL less than the volume of TE Buffer or Nuclease-Free Water used for elution.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: •	 在1.5 mL 磁力架上开关管盖应避免剧烈震动导致磁珠或液体弹出，建议用手指固定住1.5 mL 离心管中下段，然后开盖。
en: • When opening or closing the tube cap while on the 1.5 mL magnetic rack, avoid vigorous vibration that might cause magnetic beads or liquid to pop out. It is recommended to hold the middle-lower part of the 1.5 mL centrifuge tube firmly with your fingers before opening the cap.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a.  cDNA 回收液如果观察到有白色沉淀析出，可放于 55℃溶解，恢复至室温后进行纯化。提前 30 min 取出磁珠， 平衡至室温；
en: a. If white precipitates are observed in the cDNA recovery solution, it can be dissolved at 55°C and purified after returning to room temperature. Take out the magnetic beads 30 min in advance and equilibrate to room temperature;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: b.  1X 磁珠cDNA 纯化步骤;
en: b. 1X magnetic bead cDNA purification steps;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 1）将上一步回收液（450-490 μL）与室温平衡好的磁珠按照1 : 1 混合，震荡混匀，室温孵育10 min；
en: 1) Mix the recovery solution from the previous step (450-490 μL) with the magnetic beads equilibrated to room temperature at a ratio of 1:1, vortex to mix well, and incubate at room temperature for 10 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 2）瞬时离心后，将离心管放在磁力架上静置3 min；
en: 2) Briefly centrifuge, then place the centrifuge tube on a magnetic rack and let it stand for 3 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 3）待液体澄清后，用移液器小心去除上清（如果管盖上有泡沫，吸弃泡沫）；
en: 3) Once the liquid is clear, carefully remove the supernatant with a pipette (if there is foam on the tube cap, aspirate and discard the foam);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 4）将离心管保持在磁力架上，加入1 mL 80% 乙醇（使用新鲜配制并平衡至室温的80% 乙醇），旋转磁力架上的离心管，待磁珠全部吸附到靠磁力架一侧的管壁，再次旋离心管，让磁珠重新吸附到另一侧来漂洗磁珠。静置30 s，小心吸取并丢弃上清;
en: 4) Keep the centrifuge tube on the magnetic rack, add 1 mL of 80% ethanol (use 80% ethanol that has been freshly prepared and equilibrated to room temperature), and rotate the centrifuge tube on the magnetic rack. Once all magnetic beads are adsorbed to the tube wall against the magnetic rack, rotate the centrifuge tube again to allow the magnetic beads to re-adsorb to the other side to wash the beads. Let stand for 30 s, then carefully aspirate and discard the supernatant;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 5）重复一次步骤4）；
en: 5) Repeat step 4 once;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 6）将离心管保持在磁力架上，室温风干5-8 min，直至磁珠表面无反光、无开裂；
en: 6) Keep the centrifuge tube on the magnetic stand and air-dry at room temperature for 5-8 min, until the surface of the magnetic beads is non-reflective and shows no cracks;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 7）先加22 μL Nuclease-Free Water 回溶，震荡混匀后室温静置5 min，瞬时离心，磁力架静置 3-5 min，直至液体变澄清；
en: 7) First, add 22 μL of Nuclease-Free Water to resuspend, vortex to mix, then incubate at room temperature for 5 min, spin down momentarily, and place on the magnetic stand for 3-5 min until the liquid becomes clear;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 8）将上清（~21 μL cDNA）转移至新的0.2 mL PCR 管中；
en: 8) Transfer the supernatant (~21 μL cDNA) to a new 0.2 mL PCR tube;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 9）再将 22 μL Nuclease-Free Water 加入步骤7 的磁珠中二次回溶，震荡混匀后室温静置 5 min，瞬时离心，磁力架静置 3-5 min，直至液体变澄清；
en: 9) Add 22 μL of Nuclease-Free Water to the magnetic beads from step 7 for a second elution, vortex to mix, let stand at room temperature for 5 min, centrifuge briefly, and place on a magnetic stand for 3-5 min until the liquid becomes clear;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 10）将上清（~21 μL cDNA）转移至步骤8 的 PCR 管中，合并总体积~42 μL。
en: 10) Transfer the supernatant (~21 μL cDNA) to the PCR tube from step 8, combining to a total volume of ~42 μL.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 移液器吸头应在远离磁力架的管壁上操作，请勿吸打、搅动磁珠（如果管盖上有泡沫，建议用 80%乙醇清洗干净）。
en: Pipette tips should be operated on the tube wall away from the magnetic rack; do not pipette up and down or agitate the magnetic beads (if there is foam on the tube cap, it is recommended to clean it with 80% ethanol).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: c.  如果上述回收样品不足42 μL，用Nuclease-Free Water 补足。
en: c. If the recovered sample volume mentioned above is less than 42 μL, top it up with Nuclease-Free Water.

zh: 收集了洗脱的cDNA 后，可用40 µL Nuclease-free Water 在4℃保存磁珠，直至cDNA 最终产品QC 通过。

zh: e.  对PCR 产物进行 1X 磁珠纯化：
en: e. Perform 1X magnetic bead purification on PCR products:
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 1）将PCR 产物（100 μL）与室温平衡好的磁珠按照1 : 1 混合，震荡混匀，室温孵育10 min；
en: 1) Mix the PCR product (100 μL) with magnetic beads equilibrated to room temperature at a 1:1 ratio, vortex to mix thoroughly, and incubate at room temperature for 10 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 2）瞬时离心后，将PCR 管放在磁力架上静置3 min，待液体澄清后去除上清；
en: 2) After transient centrifugation, place the PCR tube on a magnetic stand and let it sit for 3 minutes until the liquid becomes clear, then remove the supernatant;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 3）将离心管保持在磁力架上，加入200 μL 80% 乙醇漂洗（新鲜配制并平衡至室温的80% 乙醇）。通过旋转磁力架上的离心管来漂洗磁珠。静置30 s，小心吸取并丢弃上清。移液器吸头应在远离磁力架的管壁上操作，请勿吸打、搅动磁珠；
en: 3) Keeping the centrifuge tube on the magnetic stand, add 200 μL of 80% ethanol for washing (use freshly prepared 80% ethanol equilibrated to room temperature). Wash the magnetic beads by rotating the centrifuge tube on the magnetic stand. Let it sit for 30 seconds, then carefully aspirate and discard the supernatant. The pipette tip should be operated against the tube wall away from the magnetic stand; do not pipette up and down or disturb the magnetic beads;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 4）重复一次步骤3；
en: 4) Repeat step 3 once;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 5）将离心管保持在磁力架上，打开盖子，室温风干5-8 min，直至磁珠表面无反光、无开裂；
en: 5) Keep the centrifuge tube on the magnetic rack, open the cap, and air-dry at room temperature for 5-8 min until the surface of the magnetic beads is no longer reflective and shows no cracking;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 6）加42 μL 的TE Buffer 回溶，震荡混匀后室温静置5 min，瞬时离心，磁力架静置3-5 min，待液体澄清后将上清（~40 μL）转移到新的1.5 mL离心管中。
en: 6) Add 42 μL of TE Buffer to resuspend, vortex to mix, incubate at room temperature for 5 min, centrifuge briefly, place on the magnetic rack for 3-5 min, and once the solution becomes clear, transfer the supernatant (~40 μL) to a new 1.5 mL centrifuge tube.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: f.  取1 μL cDNA 样品，用Qubit dsDNA HS Kit 检测浓度并记录；

source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: g.  通过Bioanalyzer、Tapestation (Agilent Technologies)、LabChip® GX、GXII、GX Touch(PerkinElmer)、Fragment AnalyzerTM (Advanced Analytical) 等基于电泳分离原理的设备对cDNA 片段分布进行检测。
en: g. Analyze the cDNA fragment size distribution using electrophoretic separation-based devices such as Bioanalyzer, Tapestation (Agilent Technologies), LabChip® GX, GXII, GX Touch (PerkinElmer), or Fragment Analyzer™ (Advanced Analytical).

zh: 纯化后，可用40 µL Nuclease-free Water 在4℃保存磁珠，直至cDNA 最终产物QC 通过。

zh: STOmics® Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版）是用于构建组织切片全转录本 3'端文库的试剂套装。本试剂套装采用的 Stereo-seq 时空转录组技术，是一种基于DNBSEQ 高通量测序技术开发的、具有高分辨大视场特点的原位全转录组信息捕获技术。Stereo-seq 芯片 T（时空 poly-T 芯片）上载有具有空间坐标信息的捕获探针，与组织切片结合后通过探针原位抓取组织内的mRNA 分子并进行cDNA 合成。研究人员通过DNBSEQ 测序和STOmics® 配套的可视化分析工具，可获取特定样本超高分辨率下的空间转录组信息。
en: The STOmics® Stereo-seq Transcriptomic Reagent Kit (Carrier-based) is used for constructing whole-transcriptome 3' end libraries from tissue sections. The Stereo-seq spatial transcriptomics technology employed in this kit is an *in situ* whole-transcriptome information capture technology featuring high resolution and a large field of view, developed based on DNBSEQ high-throughput sequencing technology. Capture probes containing spatial coordinate information are loaded onto the Stereo-seq Chip T (spatial poly-T chip). Upon binding with tissue sections, these probes capture mRNA molecules within the tissue *in situ* and perform cDNA synthesis. Researchers can obtain spatial transcriptomic information at ultra-high resolution for specific samples through DNBSEQ sequencing and STOmics® complementary visualization analysis tools.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 本试剂套装中提供的所有试剂都经过严格的质量控制和功能验证，最大程度上保证了文库制备的稳定性和重复性。
en: All reagents provided in this kit have undergone strict quality control and functional verification to ensure the stability and reproducibility of library preparation to the greatest extent possible.

en: • It is recommended to take out all reagent components in advance before use. Briefly centrifuge the enzyme components and place them on ice, and thaw the other components at room temperature.
