zh: c.  将组织放入在冰上预冷的OCT 中，在不产生气泡的前提下用药匙使组织被OCT 包裹（可使用注射器吸弃产生的气泡）；
en: c. Place the tissue into the pre-cooled OCT on ice, and use a spatula to ensure the tissue is fully encapsulated in OCT without generating air bubbles (a syringe can be used to aspirate any generated air bubbles);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: d.  将组织的拟切面朝下，放入冰上预冷的金属包埋盒A 中，使组织接触到金属包埋盒A 的底部。在不产生气泡的前提下用预冷的 OCT 填满金属包埋盒A，直至将组织完全覆盖（可使用注射器吸弃产生的气泡）；
en: d. Place the tissue with the intended cutting surface facing down into the pre-cooled metal embedding mold A, ensuring the tissue makes contact with the bottom of the mold. Fill metal embedding mold A with pre-cooled OCT without generating air bubbles, until the tissue is completely covered (a syringe can be used to aspirate any generated air bubbles);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: e.  将装有组织的金属包埋盒A，水平放置在干冰预冷的金属块上；
en: e. Place the metal embedding mold A containing the tissue horizontally onto a metal block pre-cooled with dry ice;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: f.  预冷的金属包埋盒B（作为盖子）开口向上，轻轻加盖于装有组织块的金属包埋盒A 上方，并在其开口中放置碎干冰，使干冰尽可能充分覆盖金属包埋盒表面，形成较为封闭的速冻空间；
en: f. Place the pre-cooled metal embedding cassette B (as a lid) gently, with its opening facing upwards, over the metal embedding cassette A containing the tissue block, and place crushed dry ice into the opening, ensuring the dry ice covers the surface of the metal embedding cassette as fully as possible to form a relatively closed quick-freezing space;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 2. 样本准备Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版0.5 cm*0.5 cm）使用说明书
en: 2. Sample Preparation Stereo-seq Transcriptomics Reagent Kit (Chip version 0.5 cm*0.5 cm) User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: g.  冷冻5 min 后，移去金属包埋盒B，检查OCT 是否完全凝固且变成白色不透明状, 若未完全冷冻好，则重复f；
en: g. After freezing for 5 min, remove metal embedding mold B, and check if the OCT is completely solidified and has turned white and opaque. If not fully frozen, repeat f;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: h.  如果组织块完全凝固并变成白色不透明状，用手轻掰金属包埋盒A 两侧，即可使OCT 包埋组织块从金属包埋盒A中脱模；
en: h. If the tissue block is completely solidified and has turned white and opaque, gently flex both sides of metal embedding mold A by hand to demold the OCT-embedded tissue block from metal embedding mold A;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: i.  检查包埋块底部是否被完全覆盖, 如未完全覆盖，则将组织块放置在金属块上，底部向上，在表面涂上少量OCT，待OCT 完全凝固且不透明，在包埋块切面位置做好标记。
en: i. Check if the bottom of the embedding block is completely covered. If not, place the tissue block on a metal block with the bottom facing up, apply a small amount of OCT to the surface, wait until the OCT is completely solidified and opaque, and mark the sectioning surface of the embedding block.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 将组织包埋块使用锡纸包裹，并做好标记放入自封袋，在自封袋上做好记录，放入−80℃冰箱长期保存。如需邮寄，可选干冰邮寄。
en: Wrap the tissue embedding blocks in aluminum foil, label them, and place them into a self-sealing bag. Record the necessary information on the bag and store it in a -80°C freezer for long-term storage. If shipping is required, shipment on dry ice is an option.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 3. 操作流程Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版0.5 cm*0.5 cm）使用说明书
en: 3. Operating Procedure: Stereo-seq Transcriptome Reagent Kit (Carrier Version 0.5 cm * 0.5 cm) User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 本实验用于稀释试剂的液体，除特殊说明外，均使用Nuclease - Free Water。
en: Unless otherwise specified, Nuclease-Free Water is used for diluting reagents in this experiment.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 准备试剂准备流程  保存条件
en: Reagent Preparation Procedure Storage Conditions
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 5X SSC取20X SSC 5 mL 稀释到20 mL   室温
en: 5X SSC: Take 5 mL of 20X SSC and dilute to 20 mL Room temperature
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 0.1X SSC 取20X SSC 100 μL 稀释到20 mL取20X SSC 250 μL 稀释到50 mL    室温
en: 0.1X SSC: Take 100 μL of 20X SSC and dilute to 20 mL, or take 250 μL of 20X SSC and dilute to 50 mL Room temperature
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: Wash Buffer取5 μL RI 加入95 μL 0.1X SSC 中，用量至少为30 μL/ 芯片 冰上备用
en: Take 5 μL of Wash Buffer and add it to 95 μL of 0.1X SSC, with a required amount of at least 30 μL/chip; keep on ice for later use.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 0.01N HCl按照HCl 浓度梯度稀释到0.01N，pH 值准确到2（确保pH 值在1.9-2.1 范围内；至少2 mL/ 样本）   室温48 hr
en: Dilute 0.01N HCl according to the HCl concentration gradient to 0.01N, with the pH value accurate to 2 (ensure the pH value is in the range of 1.9-2.1; at least 2 mL/sample); leave at room temperature for 48 hours.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 0.01N HCl (pH = 2.0 ) 需现配现用。对于预制的0.1N HCl 和新购买的HCl，实验前请检查pH 值。
en: 0.01N HCl (pH = 2.0) must be prepared fresh before use. For pre-made 0.1N HCl and newly purchased HCl, please check the pH value before the experiment.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 储存时间超过48 hr 将影响预期pH 值，请在配制后48 hr 内使用。
en: Storage for longer than 48 hours will affect the expected pH; please use within 48 hours of preparation.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 10X 透化试剂储存液用1 mL 新鲜配制的0.01N HCl 将PR Enzyme（红盖，粉末状）溶解后，通过移液器吹打混匀（可分装成若干份）   −20℃
en: To prepare the 10X Permeabilization Reagent Stock Solution, dissolve the PR Enzyme (red cap, powder) with 1 mL of freshly prepared 0.01N HCl and mix by pipetting (can be aliquoted into several portions). Store at −20°C.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 不要涡旋透化酶，可通过移液器吹打混匀。建议对配制好的10X 透化试剂储存液进行分装，避免反复冻融。
en: Do not vortex the permeabilization enzyme; mix by pipetting. It is recommended to aliquot the prepared 10X Permeabilization Reagent Stock Solution to avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 1X 透化试剂工作液用0.01N HCl 将10X 透化试剂储存液 20 μL 稀释到200 μL（至少200 μL/ 芯片）   冰上备用6 hr
en: Prepare the 1X permeabilization reagent working solution by diluting 20 μL of 10X permeabilization reagent stock solution to 200 μL with 0.01N HCl (at least 200 μL/chip), and keep it on ice for use within 6 hours.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: RT Oligo短暂离心，加入79 μL TE buffer 重悬。盖紧盖子后最大速度涡旋15 s，然后短暂离心−80℃
en: Briefly centrifuge the RT Oligo, add 79 μL of TE buffer to resuspend. After closing the lid tightly, vortex at maximum speed for 15 s, then briefly centrifuge and store at −80℃.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 可分装未使用的RT Oligo，并保存于−80℃，以避免反复冻融。
en: Unused RT Oligo can be aliquoted and stored at −80℃ to avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: Glycerol使用前，至少提前 5 min 取出，平衡至室温室温
en: Take out Glycerol at least 5 minutes before use and equilibrate to room temperature.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: PR Rinse Buffer（含5% RI）
en: PR Rinse Buffer (containing 5% RI)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 每张芯片至少准备 200 μL（190 μL PR Rinse Buffer + 10 μL RI）。配制后置于冰上备用，使用前室温平衡 5 min
en: Prepare at least 200 μL per chip (190 μL PR Rinse Buffer + 10 μL RI). Keep on ice after preparation, and equilibrate to room temperature for 5 minutes before use.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 冰上备用，使用前室温平衡5 min
en: Keep on ice; equilibrate to room temperature for 5 min before use.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 3. 操作流程Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版0.5 cm*0.5 cm）使用说明书
en: 3. Operational Procedure for Stereo-seq Transcriptome Reagent Kit (Substrate Version 0.5 cm * 0.5 cm) Instruction Manual.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 准备仪器准备流程备注
en: Instrument Preparation Workflow Notes
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 按顺序依次设定：
en: Configure in sequence:
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 37℃用于烤片和透化（热盖42℃）
en: 37°C for slide baking and permeabilization (lid 42°C)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 42℃用于反转录（热盖47℃）
en: 42°C for reverse transcription (lid 47°C)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 55℃用于组织移除（热盖60℃）
en: 55°C for tissue removal (lid 60°C)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 检查PCR 仪是否有异常，必要时更换
en: Check the PCR instrument for abnormalities, and replace if necessary.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 金属浴37℃用于透化酶预热-
en: Metal bath at 37°C for preheating the permeabilization enzyme-
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 荧光显微镜  FITC 通道-
en: Fluorescence microscope, FITC channel-
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 准备试剂准备流程  保存条件
en: Reagent Preparation Process  Storage Conditions
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 80% 乙醇无水乙醇稀释到80%   室温1 天
en: 80% Ethanol: Dilute absolute ethanol to 80%   Room temperature for 1 day
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 磁珠 提前取出，室温放置30 min 平衡    4℃
en: Magnetic Beads: Take out in advance, equilibrate at room temperature for 30 min    4°C
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: a. 提前将PCR 仪温度设置到37℃，热盖温度为42℃，放置PCR 适配器平衡温度；
en: a. Pre-set the PCR instrument temperature to 37°C and the lid temperature to 42°C, and place the PCR adapter to equilibrate the temperature;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: b. 冷冻切片机箱体预冷至−20℃，样本头预冷至−15℃~ −10℃（根据实际操作过程调整）；
en: b. Pre-cool the cryostat chamber to −20°C and the specimen holder to −15°C ~ −10°C (adjust according to the actual operation process);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: c. 提前将毛刷、刀片和镊子等置于箱体预冷；
en: c. Place brushes, blades, tweezers, etc., in the chamber beforehand to pre-cool;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: d. 将OCT 包埋的组织块从−80℃冰箱取出，放在冷冻切片机内平衡30 min；
en: d. Remove the OCT-embedded tissue block from the -80°C freezer and place it in the cryostat to equilibrate for 30 minutes;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: e. 使用OCT 将组织块固定到样品托上；
en: e. Use OCT to secure the tissue block onto the specimen holder;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: f. 将组织块修剪成合适的尺寸（切面小于 0.45 cm × 0.45 cm），切去组织块周围过多的OCT，保留一部分OCT，方便转移组织；
en: f. Trim the tissue block to an appropriate size (sectioning surface smaller than 0.45 cm × 0.45 cm), remove excess OCT around the tissue block while retaining a small amount of OCT to facilitate tissue handling;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: g. 根据需要对组织块做最后地修剪，以确保组织切片能更好地适配芯片，随后可进行冷冻切片。
en: g. Perform final trimming of the tissue block as needed to ensure the tissue sections fit the chip better, then proceed with cryosectioning.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 样本头温度过低会导致切片出现裂纹，样本头温度过高会导致切片出现褶皱，请根据样本情况将冻头调
en: If the specimen holder temperature is too low, it will cause cracks in the sections, and if it is too high, it will cause wrinkles. Please adjust the specimen holder
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 样本头温度过低会导致切片出现裂纹，样本头温度过高会导致切片出现褶皱，请根据样本情况将冻头调
en: Too low a specimen head temperature will cause cracks in the sections, and too high a specimen head temperature will cause wrinkles in the sections. Please adjust the cryo-head
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 3. 操作流程Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版0.5 cm*0.5 cm）使用说明书
en: 3. Operational Procedure - Stereo-seq Transcriptomics Kit (Carrier version 0.5 cm × 0.5 cm) User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: a. 取芯片：从真空干燥铝箔袋中取出 Stereo-seq 芯片T 载体，记录芯片背面的编号；注意不要触碰芯片正面；
en: a. Take the chip: Remove the Stereo-seq chip T-carrier from the vacuum-sealed aluminum foil bag, and record the serial number on the back of the chip; take care not to touch the front surface of the chip.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: b. 将载体置于桌面上复温1 min，观察芯片表面是否有杂质，如芯片上存在杂质，使用100 μL Nuclease-Free Water 清洗2 次（或在含40-50 mL NF water 的离心管中清洗2 次 )；
en: b. Place the carrier on the bench to warm up for 1 minute, and observe the surface of the chip for any impurities. If there are impurities, wash the chip twice with 100 μL of Nuclease-Free Water (or wash it twice in a centrifuge tube containing 40-50 mL of NF water).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 打开后，请检查玻片盒中的所有的 Stereo-seq 芯片载体是否正确定位在插槽中，载体上的芯片是否正面
en: After opening, please check that all Stereo-seq chip slides in the slide box are correctly positioned in the slots, and whether the chips on the carriers are facing up.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 朝上。芯片的正面为亮光面，正面含有用于 mRNA 捕获的探针。请勿触碰到芯片表面。
en: Face up. The front side of the chip is the shiny side and contains probes used for mRNA capture. Do not touch the surface of the chip.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: c. 清洗后用气瓶吹干芯片四周及表面，再用无尘纸吸干载玻片背面和周围多余的液体；
en: c. After washing, use a compressed gas duster to dry the surroundings and surface of the chip, then use a lint-free wipe to absorb any excess liquid from the back and around the slide;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: d. 当芯片表面无杂质、无明显痕迹、无任何液体残留、无波纹状纹理，即可准备贴片；
en: d. Once the chip surface is free of impurities, obvious marks, residual liquid, or wavy textures, it is ready for mounting;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: e. 预冷甲醇：在玻片盒或50 mL 离心管中加入足量甲醇，确保甲醇足够浸没所有芯片（可将一张普通载玻片放入容器中，查看甲醇的体积是否足够）。扣紧盖子，提前放入切片机中（−20℃）预冷5-30 min；
en: e. Pre-cool methanol: Add sufficient methanol to a slide box or 50 mL centrifuge tube, ensuring it is enough to fully submerge all chips (a standard microscope slide can be placed into the container to check if the methanol volume is adequate). Tighten the lid and pre-cool it in the cryostat (-20°C) for 5-30 min in advance;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: f. 将组织包埋块固定至冻头上，修片；
en: f. Secure the tissue embedding block to the cryochuck and trim the block;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: g. 组织贴片有两种操作方式可选：冷贴（A）和热帖（B）。根据需求选择切片厚度，通常为10 μm。
en: g. There are two optional methods for tissue mounting: cold mounting (A) and hot mounting (B). Select the section thickness based on requirements, usually 10 μm.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: A. 冷贴（推荐）
en: A. Cold mounting (recommended)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 1)  将玻片正面朝上置于切片机中，预冷1-6 min；
en: 1) Place the glass slide in the cryostat with the front side facing up and pre-cool for 1-6 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 2）进行冷冻切片，然后用预冷的毛刷轻轻拨动切片周围的OCT 使切片铺平。用镊子和毛刷将切片小心覆盖在芯片正中央并铺平，注意毛刷不要触碰到组织。尽量一次贴片成功，确保组织切片完整，无褶皱；
en: 2) Perform cryosectioning, and then gently nudge the OCT around the section with a pre-cooled brush to flatten it. Carefully cover the section onto the center of the chip using forceps and the brush, ensuring it is flattened; take care not to touch the tissue with the brush. Try to mount the section successfully in one attempt, ensuring the tissue section is intact and free of folds;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 3）立即拿起芯片载体，用指腹放在载体背面加温几秒钟，直至切片贴合；
en: 3) Immediately pick up the chip slide, place your fingertips on the back of the carrier to warm it for a few seconds until the section adheres;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 4）重复上述操作，直至所有切片贴片完成，建议组织切片贴片控制在5 min 内；
en: 4) Repeat the above steps until all sections are mounted; it is recommended to complete the tissue section mounting within 5 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 5）快速将载体置于PCR 适配器上37℃孵育5 min，无需盖PCR 热盖。
en: 5) Quickly place the carrier on a PCR adapter and incubate at 37°C for 5 min; there is no need to close the PCR heated lid.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 预冷时间不可过长，以免玻片表面产生水雾；预冷时间不可太短，以免玻片无法达到预冷温度。
en: The pre-cooling time must not be too long to avoid water mist forming on the slide surface; it must not be too short, otherwise the slide will not reach the pre-cooling temperature.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 进行冷贴时需控制好每张切片贴片时间，间隔时间太大，组织贴片会皱缩。
en: During cold mounting, control the mounting time for each section; excessive intervals will cause the tissue to wrinkle.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 3. 操作流程Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版0.5 cm*0.5 cm）使用说明书
en: 3. Operation Workflow for the Stereo-seq Transcriptomics Reagent Kit (Carrier version 0.5 cm*0.5 cm) Instruction Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 固定期间可参考表格3-1 提前配置组织荧光染色液，室温避光保存备用。
en: During the fixation period, refer to Table 3-1 to prepare the tissue fluorescent staining solution in advance, and store it at room temperature in the dark for later use.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: a.	 载体孵育结束后，立即置于−20℃预冷的甲醇中，确保甲醇浸没载体上的所有芯片，固定30 min；
en: a. After carrier incubation is completed, immediately place it into methanol pre-cooled to −20°C, ensuring that the methanol immerses all chips on the carrier, and fix for 30 min.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: b.	 固定结束后，将玻片盒或50 mL 离心管转移至通风橱中；
en: b. After fixation, transfer the slide box or 50 mL centrifuge tube to a fume hood;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: c.	 将载体从玻片盒或50 mL 离心管中取出，用无尘纸吸干载玻片背面和周围多余的甲醇，确保无液体残留；
en: c. Remove the carrier from the slide box or 50 mL centrifuge tube, and use lint-free paper to blot dry excess methanol from the back and surroundings of the slide, ensuring no liquid remains;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: d.	 将载体竖立放在载玻片染色架上，置于通风橱中晾干4-6 min，让甲醇充分挥发；
en: d. Place the carrier upright on a slide staining rack and let it air dry in the fume hood for 4-6 minutes to allow the methanol to evaporate completely;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: e.	 甲醇挥发完全后，肉眼可见组织变白，将载体转移至实验台上进行下一步。
en: e. After complete evaporation of the methanol, the tissue becomes visibly white; transfer the carrier to the laboratory bench for the next step.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 组分1X ( µL)
en: Component 1X ( µL)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 5X SSC94.5
en: 5X SSC 94.5
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: Qubit ssDNA Reagent0.5
en: Qubit ssDNA Reagent 0.5
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 表格3-1  组织荧光染色液
en: Table 3-1 Tissue Fluorescence Staining Solution
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: （可选暂停点）将孵育好的芯片载体放于玻片盒或者50 mL 离心管，用干冰快速转移到−80℃冰箱，最长可于−80℃保存一个月。
en: (Optional pause) Place the incubated chip slide into a slide box or 50 mL centrifuge tube, quickly transfer it on dry ice to a −80°C freezer; it can be stored at −80°C for up to one month.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 继续实验时，使用干冰将玻片盒或者50 mL 离心管转移，取出贴有组织的芯片载体，快速置于PCR 适配器上37℃孵育5 min。
en: To continue the experiment, transfer the slide box or 50 mL centrifuge tube on dry ice, remove the chip slide with the attached tissue, and quickly place it on a PCR adapter to incubate at 37°C for 5 min.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 1）连续切取组织切片，将切片移到切片台右侧靠近边缘处，然后用预冷的毛刷轻轻拨动切片周围的OCT 使切片铺平，每张切片放置间隔距离大于载体宽度；
en: 1) Continuously cut tissue sections, move the sections to the right side of the cryostat stage near the edge, then use a pre-cooled brush to gently nudge the OCT surrounding the sections to flatten them, ensuring the spacing between each section is greater than the carrier width;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 2）拿起载体的一边，使芯片正面朝下，对准切片；
en: 2) Pick up one side of the carrier, position the chip side facing down, and align it with the section;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 3）轻轻一压，肉眼可见切片已经吸附到芯片表面；
en: 3) Apply gentle pressure; the section can be visibly seen adhering to the chip surface;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 4）重复 2）-3）步骤操作，直至全部组织切片吸附到芯片表面（贴片时间控制在1 min 以内）；
en: 4) Repeat steps 2)-3) until all tissue sections are attached to the chip surface (control the attachment time to within 1 min);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 5）将芯片正面朝上，快速将载体置于提前平衡温度的PCR 适配器上，37℃孵育5 min，无需盖PCR 热盖。
en: 5) Place the chip face up, quickly place the carrier on the PCR adapter pre-equilibrated to temperature, and incubate at 37°C for 5 min; do not close the PCR thermal lid.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 3. 操作流程Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版0.5 cm*0.5 cm）使用说明书
en: 3. Operational Procedure for Stereo-seq Transcriptomics Reagent Kit (Chip version 0.5 cm*0.5 cm) Instruction Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: a.	 将组织荧光染色液加到芯片上，用量为30 μL/ 芯片。先在芯片的每个角加入一滴染色液，然后将其余染色液加到芯片中央，使所有染色液融合，确保染色液均匀覆盖全芯片，室温避光染色5 min；
en: a. Add 30 μL of tissue fluorescence staining solution onto the chip per chip. First, add one drop of staining solution to each corner of the chip, then add the remaining staining solution to the center of the chip, allowing all staining solution to merge and ensuring that the solution uniformly covers the entire chip. Incubate at room temperature, protected from light, for 5 minutes.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: b.	 染色期间分别配置30 μL/芯片的Wash Buffer和200 μL/芯片的PR Rinse Buffer（含5% RI）；
en: b. During the staining period, prepare 30 μL of Wash Buffer per chip and 200 μL of PR Rinse Buffer (containing 5% RI) per chip respectively.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: c.	 倾斜载体，用移液器从芯片一角吸去组织荧光染色液，尽量减少表面液体；
en: c. Tilt the carrier and use a pipette to aspirate the tissue fluorescent staining solution from one corner of the chip, minimizing residual liquid on the surface;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: d.	 向芯片加入Wash Buffer，用量为30 μL/ 芯片；
en: d. Add Wash Buffer to the chip, with a volume of 30 μL/chip;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: e.	 倾斜载体，用移液器从芯片一角吸弃Wash Buffer，尽量减少表面液体；
en: e. Tilt the carrier and use a pipette to aspirate and discard the Wash Buffer from one corner of the chip, minimizing residual liquid on the surface;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: f.	将载体转移至无尘纸上，一手固定载体，另一手持空气罐，出气口距离芯片一角 2-3 cm 位置，以 大概30°倾角缓慢吹气，从芯片角落起始顺序推进，吹干芯片表面液体，勿使气流过猛；
en: f. Transfer the carrier onto a lint-free wipe. Secure the carrier with one hand while holding an air duster in the other. Position the nozzle 2-3 cm from one corner of the chip and blow air slowly at an approximate 30° angle. Proceed sequentially starting from the chip's corner to dry the liquid on its surface, being careful not to use excessive airflow.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: g.	 （可选操作）使用载玻片离心机（微型玻片离心机LX-700）离心10 s 甩干芯片上液体；
en: g. (Optional) Use a slide centrifuge (micro slide centrifuge LX-700) to centrifuge for 10 s to spin-dry the liquid on the chip.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: h.	 Glycerol 使用前离心，用移液器缓慢吸取1.2 μL Glycerol 甘油滴加到组织中央，避免产生气泡；
en: h. Centrifuge the Glycerol before use. Use a pipette to slowly aspirate 1.2 μL of Glycerol and add it dropwise to the center of the tissue, taking care to avoid creating air bubbles.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: i.	用镊子夹取盖玻片，小心将盖玻片的一端放在芯片边上，同时握住另一端，然后逐渐将盖玻片放低到芯片上直至完全覆盖芯片；待甘油浸润整张芯片后，立即拍照，避免荧光猝灭。
en: i. Use tweezers to pick up the coverslip, carefully place one end of it on the edge of the chip while holding the other end, and then gradually lower the coverslip onto the chip until it completely covers the chip; after the glycerol has infiltrated the entire chip, take images immediately to avoid fluorescence quenching.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 提前将Glycerol 置于室温平衡5 min，确保芯片完全被组织荧光染色液覆盖。
en: Equilibrate Glycerol at room temperature for 5 minutes in advance and ensure the chip is completely covered by the tissue fluorescent staining solution.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 确保芯片上没有残留的染色液。
en: Ensure there is no residual staining solution on the chip.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 请保证盖玻片使用前干净无灰尘，可使用酒精擦拭盖玻片表面或者使用空气罐吹干净。
en: Please ensure that the coverslip is clean and dust-free before use; you may wipe the coverslip surface with alcohol or use an air duster to clean it.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 3. 操作流程Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版0.5 cm*0.5 cm）使用说明书
en: 3. Operating Procedure for Stereo-seq Transcriptomics Reagent Kit (Carrier Version 0.5 cm*0.5 cm) User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 成像过程需要保证染色通道的Track 线和组织区域同时清晰且组织区域不过曝。
en: The imaging process must ensure that the Track lines of the staining channel and the tissue area are simultaneously in focus, and that the tissue area is not overexposed.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: a.	 在连接荧光显微镜的电脑中新建文件夹，以芯片号命名，也可适当注明其他相关信息；
en: a. Create a new folder on the computer connected to the fluorescence microscope, name it with the chip number, and optionally include other relevant information.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: b.	 在载物台上滴加1-2 μL 水，将Stereo-seq 芯片载体转移到显微镜载物台上，取下遮光罩。选择落射荧光扫描模式，FITC 通道，10 倍镜；
en: b. Add 1-2 μL of water onto the stage, transfer the Stereo-seq chip slide to the microscope stage, and remove the light shield. Select the epifluorescence scanning mode, FITC channel, and 10x objective lens.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: c.	 框选视野：框选芯片，减少芯片外区域；
en: c. Select field of view: Frame the chip to reduce the area outside of it;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: d.	 对焦策略：在芯片四角方向（如图：组织外有 track 线的区域）分别记录焦点，对 Track 线定焦。组织区域内每平方厘米选择 2-4 个点对组织定焦（如果组织起伏较大，可以酌情增加定焦点）；对于仅支持自动对焦策略的显微镜无需考虑本策略；
en: d. Focusing strategy: Record focus points in the four corners of the chip (as shown in the figure: the area outside the tissue where track lines are present) to focus on the track lines. Select 2-4 points per square centimeter within the tissue area to focus on the tissue (if the tissue surface is highly uneven, you may increase the number of focus points as needed); this strategy does not apply to microscopes that only support automatic focusing;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: e.	 最终成像：Track 建模点完成后，将增益（Gain）调至最小，参考拍照注意事项 e 确定最终拍照参数后开始成像，待成像完成，保存整个文件夹（原始 FOV 小图与拼接大图）；
en: e. Final imaging: After track modeling points are completed, set the gain to the minimum, determine the final imaging parameters by referring to 'Imaging Precautions e', and start imaging. Once imaging is complete, save the entire folder (containing raw FOV thumbnails and the stitched large image);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: f.	打开ImageStudio 软件的图像QC 模块，上传ssDNA 染色图，并参考软件内置的《ImageStudio 用户手册》来进行图像QC；
en: f. Open the Image QC module of the ImageStudio software, upload the ssDNA staining image, and refer to the built-in "ImageStudio User Manual" to perform image QC.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: g.	 拍照后，用镊子将盖玻片轻轻推至载玻片边缘，夹在盖玻片一角；
en: g. After taking the photo, use tweezers to gently push the coverslip to the edge of the slide, and grip it at one corner.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: h.	 用镊子轻轻地平行移动盖玻片，直到芯片与盖玻片完全分离；
en: h. Use tweezers to gently move the coverslip in parallel until the chip is completely separated from the coverslip.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: i.	将载体置于装有30 mL 0.1X SSC 的50 mL 离心管中浸泡3-5 s；
en: i. Immerse the carrier in a 50 mL centrifuge tube containing 30 mL of 0.1X SSC for 3-5 s;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: j.	取出载玻片，用无尘纸擦去载玻片背面及芯片四周的残液，确保无液体残留。
en: j. Remove the microscope slide, use a dust-free paper to wipe off any residual liquid on the back of the slide and around the chip, ensuring no liquid remains.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 文件夹名称只使用字母、数字、下划线，禁止使用空格等特殊字符。 例：B00249A1
en: Folder names should only use letters, numbers, and underscores; spaces and other special characters are prohibited. Example: B00249A1
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 获得的 ssDNA 染色图需要通过 QC 才能开展进一步的图像分析(register)。
en: The obtained ssDNA staining images must pass QC before further image analysis (registration) can be carried out.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 确保芯片全部浸没于溶液中。
en: Ensure that the chip is completely immersed in the solution.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 如果QC 失败，请仔细检查图像清晰度，调整拍照方法进行二次拍照以确保可以获得清晰的组织及Track 线图像。若二次拍照QC 仍失败，继续实验。实验结束可联系FAS 帮助排查问题。
en: If QC fails, please carefully check the image clarity, adjust the imaging method, and retake the photos to ensure that clear images of the tissue and track lines can be obtained. If the second QC attempt still fails, proceed with the experiment. After the experiment, you can contact the FAS for assistance in troubleshooting the issue.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 3. 操作流程Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装（载体版0.5 cm*0.5 cm）使用说明书
en: 3. Operating Procedures: Instruction Manual for Stereo-seq Transcriptome Reagent Kit (Carrier version 0.5 cm * 0.5 cm)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: a.	 显微镜扫片时请勿触碰显微镜所在平面，周边不能有包括行走的震源;
en: a. During microscopic slide scanning, please do not touch the surface where the microscope is located, and ensure there are no sources of vibration nearby, including walking;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: b.	 显微镜扫描荧光染色图像时，尽量避免过曝，可通过图像像素统计情况（如：直方图）来判断，刚好不过曝情况为：直方图曲率适中不贴边，既直方图横坐标最大值处仅有微小突起;
en: b. When scanning fluorescence-stained images with the microscope, try to avoid overexposure. This can be assessed using image pixel statistics (e.g., a histogram). The optimal state without overexposure is: the histogram curve is moderate and does not touch the edges, meaning there is only a slight protrusion at the maximum value on the horizontal axis;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: c.	 在拍照过程中请勿将贴有组织的芯片长时间照射荧光，非拍照时间关闭激光，避免长时间照射;
en: c. During the imaging process, do not expose the tissue-mounted chip to fluorescence for an extended period. Turn off the laser when not capturing images to avoid prolonged irradiation;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: d.	 推荐使用手动对焦，按照上文策略在芯片四角和组织内分别定焦，以此同时获得清晰的 Track 线和染色图像;
en: d. It is recommended to use manual focus. Follow the strategy described above to set focus separately at the four corners of the chip and within the tissue, so as to simultaneously obtain clear Track lines and stained images.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: e.	 手动定焦拍照过程中有多次曝光和灯光强度参数调整，为进行 Track 线对焦，可以拉高增益（Gain）和灯光强度。Track 线选点之后，对组织进行对焦时，将增益降到最低，灯光强度降低到组织区域不过曝（参考注意事项 b）。在整体扫描前，选择图像上占据较大面积，又较亮的区域（如图红色框内区域），调节曝光时间（不超过 500 ms）和灯光强度（在 500 ms 曝光不能满足需求时增大光强）使该区域刚好不过曝( 参考注意事项 b)，以保证在能够获取 Track 线情况下仅有少量区域过曝；
en: e. During the manual focusing and imaging process, there will be multiple adjustments to exposure and light intensity parameters. To focus on the Track lines, you can increase the Gain and light intensity. After selecting points for the Track lines, when focusing on the tissue, reduce the Gain to the minimum and lower the light intensity until the tissue area is not overexposed (refer to Note b). Before the overall scanning, select a relatively bright area that occupies a larger portion of the image (such as the area within the red box in the figure), and adjust the exposure time (not exceeding 500 ms) and light intensity (increase the light intensity if the 500 ms exposure is insufficient) so that this area is just not overexposed (refer to Note b), ensuring that only a small number of areas are overexposed while still being able to acquire the Track lines.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: f.	如果在甘油封片过程中，存在较大区域（超过 4 个视野大小）未被甘油浸润，则需要对此区域增加建模点;
en: f. If there are large areas (exceeding 4 fields of view) that are not infiltrated by glycerol during the glycerol mounting process, it is necessary to add modeling points for these areas.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: g.	 谨慎使用自动对焦模式，大部分自动对焦策略无法对 Track 线精确定焦，容易造成 QC 失败，同时还有可能造成荧光淬灭。
en: g. Exercise caution when using autofocus mode, as most autofocus strategies cannot achieve precise focus on the Track line, easily leading to QC failure and potentially causing fluorescence quenching.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

en: d. Refer to step 1.6. Assemble the gasket and clamp into a carrier (without the chip slide). Place the carrier onto the PCR adapter, close the PCR instrument lid, and incubate at 37°C for 10 min. en: e. After incubation of the holder is complete, fix the carrier onto the holder to assemble the handheld holder, ensuring that the 8 buckles of the fixture are fastened and both sides of the carrier are flush against both sides of the fixture;

source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 本试剂套装推荐使用VAHTS DNA Clean Beads 或AMPure® XP（Agencourt, Cat. No. A63882）进行磁珠纯化。如果使用其他品牌的磁珠，纯化条件需要重新摸索。
en: This reagent kit recommends using VAHTS DNA Clean Beads or AMPure® XP (Agencourt, Cat. No. A63882) for magnetic bead purification. If using magnetic beads of other brands, purification conditions need to be re-optimized.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: •	 提前30 min 从4℃取出，涡旋混匀且平衡至室温，有利于保证回收效率。
en: • Remove from 4°C 30 minutes in advance, vortex to mix well, and equilibrate to room temperature to help ensure recovery efficiency.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: •	 磁珠每次使用前，需振荡或用移液器上下吸打，确保充分混匀。
en: • Before each use, the magnetic beads must be vortexed or pipetted up and down to ensure they are fully resuspended.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: •	 磁珠使用量直接影响纯化得到的DNA 片段分布。磁珠用量越高，纯化得到的DNA 片段的下限长度越小。
en: • The amount of magnetic beads used directly affects the size distribution of the purified DNA fragments. A higher amount of magnetic beads results in a lower cutoff length for the purified DNA fragments.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 磁珠操作注意事项
en: Precautions for Magnetic Bead Handling
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: •	 样本与磁珠充分混匀后置于磁力架上进行分离时，请于溶液彻底澄清后再吸取上清，一般需要2-3 min。但由于磁力架吸力不同等原因，推荐分离时间有时可能需要延长，以液体彻底澄清为准。
en: • When placing the sample and magnetic beads on a magnetic stand for separation after thorough mixing, please wait until the solution is completely clear before aspirating the supernatant, which generally takes 2-3 minutes. However, due to variations in magnetic stand strength, the recommended separation time may sometimes need to be extended; the solution becoming completely clear should be the determining criterion.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: •	 在分离磁珠与液体时，注意吸头不可碰到磁珠，最后可余留2-3 μL 液体，以避免吸到磁珠。若不慎吸到磁珠，可将磁珠与液体全部打回管内，再次分离后再吸取上清。
en: • When separating the magnetic beads from the liquid, take care not to let the pipette tip touch the magnetic beads. It is advisable to leave 2-3 μL of liquid behind to avoid aspirating the beads. If the beads are accidentally aspirated, dispense the beads and liquid back into the tube, perform the separation again, and then aspirate the supernatant.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: •	 磁珠乙醇漂洗应使用新鲜配制并平衡至室温的80% 乙醇。漂洗过程中离心管应始终置于磁力架上，移液器吸头应在远离磁力架的管壁上操作，请勿吸打、搅动磁珠。
en: • Magnetic bead ethanol washing should use 80% ethanol that is freshly prepared and equilibrated to room temperature. During the washing process, the centrifuge tube should always be placed on the magnetic rack. The pipette tip should be operated on the tube wall away from the magnetic rack; do not pipette up and down or agitate the magnetic beads.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: •	 第二次乙醇漂洗应尽量吸干管底液体。若有少量液体残留在管壁，可将离心管瞬时离心，在磁力架上分离后，用小量程的移液器把管底液体吸干。
en: • For the second ethanol wash, try to aspirate all liquid from the bottom of the tube. If a small amount of liquid remains on the tube wall, the centrifuge tube can be pulse-centrifuged. After separation on the magnetic rack, use a low-volume pipette to aspirate the liquid at the bottom.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: •	 两次乙醇漂洗后，应在室温下充分干燥磁珠。干燥不充分（磁珠表面反光）容易造成乙醇残留，影响后续反应，过度干燥（磁珠开裂）会降低回收得率。通常情况下，室温干燥需要5-10 min，但由于室内温度和湿度的差异，干燥时间可能会不同，应随时观察。直至磁珠表面无反光，即可用TE Buffer 或 Nuclease-Free Water 进行产物洗脱。
en: • After the two ethanol washes, the magnetic beads should be fully dried at room temperature. Insufficient drying (the magnetic beads appear reflective) can easily cause ethanol residue, which affects subsequent reactions, while excessive drying (the magnetic beads crack) will reduce the recovery yield. Typically, room temperature drying takes 5-10 minutes, but due to variations in indoor temperature and humidity, the drying time may vary and should be monitored. Once the surface of the magnetic beads is no longer reflective, the product can be eluted with TE Buffer or Nuclease-Free Water.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: •	 洗脱后吸取上清时，切忌触碰磁珠，若吸到磁珠可能会影响后续的纯化反应。所以，最终吸取的上清可比用于洗脱的TE Buffer 或 Nuclease-Free Water 的体积少~2 μL。
en: • When aspirating the supernatant after elution, strictly avoid touching the magnetic beads, as aspiration of beads may affect subsequent purification reactions. Therefore, the final volume of supernatant aspirated can be ~2 μL less than the volume of TE Buffer or Nuclease-Free Water used for elution.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: •	 在1.5 mL 磁力架上开关管盖应避免剧烈震动导致磁珠或液体弹出，建议用手指固定住1.5 mL 离心管中下段，然后开盖。
en: • When opening or closing the tube cap while on the magnetic rack, avoid vigorous vibration to prevent magnetic beads or liquid from being ejected. It is recommended to hold the middle-lower section of the 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube with your fingers before opening the cap.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: a.  cDNA 回收液如果观察到有白色沉淀析出，可放于 55℃溶解，恢复至室温后进行纯化。提前 30 min 取出磁珠， 平衡至室温；

zh: b.  1X 磁珠cDNA 纯化步骤：
en: b. 1X cDNA purification with magnetic beads steps:
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 1）将上一步回收液（450-490 μL）与室温平衡好的磁珠按照1 : 1 混合，震荡混匀，室温孵育10 min；
en: 1) Mix the recovery solution from the previous step (450-490 μL) with the magnetic beads equilibrated to room temperature at a 1:1 ratio, vortex to mix, and incubate at room temperature for 10 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 2）瞬时离心后，将离心管放在磁力架上静置3 min；
en: 2) After brief centrifugation, place the centrifuge tube on a magnetic stand and let it stand for 3 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 3）待液体澄清后，用移液器小心去除上清（如果管盖上有泡沫，吸弃泡沫）；
en: 3) Once the liquid is clear, carefully remove the supernatant with a pipette (if there is foam on the tube lid, aspirate and discard it);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 4）将离心管保持在磁力架上，加入1 mL 80% 乙醇（使用新鲜配制并平衡至室温的80% 乙醇），旋转磁力架上的离心管，待磁珠全部吸附到靠磁力架一侧的管壁，再次旋离心管，让磁珠重新吸附到另一侧来漂洗磁珠。静置30 s，小心吸取并丢弃上清;
en: 4) While keeping the centrifuge tube on the magnetic stand, add 1 mL of 80% ethanol (use freshly prepared 80% ethanol equilibrated to room temperature). Rotate the tube on the magnetic stand; once the magnetic beads have fully migrated to the wall against the magnet, rotate the tube again to allow the beads to migrate to the opposite side to wash them. Let stand for 30 seconds, then carefully aspirate and discard the supernatant;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 5）重复一次步骤4）；
en: 5) Repeat step 4 once);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 6）将离心管保持在磁力架上，室温风干5-8 min，直至磁珠表面无反光、无开裂；
en: 6) Keep the centrifuge tube on the magnetic stand and air-dry at room temperature for 5-8 min, until the surface of the magnetic beads is non-reflective and free of cracks;

zh: 7）先加22 μL Nuclease-Free Water 回溶，震荡混匀后室温静置5 min，瞬时离心，磁力架静置 3-5 min，直至液体变澄清；
en: 7) Add 22 μL of Nuclease-Free Water to resuspend, vortex to mix, incubate at room temperature for 5 min, centrifuge briefly, and place on the magnetic stand for 3-5 min until the liquid becomes clear;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 8）将上清（~21 μL cDNA）转移至新的0.2 mL PCR 管中；
en: 8) Transfer the supernatant (~21 μL cDNA) to a new 0.2 mL PCR tube;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 9）再将 22 μL Nuclease-Free Water 加入步骤7 的磁珠中二次回溶，震荡混匀后室温静置 5 min，瞬时离心，磁力架静置 3-5 min，直至液体变澄清；
en: 9) Add 22 μL of Nuclease-Free Water to the magnetic beads from step 7 for a secondary resuspension, vortex to mix, incubate at room temperature for 5 min, centrifuge briefly, and place on a magnetic stand for 3-5 min until the liquid becomes clear;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 10）将上清（~21 μL cDNA）转移至步骤8 的 PCR 管中，合并总体积~42 μL。
en: 10) Transfer the supernatant (~21 μL cDNA) to the PCR tube from step 8, combining for a total volume of ~42 μL.

zh: 移液器吸头应在远离磁力架的管壁上操作，请勿吸打、搅动磁珠（如果管盖上有泡沫，建议用 80%乙醇清洗干净）。
en: The pipette tip should be operated against the tube wall away from the magnetic rack; do not pipette up and down or disturb the magnetic beads (if there is foam on the tube cap, it is recommended to clean it with 80% ethanol).

zh: c.  如果上述回收样品不足42 μL，用Nuclease-Free Water 补足。

zh: 1）将PCR 产物（100 μL）与室温平衡好的磁珠按照1 : 1 混合，震荡混匀，室温孵育10 min；
en: 1) Mix the PCR products (100 μL) with magnetic beads equilibrated to room temperature at a 1:1 ratio, vortex to mix, and incubate at room temperature for 10 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 2）瞬时离心后，将PCR 管放在磁力架上静置3 min，待液体澄清后去除上清；
en: 2) After brief centrifugation, place the PCR tube on a magnetic stand and let it stand for 3 minutes until the liquid becomes clear, then remove the supernatant;

zh: 3）将离心管保持在磁力架上，加入200 μL 80% 乙醇漂洗（新鲜配制并平衡至室温的80% 乙醇）。通过旋转磁力架上的离心管来漂洗磁珠。静置30 s，小心吸取并丢弃上清。移液器吸头应在远离磁力架的管壁上操作，请勿吸打、搅动磁珠；
en: 3) Keep the centrifuge tube on the magnetic stand, add 200 μL of 80% ethanol for washing (freshly prepared 80% ethanol equilibrated to room temperature). Wash the magnetic beads by rotating the centrifuge tube on the magnetic stand. Let it stand for 30 seconds, then carefully aspirate and discard the supernatant. The pipette tip should be operated on the tube wall away from the magnetic stand; do not pipette up and down or agitate the magnetic beads;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_转录组试剂套装（载体版，0.5_x_0.5）使用说明书-B

zh: 4）重复一次步骤3；

zh: 5）将离心管保持在磁力架上，打开盖子，室温风干5-8 min，直至磁珠表面无反光、无开裂；
en: 5) Keep the centrifuge tube on the magnetic stand, open the lid, and air-dry at room temperature for 5-8 min until the surface of the magnetic beads is no longer reflective and appears crack-free.

zh: STOmics Stereo-seq 透化试剂套装（载体版）是用于摸索组织切片最佳透化时间的预实验试剂套装。本试剂套装采用的Stereo-seq 时空转录组技术，是一种基于DNBSEQ 高通量测序技术开发的、具有高分辨大视场的原位全转录组信息捕获技术。Stereo-seq 芯片P（透化测试芯片）上载有核苷酸捕获探针，与组织切片结合后通过探针原位抓取组织内的mRNA 分子，再利用带有荧光标记的核苷酸进行cDNA 合成。研究人员通过荧光显微成像可以快速判断特定组织的最佳透化时间, 若同时将蛋白检测技术融入标准Stereo-seq 透化测试实验流程中，还可以快速判断兼容蛋白组的特定组织的最佳透化时间。
en: The STOmics Stereo-seq Permeabilization Reagent Kit (Slide version) is a pre-experimental kit used to determine the optimal permeabilization time for tissue sections. The Stereo-seq spatial transcriptomics technology employed in this kit is an in situ whole-transcriptome information capture technology with high resolution and a large field of view, developed based on DNBSEQ high-throughput sequencing technology. Stereo-seq Chip P (permeabilization test chip) is loaded with nucleotide capture probes, which bind to tissue sections to capture mRNA molecules within the tissue in situ, followed by cDNA synthesis using fluorescently labeled nucleotides. Researchers can quickly determine the optimal permeabilization time for a specific tissue through fluorescence microscopy. If protein detection technology is also integrated into the standard Stereo-seq permeabilization test workflow, the optimal permeabilization time for specific tissues compatible with proteomics can also be rapidly determined.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: Stereo-seq 芯片载体保存方法
en: Storage Method for Stereo-seq Chip Slides
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: Stereo-seq 芯片载体装于真空密封的铝袋中，冷链运输。收到产品后须立即将未开封的Stereo-seq 芯片P/T 载体储存在−20℃或4℃。若拆袋后未使用，需重新干燥密封并储存在−20℃或4℃。
en: Stereo-seq chip slides are packed in vacuum-sealed aluminum bags and transported via cold chain. Upon receipt, unopened Stereo-seq chip P/T carriers must be immediately stored at −20°C or 4°C. If the bag has been opened but the chip has not been used, it must be re-dried, resealed, and stored at −20°C or 4°C.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 需在铝制密封袋中放入干燥剂以保持干燥条件。重新密封的芯片不可放置超过两周。
en: A desiccant must be placed inside the sealed aluminum bag to maintain dry conditions. Resealed chips should not be stored for more than two weeks.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

en: • This product is for research use only and is not intended for clinical diagnostic procedures. Please read this manual carefully before use.

zh: •	 实验前请熟悉需使用的各种仪器的注意事项并掌握其操作方法。
en: • Before beginning the experiment, please familiarize yourself with the precautions and operating methods for all instruments required.

en: • The experimental protocols provided in this manual are general guidelines. In practice, experimental procedures and reaction parameters may be adjusted based on specific experimental designs, sample characteristics, sequencing applications, and equipment used to optimize performance and efficiency.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: •	 推荐使用前将各试剂组分提前取出，将酶类组分瞬时离心后置于冰上备用，并将其他组分置于室温解冻。解冻后轻柔地上下颠倒数次使其充分混匀，瞬时离心后置于冰上备用。
en: • It is recommended to remove all reagent components in advance before use. Briefly centrifuge the enzyme components and place them on ice, while thawing the other components at room temperature. After thawing, gently invert the tubes several times to mix thoroughly, then briefly centrifuge and place on ice until needed.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: •	 为避免样本交叉污染，推荐使用带滤芯的吸头，吸取不同样本时请更换吸头。
en: • To avoid sample cross-contamination, it is recommended to use aerosol-resistant (filter) pipette tips. Please change tips when pipetting different samples.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: •	 推荐把PCR 仪温度预热至反应温度。
en: • It is recommended to preheat the PCR thermal cycler to the reaction temperature.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: •	 应避免皮肤和眼睛直接接触样本及试剂，切勿吞咽样本及试剂，一旦发生意外请立即用大量清水冲洗并及时就医。
en: • Avoid direct contact of samples and reagents with skin and eyes; do not swallow samples or reagents. In case of accidental contact, rinse immediately with plenty of water and seek medical attention.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: •	 所有样本和各种废弃物均应按相关法规规定处理。
en: • All samples and various wastes should be disposed of in accordance with relevant regulations.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 2. 操作流程Stereo-seq 透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书
en: 2. Operational Workflow for the Stereo-seq Permeabilization Reagent Kit (Carrier-based, Proteomics Compatible) Instruction Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 本实验用于稀释试剂的液体，除特殊说明外，均使用Nuclease - Free Water。
en: Unless otherwise specified, Nuclease-Free Water is used for all liquids intended for reagent dilution in this experiment.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 准备试剂准备流程  储存
en: Reagent Preparation Process Storage
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 4% PFA−20℃取出融化后混匀，再分装每管 2 mL−20℃
en: Remove 4% PFA from -20°C, thaw and mix well, then aliquot into 2 mL per tube and store at -20°C.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 5X SSC取20X SSC 5 mL 用Nuclease-Free Water 稀释到20 mL室温
en: For 5X SSC: take 5 mL of 20X SSC and dilute to 20 mL with Nuclease-Free Water; keep at room temperature.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 0.1X SSC取20X SSC 100 μL 用 Nuclease-Free Water 稀释到20 mL室温
en: For 0.1X SSC: take 100 μL of 20X SSC and dilute to 20 mL with Nuclease-Free Water; keep at room temperature.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: Wash Buffer取105 μL RI 加入1995 μL 0.1X SSC 中( 一张芯片至少用量2100 μL）   冰上备用
en: For Wash Buffer: take 105 μL of RI and add to 1995 μL of 0.1X SSC (minimum volume per chip is 2100 μL); keep on ice for use.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 提前取出血清，融化后，马血清与山羊血清按 1：1 混合，用 0.22 μm 滤膜（针筒式过滤器配套一次性无菌注射器）进行过滤后分装，建议分装 200 μL/ 管（一轮的透化+ 蛋白转录组），分装后不可反复冻融超过 3 次。实验之前，−20℃取出分装血清融化， 4℃，14000g 离心 10 min，冰上备用。
en: Take out the serum in advance. After it thaws, mix horse serum and goat serum at a 1:1 ratio, filter using a 0.22 μm filter membrane (syringe filter coupled with a disposable sterile syringe), and then aliquot. It is recommended to aliquot 200 μL per tube (for one round of permeabilization + protein transcriptome). After aliquoting, do not freeze and thaw repeatedly more than 3 times. Before the experiment, take out the aliquoted serum from -20°C to thaw, centrifuge at 4°C and 14,000g for 10 min, and keep it on ice for use.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: RI−20℃取出冰上备用−20℃
en: RI Take out from -20°C and keep on ice for use -20°C
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 10% Triton X-100若无10% Triton X-100，可将100% Triton X-100 用Nuclease-Free Water 稀释室温
en: 10% Triton X-100: If 10% Triton X-100 is unavailable, 100% Triton X-100 can be diluted with Nuclease-Free Water. (Room Temperature)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 0.01N HCl按照HCl 浓度梯度稀释到0.01N，pH 值准确到2（确保pH 值在1.9-2.1 范围内；至少2 mL/ 样本）   室温48 hr
en: 0.01N HCl: Dilute HCl according to the concentration gradient to 0.01N, with the pH accurately adjusted to 2 (ensure the pH value is in the range of 1.9-2.1; at least 2 mL/sample). (Room Temperature, 48 hours)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 0.01N HCl (pH = 2.0 ) 需现配现用。对于预制的0.1N HCl 和新购买的HCl，实验前请检查pH 值。储存时间超过48 hr 将影响预期pH 值，请在配制后48 hr 内使用。
en: 0.01N HCl (pH = 2.0): Prepare immediately before use. For pre-prepared 0.1N HCl and newly purchased HCl, please check the pH value before the experiment. Storage for more than 48 hours will affect the expected pH value; please use it within 48 hours after preparation.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 10X 透化试剂储存液PR Enzyme（红盖、粉末状）短暂离心，加入1 mL 新鲜配制的0.01N HCl，通过移液器吹打混匀（可分装成若干份）   −20℃
en: Briefly centrifuge the 10X Permeabilization Reagent PR Enzyme (red cap, powder). Add 1 mL of freshly prepared 0.01N HCl and mix by pipetting (can be aliquoted into several portions). Store at −20°C.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 不要涡旋透化酶，可通过移液器吹打混匀。建议对配制好的10X 透化试剂储存液进行分装，避免反复冻融。
en: Do not vortex the permeabilization enzyme; mix by pipetting. It is recommended to aliquot the prepared 10X Permeabilization Reagent stock solution to avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 1X 透化试剂工作液用0.01N HCl 将15 μL 10X 透化试剂储存液稀释到150 μL（至少150 μL/ 芯片）   冰上备用6 hr
en: 1X Permeabilization Reagent working solution: Dilute 15 μL of 10X Permeabilization Reagent stock solution to 150 μL using 0.01N HCl (at least 150 μL/chip). Keep on ice; stable for 6 hours.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: Decrosslinking      Reagent              −20℃取出恢复至室温室温
en: Decrosslinking Reagent - Remove from -20°C and allow to warm to room temperature. Room temperature.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 准备仪器准备流程  备注
en: Instrument Preparation Procedure  Remarks
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 按顺序依次设定：37℃用于烤片和透化（热盖42℃）70℃用于解交联（热盖 75℃）42℃用于反转录（热盖47℃）55℃用于组织移除（热盖60℃）
en: Set in sequence: 37°C for slide baking and permeabilization (lid temperature 42°C), 70°C for de-crosslinking (lid temperature 75°C), 42°C for reverse transcription (lid temperature 47°C), and 55°C for tissue removal (lid temperature 60°C).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 检查PCR 仪是否有异常，必要时更换
en: Check the PCR instrument for any abnormalities and replace it if necessary.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 金属浴( 或其他同等功能仪器)37℃用于透化酶预热                                              70℃用于解交联试剂预热-
en: Use a metal bath (or other equivalent equipment) set to 37°C for preheating the permeabilization enzyme and 70°C for preheating the de-crosslinking reagent.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 荧光显微镜TRITC 通道-
en: Fluorescence microscope TRITC channel-
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 离心机提前将离心机温度调节到 4℃离心血清
en: Centrifuge: Pre-cool to 4°C for serum centrifugation
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 2. 操作流程Stereo-seq 透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书
en: 2. Operational Protocol for Stereo-seq Permeabilization Reagent Kit (Slide-compatible Proteomics) Instruction Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: a. 提前将PCR 仪温度设置到37℃，热盖温度为42℃，放置PCR 适配器平衡温度；
en: a. Pre-set the PCR instrument temperature to 37°C and the heated lid temperature to 42°C, and place the PCR adapter to equilibrate the temperature;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: b. 冷冻切片机箱体预冷至−20℃，样本头预冷至−15℃ ~ −10℃（根据实际操作过程调整）；
en: b. Pre-cool the cryostat chamber to −20°C and the specimen head to −15°C ~ −10°C (adjust according to actual operation);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: c. 提前将毛刷、刀片和镊子等置于箱体预冷；
en: c. Place the brush, blade, forceps, etc., in the chamber to pre-cool in advance;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: d. 将OCT 包埋的组织块从−80℃冰箱取出，放在冷冻切片机内平衡30 min；
en: d. Take the OCT-embedded tissue block out of the -80°C freezer and place it in the cryostat to equilibrate for 30 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: e. 组织平衡等待期间，参考2.5. 封闭和模拟抗体孵育中的表格2-1 准备下一步封闭以及模拟抗体孵育步骤需要的封闭液（需制备5 片组织的用量，含阳参），置于冰上备用；
en: e. During the tissue equilibration, refer to Table 2-1 in 2.5 "Blocking and mock antibody incubation" to prepare the blocking buffer needed for the subsequent blocking and mock antibody incubation steps (prepare enough for 5 tissue sections, including the positive control), and keep it on ice for later use;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: f. 组织温度平衡过程，提前从4℃冰箱取出足量4% PFA 溶液于离心管内平衡至室温；
en: f. During the tissue temperature equilibration process, take out a sufficient amount of 4% PFA solution from the 4°C refrigerator into a centrifuge tube in advance and equilibrate to room temperature;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: g. 使用OCT 将组织块固定到样品托上；
en: g. Use OCT to mount the tissue block onto the sample holder.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: h. 将组织块修剪成合适的尺寸（切面小于0.9 cm × 0.9 cm），切去组织块周围过多的OCT，保留一部分OCT，方便转移组织；
en: h. Trim the tissue block to an appropriate size (cross-section smaller than 0.9 cm × 0.9 cm), removing excess OCT around the tissue block while retaining a small amount to facilitate tissue transfer.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: i. 根据需要对组织块做最后地修剪，以确保组织切片能更好地适配芯片，随后可进行冷冻切片。
en: i. Perform final trimming of the tissue block as needed to ensure the tissue sections better fit the chip, then proceed with cryosectioning.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 样本头温度过低会导致切片出现裂纹，样本头温度过高会导致切片出现褶皱，请根据样本情况将冻头调整到合适温度。
en: If the specimen head temperature is too low, cracks will appear in the sections; if the temperature is too high, the sections will wrinkle. Please adjust the specimen head temperature to an appropriate level based on the sample's condition.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: a. 取芯片：从真空干燥铝箔袋中取出 Stereo-seq 芯片P 载体，记录芯片背面的编号；注意不要触碰芯片正面；
en: a. Retrieve the chip: Remove the Stereo-seq chip P carrier from the vacuum-sealed aluminum foil bag and record the serial number on the back of the chip. Be careful not to touch the front surface of the chip.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: b. 将载体置于桌面上复温1 min，观察芯片表面是否有杂质，如芯片上存在杂质，使用100 μL Nuclease-Free Water 清洗2 次，可参考图a（或在含40-50 mL Nuclease-Free Water 的离心管中清洗2 次，可参考图b)；
en: b. Place the carrier on the table and let it reach room temperature for 1 minute. Observe the surface of the chip for impurities. If there are impurities on the chip, wash it twice using 100 μL of Nuclease-Free Water (refer to Figure a), or wash it twice in a centrifuge tube containing 40-50 mL of Nuclease-Free Water (refer to Figure b).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 打开后，请检查玻片盒中的所有的 Stereo-seq 芯片载体是否正确定位在插槽中，载体上的芯片是否正面朝上。芯片的正面为亮光面，正面含有用于 mRNA 捕获的探针。请勿触碰到芯片表面。
en: After opening, please check that all Stereo-seq chip slides in the slide box are correctly positioned in the slots and that the chips on the carriers are facing up. The front side of the chip is the glossy side and contains probes for mRNA capture. Do not touch the chip surface.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 温度时间  循环数
en: Temperature Time Cycle Number
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 42℃热盖on-
en: 42°C, Heated Lid on-
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

en: 37°C 5 min 1
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 37℃Hold-
en: 37°C Hold-
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 2. 操作流程Stereo-seq 透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书
en: 2. Operational Procedure: Stereo-seq Permeabilization Reagent Kit (Substrate Version, Proteomics Compatible) Instruction Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: c. 清洗后用气瓶吹干芯片四周及表面，再用无尘纸吸干载玻片背面和周围多余的液体；
en: c. After washing, dry the perimeter and surface of the chip using an air duster, then use a lint-free wipe to absorb excess liquid from the back and around the slide;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: d. 当芯片表面无杂质、无明显痕迹、无任何液体残留、无波纹状纹理，即可准备贴片；
en: d. When the chip surface is free of impurities, obvious marks, any liquid residue, and wavy textures, it is ready for mounting;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: e. 将组织包埋块固定至冻头上，修片；
en: e. Secure the tissue embedding block onto the cryochuck and trim the block;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: f. 组织贴片有两种操作方式可选：热贴（A）和冷贴（B）。根据需求选择切片厚度，通常为10 μm。
en: f. There are two optional methods for tissue mounting: thermal mounting (A) and cold mounting (B). Select the section thickness according to requirements, typically 10 μm.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 1）连续切取组织切片，将切片移到切片台右侧靠近边缘处，然后用预冷的毛刷轻轻拨动切片周围的OCT 使切片铺平，每张切片放置间隔距离大于载体宽度；
en: 1) Continuously cut tissue sections, move them to the area near the edge on the right side of the sectioning stage, and then use a pre-cooled brush to gently manipulate the OCT around the sections to flatten them, ensuring the spacing between each section is greater than the width of the carrier;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 2）拿起载体的一边，使芯片正面朝下，对准切片；
en: 2) Pick up the carrier by one side, position the chip face down, and align it with the section;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 3）轻轻一压，肉眼可见切片已经吸附到芯片表面；
en: 3) Apply gentle pressure, and the slice can be visibly seen adhering to the chip surface;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 4）重复 2）-3）步骤操作，直至全部组织切片吸附到芯片表面（贴片时间控制在1 min 以内）；
en: 4) Repeat steps 2)-3) until all tissue slices are adhered to the chip surface (control the mounting time within 1 min);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 5）将芯片正面朝上，快速将载体置于提前平衡温度的PCR 适配器上，37℃孵育5 min，无需盖PCR 热盖。
en: 5) Place the chip face up, quickly place the carrier onto a pre-temperature-equilibrated PCR adapter, and incubate at 37°C for 5 min; there is no need to close the PCR heated lid.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 2. 操作流程Stereo-seq 透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书
en: 2. Operation Procedure: Stereo-seq Permeabilization Reagent Kit (Slide-compatible for Proteomics) User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 3）立即拿起芯片载体，用指腹放在载体背面加温几秒钟，直至切片贴合；
en: 3) Immediately pick up the slide, and place your fingertip on the back of the slide to warm it for a few seconds until the section is firmly attached;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 4）重复上述操作，直至所有切片贴片完成，建议组织切片贴片控制在5 min 内；
en: 4) Repeat the above steps until all sections are mounted; it is recommended to complete the section mounting within 5 minutes.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 5）快速将载体置于PCR 适配器上37℃孵育5 min，无需盖PCR 热盖。
en: 5) Quickly place the carrier onto the PCR adapter and incubate at 37°C for 5 minutes; do not engage the PCR thermal lid.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 1)  将载体芯片正面朝上置于切片机中，预冷1-6 min；
en: 1) Place the carrier chip in the cryostat with the front side facing up and pre-cool for 1-6 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 2）进行冷冻切片，然后用预冷的毛刷轻轻拨动切片周围的OCT 使切片铺平。用镊子和毛刷将切片小心覆盖在芯片正中央并铺平，注意毛刷不要触碰到组织。尽量一次贴片成功，确保组织切片完整，无褶皱；
en: 2）Perform cryosectioning, then gently use a pre-cooled brush to push the OCT around the section to flatten it. Use tweezers and a brush to carefully cover the section in the center of the chip and flatten it; be careful not to let the brush touch the tissue. Try to achieve successful placement on the first attempt, ensuring the tissue section is intact and free of wrinkles;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 如需在同一个载体的不同芯片上贴2 个不同组织的切片，建议将两个组织都修好片后，先对一个组织切片，使用热贴方式贴片，将载体放至PCR 适配器上37℃等待贴下一个组织，等待时间控制在5 min 以内；然后换另外一个组织切片，使用热贴方式贴片，快速将载体置于PCR适配器上37℃孵育5 min。
en: If it is necessary to place 2 different tissue sections on different chips of the same carrier, it is recommended that after both tissues have been trimmed, section one tissue first, perform thermal placement, and place the carrier on a PCR adapter at 37°C while waiting to place the next tissue, keeping the waiting time within 5 min; then switch to the other tissue section, perform thermal placement, and quickly place the carrier on the PCR adapter for incubation at 37°C for 5 min.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 预冷时间不可过长，以免玻片表面产生水雾；预冷时间不可太短，以免玻片无法达到预冷温度。
en: The pre-cooling time should not be too long to avoid condensation on the slide surface; nor should it be too short, to ensure the slide reaches the required pre-cooling temperature.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 进行冷贴时需控制好每张切片贴片时间，间隔时间太大，组织贴片会皱缩。
en: During cold mounting, the time for mounting each section must be strictly controlled; excessive intervals will cause the tissue sections to wrinkle.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: （可选暂停点）将孵育好的芯片载体放于玻片盒或者50 mL 离心管，用干冰快速转移到−80℃冰箱，最长可于−80℃保存一个月。
en: (Optional stopping point) Place the incubated chip slide into a slide box or a 50 mL centrifuge tube, transfer it rapidly to a −80°C freezer using dry ice; it can be stored at −80°C for up to one month.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 继续实验时，使用干冰将玻片盒或者50 mL 离心管转移，取出贴有组织的芯片载体，快速置于PCR 适配器上37℃孵育5 min。
en: When continuing the experiment, transfer the slide box or 50 mL centrifuge tube using dry ice, remove the chip slide with the tissue attached, and quickly place it on the PCR adapter to incubate at 37°C for 5 min.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: a. 参考《Stereo-seq 芯片载体及配件使用说明书》第二章将垫圈与夹具组合成载具；
en: a. Refer to Chapter 2 of the "Stereo-seq Chip Slide and Accessories Instruction Manual" to assemble the gasket and clamp into a carrier;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: b. 将上一步孵育完成的芯片载体固定于载具上，组合成手持载具，确保夹具8 个卡扣扣紧并且载体两侧贴紧夹具两侧 ；
en: b. Fix the incubated chip slide from the previous step onto the carrier to assemble it into a handheld carrier, ensuring that all 8 clips of the clamp are fastened securely and that both sides of the chip slide are flush against the sides of the clamp;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: c. 将载具置于通风橱内操作，加入4% PFA 溶液，用量为400 μL/ 芯片，撕掉封板膜上的白膜，用透明的封板膜封口，固定10 min；
en: c. Place the carrier in a fume hood to operate; add 4% PFA solution at a dosage of 400 μL/chip, peel off the white film from the sealing film, seal with a transparent sealing film, and fix for 10 minutes;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: d. 固定完成后，撕开封板膜，微微倾斜手持载具，倾斜角度小于20°，用移液器在芯片一角吸弃4% PFA 溶液，注意保持芯片组织湿润；
en: d. After fixation, remove the sealing film, hold the carrier and tilt it slightly, with an angle of less than 20°, and use a pipette to aspirate and discard the 4% PFA solution from one corner of the chip, taking care to keep the chip tissue moist;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 避免载具接触芯片正面。
en: Avoid contact between the carrier and the front side of the chip.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 2. 操作流程Stereo-seq 透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书
en: 2. Operating Procedure for Stereo-seq Permeabilization Reagent Kit (Slide-compatible Proteomics) Instruction Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: e. 立即加入Wash Buffer，用量为400 μL/ 芯片，室温孵育1 min；
en: e. Immediately add Wash Buffer at 400 μL/chip and incubate at room temperature for 1 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: f. 微微倾斜手持载具，倾斜角度小于20°，用移液器在芯片一角吸弃Wash Buffer溶液，保持芯片组织湿润；
en: f. Slightly tilt the handheld carrier at an angle of less than 20°, aspirate the Wash Buffer solution from one corner of the chip using a pipette, and keep the chip tissue moist;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: g. 重复步骤e.-f. 一次，共计清洗2 次。
en: g. Repeat steps e.-f. once, for a total of 2 washes.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: a. 封闭：此时可将载具转移至通风橱外实验桌操作，立即将已配制好的封闭液滴加到组织表面，用量为150 μL/ 芯片，室温孵育20 min；
en: a. Blocking: At this point, the carrier can be transferred to the laboratory bench outside the fume hood for operation; immediately apply the prepared blocking solution dropwise to the surface of the tissue, using 150 μL/chip, and incubate at room temperature for 20 min.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 换液过程中避免组织干燥，避免移液器和枪头碰触到组织和芯片。
en: Avoid tissue drying during the liquid changing process, and avoid touching the tissue and chip with the pipette or pipette tip.

zh: 1) 先在透化时间为26 min 的芯片添加150 μL 1X 透化试剂。在芯片的每个角加入一滴透化试剂（移液器挨近芯片加液，注意不要划伤组织），然后将其余透化试剂加到芯片中央，使所有液体融合，确保透化试剂覆盖全芯片；
en: 1) First, add 150 μL of 1X permeabilization reagent to the chip with a permeabilization time of 26 min. Add one drop of permeabilization reagent to each corner of the chip (keep the pipette close to the chip when dispensing, and be careful not to scratch the tissue), then add the remaining permeabilization reagent to the center of the chip, allowing all the liquid to merge and ensuring the permeabilization reagent covers the entire chip;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 2) 将手持载具转移到PCR 适配器上，将新的封板膜( 撕掉封板膜上的白膜) 放置于载具上覆盖反应孔，盖上PCR 仪盖，37℃孵育；
en: 2) Transfer the handheld carrier onto the PCR adapter, place a new sealing film (after removing the white film on the sealing film) onto the carrier to cover the reaction wells, close the PCR instrument lid, and incubate at 37°C;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 3) 6 min 后，打开PCR 仪盖，掀开未加液孔上的封板膜，在透化时间为20 min 的芯片添加150 μL 1X 透化试剂；
en: 3) After 6 min, open the PCR instrument lid, lift the sealing film over the wells to which no liquid has been added, and add 150 μL of 1X permeabilization reagent to the chips with a permeabilization time of 20 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 4) 将封板膜重新放置于载具上，盖上PCR 仪盖，37℃孵育；
en: 4) Place the sealing film back onto the carrier, close the PCR instrument lid, and incubate at 37°C;

zh: 若发现组织移除不完全，有残留组织存在，可延长移除时间，以保证完全移除（不超过 16 hr），必须保证移除完全。
en: If tissue removal is found to be incomplete and residual tissue exists, the removal time can be extended to ensure complete removal (do not exceed 16 hr); complete removal must be ensured.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 如芯片表面残留明显痕迹，加入100 μl Nuclease - Free Water，用空气罐将芯片四周及表面完全吹干（该步骤可重复，直至芯片表面无明显痕迹残留）。
en: If there are obvious residues on the chip surface, add 100 μl of Nuclease-Free Water and completely dry the surroundings and surface of the chip with an air duster (this step can be repeated until there are no obvious residues left on the chip surface).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: q. 将芯片载体放置于干燥的培养皿中，用锡箔纸包裹孔板以避光，等待拍照。
en: q. Place the chip slide in a dry petri dish, wrap the plate with aluminum foil to protect it from light, and wait for imaging.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 可选操作：操作步骤 k-p 可替换为将载体从手持载具上拆下，置于 50 mL 离心管（50 mL 0.1X SSC 试剂）中上下冲洗 10 次，然后将载体置于 50 mL 离心管（50 mL Nuclease - Free Water）内上下冲洗 10 次，用空气罐 (Matin, M-6318) 将芯片表面完全吹干（该步骤可重复，直至芯片表面无明显痕迹残留）。
en: Optional: Steps k-p can be replaced by removing the carrier from the handheld holder, placing it in a 50 mL centrifuge tube (50 mL 0.1X SSC reagent) and washing it up and down 10 times, then placing the carrier in a 50 mL centrifuge tube (50 mL Nuclease-Free Water) and washing it up and down 10 times, and finally blow-drying the chip surface completely with a canned air duster (Matin, M-6318) (this step can be repeated until no obvious residue remains on the chip surface).
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: a. 在连接荧光显微镜的电脑中新建文件夹，以芯片号命名，也可适当注明其他相关信息；
en: a. Create a new folder on the computer connected to the fluorescence microscope, named by the chip number, and you may also include other relevant information as appropriate;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: b. 使用荧光显微镜（具备拼接功能），选择落射荧光扫描模式，手动选择TRITC 通道，选择4 倍镜或10 倍镜；
en: b. Using a fluorescence microscope (equipped with stitching capability), select the epifluorescence scanning mode, manually choose the TRITC channel, and select a 4x or 10x objective lens;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: c. 在载物台上滴加1-2 μL 水，小心地将芯片转移到显微镜载物台上，取下遮光罩，选择感兴趣的芯片区域；
en: c. Add 1-2 μL of water to the stage, carefully transfer the chip onto the microscope stage, remove the light shield, and select the chip area of interest;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: d. 先用4 倍镜找到目标区域，然后切换到10 倍镜，扫描整张芯片。
en: d. First use a 4x objective to locate the target area, then switch to a 10x objective to scan the entire chip.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 文件夹名称只使用字母、数字、下划线，禁止使用空格等特殊字符。 例：B00249A1
en: Folder names should only contain letters, numbers, and underscores; special characters such as spaces are prohibited. Example: B00249A1
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 同一组织不同透化时间的芯片要在相同成像条件下扫描，包括亮度和曝光等条件。
en: Chips from the same tissue with different permeabilization times must be scanned under the same imaging conditions, including brightness and exposure.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 在组织移除干净且保持相同成像条件（包括亮度和曝光等条件）的情况下，以组织形态完整、荧光值较强且无弥散为最佳透化时间的判断标准。
en: When the tissue is removed cleanly and imaging conditions (including brightness and exposure) are kept identical, the criteria for determining the optimal permeabilization time are tissue integrity, strong fluorescence intensity, and lack of diffusion.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: 如图二所示，小鼠胸腺组织在8 min 透化时间下，组织呈现中间亮度不均匀的情况，说明透化不充分；14 min 和20 min 透化时间下，细节清晰，信号均匀，亮度最大；26 min 透化时间下的信号最弱；因此，较合适的透化时间有14 min和20 min，但建议选用短时间14min 作为最佳透化时间，便于减少扩散。
en: As shown in Figure 2, for mouse thymus tissue permeabilized for 8 minutes, the tissue exhibited uneven brightness in the center, indicating insufficient permeabilization; at permeabilization times of 14 minutes and 20 minutes, the details were clear, the signal was uniform, and the brightness was at its maximum; at 26 minutes, the signal was at its weakest. Therefore, 14 minutes and 20 minutes are suitable permeabilization times, but it is recommended to select the shorter time of 14 minutes as the optimal permeabilization time to facilitate the reduction of diffusion.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版兼容蛋白组）使用说明书-verA

zh: STOmics® Stereo-seq 透化试剂套装（载体版）是用于摸索组织切片最佳透化时间的预实验试剂套装。本试剂套装采用的Stereo-seq 时空转录组技术，是一种基于DNBSEQ 高通量测序技术开发的、具有高分辨大视场的原位全转录组信息捕获技术。Stereo-seq 芯片P（透化测试芯片）上载有核苷酸捕获探针，与组织切片结合后通过探针原位抓取组织内的mRNA 分子，再利用带有荧光标记的核苷酸进行cDNA 合成。研究人员通过荧光显微成像可以快速判断特定组织的最佳透化时间。
en: The STOmics® Stereo-seq Permeabilization Reagent Kit (Slide version) is a pre-experimental kit designed to explore the optimal permeabilization time for tissue sections. The Stereo-seq spatial transcriptomics technology employed in this kit is an *in situ* whole-transcriptome capture technology featuring high resolution and a large field of view, developed based on DNBSEQ high-throughput sequencing technology. The Stereo-seq Chip P (permeabilization test chip) is loaded with nucleotide capture probes. After binding to tissue sections, it captures mRNA molecules within the tissue *in situ* via these probes, followed by cDNA synthesis using fluorescently labeled nucleotides. Researchers can quickly determine the optimal permeabilization time for a specific tissue through fluorescence microscopy imaging.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 本试剂套装中提供的所有试剂都经过严格的质量控制和功能验证，最大程度上保证了产品性能的稳定性和重复性。
en: All reagents provided in this kit have undergone rigorous quality control and functional verification to ensure the stability and reproducibility of product performance to the greatest extent possible.
