zh: Stereo-seq 载体配件包
en: Stereo-seq Carrier Accessory Kit
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: Stereo-seq 载体配件包中包含芯片载体的夹具和可装卸的垫圈。
en: The Stereo-seq carrier accessory kit includes a fixture for the chip slide and a detachable gasket.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 芯片盒中包含2 张芯片载体，2 张载体上均贴有4 张Stereo-seq 芯片P（1 cm * 1 cm）。
en: The chip box contains 2 chip slides, with 4 Stereo-seq Chip P (1 cm * 1 cm) attached to each carrier.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 可通过载体末端光刻的标签区分Stereo-seq 芯片P 载体和Stereo-seq 芯片T 载体。
en: The Stereo-seq chip P carrier and the Stereo-seq chip T carrier can be distinguished by the tags photolithographed on the ends of the carriers.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: Stereo-seq 芯片载体保存方法
en: Preservation method for Stereo-seq chip slides
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: Stereo-seq 芯片载体装于真空密封的铝袋中，冷链运输。收到产品后须立即将未开封的Stereo-seq 芯片P/T 载体储存在−20℃或4℃。若拆袋后未使用，需重新干燥密封并储存在−20℃或4℃。
en: Stereo-seq chip slides are packed in vacuum-sealed aluminum bags and transported via cold chain. Upon receipt, unopened Stereo-seq chip P/T carriers must be immediately stored at −20°C or 4°C. If the bag has been opened but the carrier has not been used, it must be re-dried, resealed, and stored at −20°C or 4°C.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 需在铝制密封袋中放入干燥剂以保持干燥条件。重新密封的芯片不可放置超过两周。
en: Desiccant must be placed in the resealable aluminum bag to maintain dry conditions. Resealed chips must not be stored for more than two weeks.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: Stereo-seq 透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书
en: Stereo-seq Tissue Permeabilization Reagent Kit (Slide version) Instruction Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a. 从Stereo-seq 载体配件包中取出夹具和垫圈；
en: a. Remove the fixture and gasket from the Stereo-seq carrier accessory kit;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: b. 夹具反面朝上，将垫圈插入夹具中，确保夹具和垫圈的孔位切口对齐。按压垫圈，使垫圈和夹具契合在一起；
en: b. With the back of the fixture facing up, insert the gasket into the fixture, ensuring that the hole cutouts of the fixture and the gasket are aligned. Press the gasket down so that the gasket and fixture fit together;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: c. 用手指微调垫圈边缘位置，使垫圈与夹具更紧密地契合；
en: c. Use your fingers to fine-tune the position of the gasket edge to make the gasket fit more tightly with the fixture;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: d. 使用空气罐尽可能地吹去表面的杂质或碎屑；
en: d. Use a compressed air canister to blow away surface impurities or debris as much as possible;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: e. 拿起Stereo-seq 芯片载体，芯片面朝下，将芯片载体标签朝夹具的长边卡扣方向；
en: e. Pick up the Stereo-seq chip slide, with the chip side facing down, and orient the label towards the long-side clip of the fixture;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 组装方法视频参考网址:    https://www.stomics.tech/col113/607
en: Assembly method video reference URL: https://www.stomics.tech/col113/607
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: Stereo-seq 透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书
en: Stereo-seq Permeabilization Reagent Kit (Slide Version) User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: h. 沿着夹具卡带两侧按压，确保夹具与芯片载体稳固组装在一起；
en: h. Press along both sides of the fixture to ensure the fixture and chip slide are securely assembled together;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: i. 最后检查组装好的夹具和芯片载体，确保位置正确。
en: i. Finally, check the assembled fixture and chip slide to ensure they are properly positioned.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: g.  先将芯片载体卡进夹具下方4 个卡扣。双手中指支撑夹具的正面，左手拇指放在tab 1 和tab 2 之间，右手拇指放在tab 3 和tab 4 之间，拇指匀力向下按压芯片载体，直至听到“咔”的一声。双手食指用力向下按压夹具顶部边缘，将载体卡进夹具上方4 个卡扣;
en: g. First, snap the chip slide into the 4 clips at the bottom of the fixture. Support the front of the fixture with the middle fingers of both hands, place the left thumb between tab 1 and tab 2, and the right thumb between tab 3 and tab 4. Apply even downward pressure on the chip slide with your thumbs until you hear a "click." Firmly press down on the top edge of the fixture with the index fingers of both hands to snap the carrier into the 4 clips at the top of the fixture;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: f.  芯片对准垫圈孔位，避免夹具和垫圈接触芯片表面；
en: f. Align the chip with the gasket hole, avoiding contact between the fixture or gasket and the chip surface;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: Stereo-seq 透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书
en: Stereo-seq Permeabilization Reagent Kit (Carrier Version) Instruction Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a. 将夹具翻转过来，用力按压夹具上方卡带，使芯片载体从夹具中脱离。用大拇指稍微挡住载体背面，避免载体弹出；
en: a. Turn the fixture over and press firmly on the cassette above the fixture to release the chip slide from the fixture. Use your thumb to slightly block the back of the carrier to prevent it from popping out;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: b. 将芯片载体从带有刻字标签一侧抬起拿出。
en: b. Lift the chip slide from the side with the engraved label and remove it.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: •	 本产品仅适用于科研用途，不可用于临床诊断，使用前请仔细阅读本说明书。
en: • This product is intended for scientific research purposes only and must not be used for clinical diagnosis. Please read this manual carefully before use.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: •	 实验前请熟悉需使用的各种仪器的注意事项并掌握其操作方法。
en: • Before the experiment, please familiarize yourself with the precautions for the various instruments to be used and master their operating methods.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: •	 本说明书提供的实验流程是通用的，实际操作中可根据具体的实验设计、样本特征、测序应用和设备进行实验流程、反应参数的调整，以优化性能和效率。
en: • The experimental procedure provided in this manual is for general use. In actual operation, adjustments to the experimental procedure and reaction parameters can be made based on specific experimental design, sample characteristics, sequencing applications, and equipment to optimize performance and efficiency.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: •	 推荐使用前将各试剂组分提前取出，将酶类组分瞬时离心后置于冰上备用，并将其他组分置于室温解冻。解冻后轻柔地上下颠倒数次使其充分混匀，瞬时离心后置于冰上备用。
en: • Before use, it is recommended to retrieve all reagent components in advance. Briefly centrifuge enzyme components and place them on ice; thaw other components at room temperature. After thawing, gently invert each tube several times to ensure thorough mixing, briefly centrifuge, and place on ice for use.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: •	 为避免样本交叉污染，推荐使用带滤芯的吸头，吸取不同样本时请更换吸头。
en: • To avoid sample cross-contamination, the use of filter tips is recommended, and tips must be changed when pipetting different samples.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: •	 推荐把PCR 仪温度预热至反应温度。
en: • It is recommended to preheat the PCR thermal cycler to the reaction temperature.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: •	 应避免皮肤和眼睛直接接触样本及试剂，切勿吞咽样本及试剂，一旦发生意外请立即用大量清水冲洗并及时就医。
en: • Avoid direct contact of samples and reagents with skin and eyes; do not swallow samples or reagents. In case of accidental contact, rinse immediately with plenty of water and seek medical attention.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: •	 所有样本和各种废弃物均应按相关法规规定处理。
en: • All samples and various waste materials must be disposed of in accordance with relevant regulations.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 2. 样本准备Stereo-seq 透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书
en: 2. Sample Preparation Stereo-seq Permeabilization Reagent Kit (Carrier version) User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 适用于常见动物物种的时空转录组研究，包括但不限于人、猴、鼠等样本，详情可参考《Stereo-seq 试剂套装推荐样本》及《时空测试目录》。
en: Suitable for spatial transcriptomic studies of common animal species, including but not limited to human, monkey, and mouse samples. For details, please refer to the "Stereo-seq Reagent Kit Recommended Samples" and "Spatial Testing Catalog".
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 样本包埋组织RNA 完整值RIN
en: RNA Integrity Number (RIN) of embedded tissue samples.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 为保证样本质量，降低实验风险，建议切取10-20 片10 μm 厚的组织片，存放至−20℃下预冷的1.5 mL EP 管中，然后进行Total RNA 的提取和质量检测。
en: To ensure sample quality and reduce experimental risk, it is recommended to collect 10-20 tissue sections, each 10 μm thick, store them in a 1.5 mL EP tube pre-cooled at −20°C, and then proceed with total RNA extraction and quality control analysis.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 参考图一. 小鼠大脑组织切片RNA RIN 值峰图。
en: Refer to Figure 1. Electropherogram of RNA RIN value in mouse brain tissue sections.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 图一. 小鼠大脑组织切片RNA RIN 值峰图
en: Figure 1. Electropherogram of RNA RIN value in mouse brain tissue sections.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 强烈建议只对RIN ≥7 的组织样本进行后续实验操作。
en: It is strongly recommended to proceed with subsequent experimental operations only for tissue samples with RIN ≥7.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 实验室条件下严格保证新鲜样本在离体30 min 内进行直接包埋处理，以最大程度避免组织内部RNA 降解。
en: Under laboratory conditions, it is strictly required that fresh samples be directly embedded within 30 minutes of excision to minimize degradation of RNA within the tissue.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 组织尺寸不应超过 0.9 cm × 0.9 cm × 2 cm，组织切片/ 芯片面积不应超过80%。
en: The tissue dimensions should not exceed 0.9 cm × 0.9 cm × 2 cm, and the area of the tissue section/chip should not exceed 80%.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

en: Sakura/Base Molds/4583 O.C.T. 1
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

en: Sakura/Base Molds/4162 Metal Base Mold A1
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

en: Sakura/Base Molds/7055 Metal Base Mold B1
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

en: Sample processing video reference URL:    https://www.

zh: 2. 样本准备Stereo-seq 透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书
en: 2. Sample Preparation - Stereo-seq Permeabilization Reagent Kit (Carrier version) Instruction Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a1. 提前准备一泡沫箱碎冰并将OCT 放在冰上预冷10 min；
en: a1. Prepare a foam box of crushed ice in advance and place the OCT on the ice to pre-chill for 10 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a2. 根据组织大小提前准备两个合适大小的金属包埋盒A 和B（B 的尺寸需略大于A）；
en: a2. Prepare two metal embedding cassettes, A and B, of suitable sizes in advance based on the tissue size (the dimensions of B should be slightly larger than A);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a5. 准备一泡沫箱干冰；
en: a5. Prepare a foam box of dry ice;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a6. 准备具有平整面的金属块，金属块面积需大于金属包埋盒A，用于平放金属包埋盒；
en: a6. Prepare a metal block with a flat surface, with an area larger than that of metal embedding cassette A, for placing the metal embedding cassette flat;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a3. 提前将预冷好的OCT 填充金属包埋盒A 的2/3 左右，并放置在冰上预冷10 min 以上（可使用注射器吸弃产生的气泡）；
en: a3. Fill the metal embedding mold A about 2/3 full with pre-cooled OCT in advance, and place it on ice to pre-cool for at least 10 minutes (a syringe can be used to remove any air bubbles formed);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a4. 在平皿中加满OCT，提前预冷10 min（可使用注射器吸弃产生的气泡）；
en: a4. Fill the petri dish with OCT and pre-cool for 10 minutes (a syringe can be used to aspirate any air bubbles that form);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a7. 将金属块平整面向上放置到干冰中，预冷5 min 以上；a8. 将金属包埋盒B 放置于干冰中预冷5 min 以上。
en: a7. Place the metal block with the flat side facing up into dry ice and pre-cool for at least 5 minutes; a8. Place the metal embedding cassette B into dry ice and pre-cool for at least 5 minutes.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: b.   新鲜组织离体30 min 内，用无菌无纺布或无尘纸擦干组织表面液体，以避免在组织表面形成冰块，影响后续包埋切片；
en: b. Within 30 minutes of removing the fresh tissue, blot the surface liquid with sterile non-woven fabric or dust-free paper to prevent the formation of ice crystals on the tissue surface, which could interfere with subsequent embedding and sectioning;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 2. 样本准备Stereo-seq 透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书
en: 2. Sample Preparation Stereo-seq Tissue Permeabilization Reagent Kit (Chip-based) User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: c.  将组织放入在冰上预冷的OCT 中，在不产生气泡的前提下用药匙使组织被OCT 包裹（可使用注射器吸弃产生的气泡）；
en: c. Place the tissue into OCT that has been pre-chilled on ice; use a spatula to ensure the tissue is coated with OCT while avoiding the formation of air bubbles (a syringe can be used to remove any air bubbles that form);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: d.  将组织的拟切面朝下，放入冰上预冷的金属包埋盒A 中，使组织接触到金属包埋盒A 的底部。在不产生气泡的前提下用预冷的 OCT 填满金属包埋盒A，直至将组织完全覆盖（可使用注射器吸弃产生的气泡）；
en: d. Place the tissue face down, with its intended cutting surface facing the bottom, into the pre-chilled metal embedding mold A on ice, ensuring the tissue contacts the base of the mold. Fill the metal embedding mold A with pre-chilled OCT without forming air bubbles until the tissue is completely covered (a syringe can be used to remove any air bubbles that form);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: e.  将装有组织的金属包埋盒A，水平放置在干冰预冷的金属块上；
en: e. Place the metal embedding mold A containing the tissue horizontally onto a metal block pre-chilled on dry ice;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: f.  预冷的金属包埋盒B（作为盖子）开口向上，轻轻加盖于装有组织块的金属包埋盒A 上方，并在其开口中放置碎干冰，使干冰尽可能充分覆盖金属包埋盒表面，形成较为封闭的速冻空间；
en: f. Place the pre-cooled metal embedding cassette B (acting as a lid) with its opening facing upward, gently cover it over the metal embedding cassette A containing the tissue block, and place crushed dry ice into the opening, ensuring the dry ice covers the surface of the metal embedding cassette as thoroughly as possible to create a relatively enclosed quick-freezing space;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 2. 样本准备Stereo-seq 透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书
en: 2. Sample Preparation Stereo-seq Permeabilization Reagent Kit (Array Version) User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: g. 冷冻5 min 后，移去金属包埋盒B，检查OCT 是否完全凝固且变成白色不透明状, 若未完全冷冻好，则重复f；
en: g. After freezing for 5 minutes, remove the metal embedding mold B and check if the OCT has completely solidified and turned white and opaque; if it is not fully frozen, repeat step f.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: h. 如果组织块完全凝固并变成白色不透明状，用手轻掰金属包埋盒A 两侧，即可使OCT 包埋组织块从金属包埋盒A中脱模；
en: h. If the tissue block is completely solidified and has turned white and opaque, gently pry the sides of the metal embedding mold A by hand to demold the OCT-embedded tissue block from the metal embedding mold A.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: i. 检查包埋块底部是否被完全覆盖, 如未完全覆盖，则将组织块放置在金属块上，底部向上，在表面涂上少量OCT，待OCT 完全凝固且不透明，在包埋块切面位置做好标记。
en: i. Check if the bottom of the embedded block is completely covered; if not, place the tissue block on the metal block with the bottom facing up, apply a small amount of OCT to the surface, wait until the OCT has completely solidified and become opaque, and mark the sectioning surface of the embedded block.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 将组织包埋块使用锡纸包裹，并做好标记放入自封袋，在自封袋上做好记录，放入−80℃冰箱长期保存。如需邮寄，可选干冰邮寄。
en: Wrap the tissue embedding blocks in aluminum foil, label them clearly, place them in a self-sealing bag, record the details on the bag, and store them long-term in a -80°C freezer. If shipping is required, dry ice can be used.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 本实验用于稀释试剂的液体，除特殊说明外，均使用Nuclease - Free Water。

en: Reagent Preparation Procedure Storage
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 0.1X SSC取20X SSC 100 μL 稀释到20 mL   室温
en: 0.1X SSC: Take 100 μL of 20X SSC and dilute to 20 mL. Room temperature.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: Wash Buffer取5 μL RI 加入95 μL 0.1X SSC 中，用量至少为100 μL/ 芯片   冰上备用
en: Prepare Wash Buffer by adding 5 μL of RI to 95 μL of 0.1X SSC; required volume is at least 100 μL per chip. Keep on ice for use.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 0.01N HCl按照HCl 浓度梯度稀释到0.01N，pH 值准确到2（确保pH 值在1.9-2.1 范围内；至少2 mL/ 样本）   室温48 hr
en: Prepare 0.01N HCl by diluting HCl according to the concentration gradient to 0.01N, with the pH adjusted accurately to 2 (ensure pH is within the 1.9-2.1 range; at least 2 mL per sample). Keep at room temperature for 48 hours.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 0.01N HCl (pH = 2.0 ) 需现配现用。对于预制的0.1N HCl 和新购买的HCl，实验前请检查pH 值。
en: 0.01N HCl (pH = 2.0) must be freshly prepared before use. Check the pH of pre-made 0.1N HCl and newly purchased HCl before the experiment.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 储存时间超过48 hr 将影响预期pH 值，请在配制后48 hr 内使用。
en: Storage for more than 48 hours will affect the expected pH; please use within 48 hours of preparation.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 10X 透化试剂储存液用1 mL 新鲜配制的0.01N HCl 将PR Enzyme（红盖，粉末状）溶解后，通过移液器吹打混匀（可分装成若干份）   −20℃
en: To prepare 10X Permeabilization Reagent Stock, dissolve the PR Enzyme (red cap, powder) in 1 mL of freshly prepared 0.01N HCl and mix by pipetting up and down (can be aliquoted); store at −20°C.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 不要涡旋透化酶，可通过移液器吹打混匀。建议对配制好的10X 透化试剂储存液进行分装，避免反复冻融。
en: Do not vortex the permeabilization enzyme; mix by pipetting up and down. It is recommended to aliquot the prepared 10X Permeabilization Reagent Stock to avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 1X 透化试剂工作液用0.01N HCl 将10X 透化试剂储存液 15 μL 稀释到150 μL（至少150 μL/ 芯片）   冰上备用6 hr
en: For 1X Permeabilization Reagent working solution, dilute 15 μL of 10X Permeabilization Reagent stock solution to 150 μL using 0.01N HCl (at least 150 μL/chip). Keep on ice for use within 6 hr.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 准备仪器准备流程  备注
en: Prepare Instrument Preparation Procedure Remarks
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 按顺序依次设定：
en: Set in the following order:

zh: 37℃用于烤片和透化（热盖42℃）
en: 37°C for slide baking and permeabilization (lid heater 42°C)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 42℃用于反转录（热盖47℃）
en: 42°C for reverse transcription (lid heater 47°C)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 55℃用于组织移除（热盖60℃）
en: 55°C for tissue removal (lid 60°C)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 检查PCR 仪是否有异常，必要时更换
en: Check the PCR machine for abnormalities, and replace if necessary.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 金属浴37℃用于透化酶预热-
en: 37°C metal bath for preheating the permeabilization enzyme-
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 荧光显微镜TRITC 通道-
en: Fluorescence microscope TRITC channel-
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 3. 操作流程Stereo-seq 透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书
en: 3. Operation Procedure for Stereo-seq Permeabilization Reagent Kit (Carrier Version) Instruction Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a. 提前将PCR 仪温度设置到37℃，热盖温度为42℃，放置PCR 适配器平衡温度；
en: a. Pre-set the PCR instrument temperature to 37°C and the lid temperature to 42°C, then place the PCR adapter to equilibrate the temperature;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: b. 冷冻切片机箱体预冷至−20℃，样本头预冷至−15℃ ~ −10℃（根据实际操作过程调整）；
en: b. Pre-cool the cryostat chamber to −20°C and the specimen head to −15°C ~ −10°C (adjust based on the actual operating procedure);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: c. 提前将毛刷、刀片和镊子等置于箱体预冷；
en: c. Pre-place the brushes, blades, tweezers, etc., in the chamber to cool down;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: d. 将OCT 包埋的组织块从−80℃冰箱取出，放在冷冻切片机内平衡30 min；
en: d. Remove the OCT-embedded tissue block from the -80°C freezer and place it in a cryostat to equilibrate for 30 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: e. 使用OCT 将组织块固定到样品托上；
en: e. Use OCT to secure the tissue block onto the specimen chuck;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: f. 将组织块修剪成合适的尺寸（切面小于0.9 cm × 0.9 cm），切去组织块周围过多的OCT，保留一部分OCT，方便转移组织；
en: f. Trim the tissue block to an appropriate size (cross-sectional area smaller than 0.9 cm × 0.9 cm), trim away excess OCT around the tissue block, while retaining some OCT to facilitate tissue transfer;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: g. 根据需要对组织块做最后地修剪，以确保组织切片能更好地适配芯片，随后可进行冷冻切片。
en: g. Perform final trimming of the tissue block as needed to ensure the tissue sections better fit the chuck, then proceed with cryosectioning.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 样本头温度过低会导致切片出现裂纹，样本头温度过高会导致切片出现褶皱，请根据样本情况将冻头调
en: If the specimen head temperature is too low, it will cause cracks in the sections; if the specimen head temperature is too high, it will cause wrinkles in the sections. Please adjust the specimen head based on the sample conditions to
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 样本头温度过低会导致切片出现裂纹，样本头温度过高会导致切片出现褶皱，请根据样本情况将冻头调
en: If the sample block temperature is too low, it will cause cracks in the sections; if the sample block temperature is too high, it will cause wrinkles in the sections, please adjust the cryostat head
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a. 取芯片：从真空干燥铝箔袋中取出 Stereo-seq 芯片P 载体，记录芯片背面的编号；注意不要触碰芯片正面；
en: a. Retrieve the chip: Remove the Stereo-seq chip P carrier from the vacuum-sealed aluminum foil bag, and record the serial number on the back of the chip; be careful not to touch the front side of the chip;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: b. 将载体置于桌面上复温1 min，观察芯片表面是否有杂质，如芯片上存在杂质，使用100 μL Nuclease-Free Water 清洗2 次（或在含40-50 mL NF water 的离心管中清洗2 次 )；
en: b. Place the carrier on the workbench to warm up for 1 minute, and observe the chip surface for impurities. If impurities are present on the chip, wash it twice with 100 μL of Nuclease-Free Water (or wash it twice in a centrifuge tube containing 40-50 mL of NF water);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: c. 清洗后用气瓶吹干芯片四周及表面，再用无尘纸吸干载玻片背面和周围多余的液体；
en: c. After washing, use a gas cylinder to blow dry the periphery and surface of the chip, then use a lint-free wipe to blot dry any excess liquid from the back of the slide and its surroundings;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: d. 当芯片表面无杂质、无明显痕迹、无任何液体残留、无波纹状纹理，即可准备贴片；
en: d. When the chip surface is free of impurities, obvious marks, residual liquid, and rippled textures, it is ready for mounting;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: e. 预冷甲醇：在玻片盒或50 mL 离心管中加入足量甲醇，确保甲醇足够浸没所有芯片（可将一张普通载玻片放入容器中，查看甲醇的体积是否足够）。扣紧盖子，提前放入切片机中（−20℃）预冷5-30 min；
en: e. Pre-chill methanol: Add a sufficient amount of methanol to a slide box or 50 mL centrifuge tube, ensuring that the methanol is enough to submerge all chips (a standard microscope slide can be placed into the container to check if the volume of methanol is sufficient). Tightly close the lid and pre-chill it in the cryostat (−20°C) for 5–30 min in advance.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: f. 将组织包埋块固定至冻头上，修片；
en: f. Mount the tissue embedding block onto the specimen chuck, and trim the block.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: g. 组织贴片有两种操作方式可选：热贴（A）和冷贴（B）。根据需求选择切片厚度，通常为10 μm。
en: g. There are two optional methods for tissue section mounting: warm mounting (A) and cold mounting (B). Select the section thickness according to requirements, typically 10 μm.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 打开后，请检查玻片盒中的所有的 Stereo-seq 芯片载体是否正确定位在插槽中，载体上的芯片是否正面
en: After opening, please check that all Stereo-seq chip slides in the slide box are correctly positioned in the slots, and whether the chips on the carriers are face
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 朝上。芯片的正面为亮光面，正面含有用于 mRNA 捕获的探针。请勿触碰到芯片表面。
en: up. The front side of the chip is the glossy surface and contains probes for mRNA capture. Please do not touch the chip surface.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 3. 操作流程Stereo-seq 透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书
en: 3. Operating Procedure for Stereo-seq Permeabilization Reagent Kit (Slide-based) User Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 1）连续切取组织切片，将切片移到切片台右侧靠近边缘处，然后用预冷的毛刷轻轻拨动切片周围的OCT 使切片铺平，每张切片放置间隔距离大于载体宽度；
en: 1) Continuously cut tissue sections, move the sections to the right side of the cryostat stage near the edge, then use a pre-cooled brush to gently manipulate the OCT around the sections to flatten them; the spacing between each section should be greater than the width of the slide;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 2）拿起载体的一边，使芯片正面朝下，对准切片；
en: 2) Pick up one side of the carrier, align the chip with the tissue section facing downward;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 3）轻轻一压，肉眼可见切片已经吸附到芯片表面；
en: 3) Apply gentle pressure, and the tissue section will be visibly adsorbed onto the chip surface;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 4）重复 2）-3）步骤操作，直至全部组织切片吸附到芯片表面（贴片时间控制在1 min 以内）；
en: 4) Repeat steps 2) and 3) until all tissue sections are adsorbed onto the chip surface (the mounting process should be completed within 1 min);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 5）将芯片正面朝上，快速将载体置于提前平衡温度的PCR 适配器上，37℃孵育5 min，无需盖PCR 热盖。
en: 5) Place the chip with the front side facing up, and quickly place the carrier onto the pre-equilibrated PCR adapter. Incubate at 37°C for 5 minutes without closing the PCR thermal lid.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 1)  将玻片正面朝上置于切片机中，预冷1-6 min；
en: 1) Place the slide with the front side facing up into the cryostat and pre-cool for 1-6 minutes;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 2）进行冷冻切片，然后用预冷的毛刷轻轻拨动切片周围的OCT 使切片铺平。用镊子和毛刷将切片小心覆盖在芯片正中央并铺平，注意毛刷不要触碰到组织。尽量一次贴片成功，确保组织切片完整，无褶皱；
en: 2) Perform cryosectioning, then use a pre-chilled brush to gently nudge the OCT around the section to flatten it. Carefully place the section in the center of the chip using forceps and the brush, ensuring it is flat; take care not to let the brush touch the tissue. Aim for a successful mount on the first attempt, ensuring the tissue section is intact and wrinkle-free;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 3）立即拿起芯片载体，用指腹放在载体背面加温几秒钟，直至切片贴合；
en: 3) Immediately pick up the chip slide and place a fingertip on the back of the carrier to warm it for a few seconds until the section adheres;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 4）重复上述操作，直至所有切片贴片完成，建议组织切片贴片控制在5 min 内；
en: 4) Repeat the above steps until all sections are mounted; it is recommended to complete the mounting of tissue sections within 5 minutes;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 5）快速将载体置于PCR 适配器上37℃孵育5 min，无需盖PCR 热盖。
en: 5) Quickly place the carrier onto the PCR adapter and incubate at 37°C for 5 min; there is no need to close the PCR thermal lid.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 如需在同一个载体的不同芯片上贴2 个不同组织的切片，建议将两个组织都修好片后，先对一个组织切片，
en: If it is necessary to attach tissue sections from two different tissues onto different chips of the same carrier, it is recommended to trim both tissue blocks first, then section one tissue,
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 使用热贴方式贴片，将载体放至PCR 适配器上37℃等待贴下一个组织，等待时间控制在5 min 以内；然
en: attach the section using the heat-attachment method, place the carrier onto the PCR adapter at 37°C while waiting to attach the next tissue, keeping the waiting time within 5 min; then
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 后换另外一个组织切片，使用热贴方式贴片，快速将载体置于PCR 适配器上37℃孵育5 min。
en: Then, change to another tissue section, perform heat-mounting, and quickly place the carrier on the PCR adapter to incubate at 37°C for 5 min.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 预冷时间不可过长，以免玻片表面产生水雾；预冷时间不可太短，以免玻片无法达到预冷温度。
en: The pre-cooling time should not be too long to avoid condensation on the slide surface; it should not be too short to ensure the slide reaches the pre-cooling temperature.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 进行冷贴时需控制好每张切片贴片时间，间隔时间太大，组织贴片会皱缩。
en: When performing cold-mounting, control the mounting time for each section; if the interval is too long, the tissue section will wrinkle.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: （可选暂停点）将孵育好的芯片载体放于玻片盒或者50 mL 离心管，用干冰快速转移到−80℃冰箱，最长可于−80℃保存一个月。
en: (Optional pause point) Place the incubated chip slide into a slide box or a 50 mL centrifuge tube, and quickly transfer to a −80°C freezer using dry ice. It can be stored at −80°C for up to one month.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 继续实验时，使用干冰将玻片盒或者50 mL 离心管转移，取出贴有组织的芯片载体，快速置于PCR 适配器上37℃孵育5 min。
en: To continue the experiment, use dry ice to transfer the slide box or 50 mL centrifuge tube, take out the chip slide with the tissue attached, and quickly place it on a PCR adapter to incubate at 37°C for 5 min.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 3. 操作流程Stereo-seq 透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书
en: 3. Operating Procedures - Stereo-seq Permeabilization Kit (Slide version) Instruction Manual
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a. 孵育结束后，立即将芯片载体置于−20℃预冷的甲醇中，确保甲醇浸没载体上的所有芯片，固定30 min;
en: a. After incubation, immediately place the chip slide into methanol pre-cooled at −20°C, ensuring that the methanol submerges all chips on the carrier, and fix for 30 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: b. 固定结束后，将玻片盒或50 mL 离心管转移至通风橱中；
en: b. After fixation, transfer the slide box or 50 mL centrifuge tube to a fume hood;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: c. 将载体从玻片盒或50 mL 离心管中取出，用无尘纸吸干载玻片背面和芯片周围多余的甲醇，确保无液体残留；
en: c. Remove the carrier from the slide box or 50 mL centrifuge tube, and use lint-free paper to blot dry the excess methanol on the back of the slide and around the chips, ensuring there is no residual liquid;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: d. 将载体竖立放在载玻片染色架上，置于通风橱中晾干4-6 min，让甲醇充分挥发；
en: d. Place the carrier vertically on a microscope slide staining rack and air-dry in a fume hood for 4-6 min to allow the methanol to evaporate completely;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: e. 甲醇挥发完全后，肉眼可见组织变白，将载体转移至实验桌上。
en: e. After the methanol has completely evaporated, the tissue is visibly white to the naked eye; transfer the carrier to the laboratory bench.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 可提前将RT QC Reagent、RT Additive 和RT QC Enzyme 放置在冰上解冻。
en: You can place the RT QC Reagent, RT Additive, and RT QC Enzyme on ice to thaw in advance.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: a. 根据【实验前准备】，提前配制2 mL 0.01N HCl，准备好1X 透化试剂工作液；
en: a. According to [Preparation Before Experiment], prepare 2 mL of 0.01N HCl in advance, and prepare the 1X permeabilization reagent working solution;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: b. 提前将2 个PCR 仪（或一个PCR 仪、一个金属浴）温度设置到37℃，热盖温度为42℃，其中一个PCR 仪提前3 min 放置PCR 适配器平衡温度；
en: b. Set the temperature of two PCR instruments (or one PCR instrument and one metal bath) to 37°C and the heated lid temperature to 42°C in advance, and place a PCR adapter in one of the PCR instruments for 3 minutes in advance to equilibrate the temperature;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: c. 参考步骤 1.5. 将垫圈与夹具组合成载具（不含芯片载体）。将载具放置于PCR 适配器上，盖上PCR 仪盖，37℃孵育10 min，透化工作液使用前置于PCR 仪或者金属浴中37℃孵育10 min（最长时间不超过30 min）；
en: c. Refer to step 1.5. Assemble the gasket and fixture into a carrier (excluding the chip slide). Place the carrier on the PCR adapter, close the PCR instrument lid, and incubate at 37°C for 10 min. Before use, pre-incubate the permeabilization working solution in the PCR instrument or a dry bath at 37°C for 10 min (do not exceed 30 min);
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: d. 载具孵育完成后，将载体固定于载具上，组合成手持载具，确保夹具 8 个卡扣扣紧并且载体两侧贴紧夹具两侧；
en: d. After the carrier incubation is complete, fix the chip slide onto the carrier to assemble into a handheld carrier, ensuring that the 8 latches of the fixture are fastened tightly and both sides of the chip slide are closely attached to the sides of the fixture;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: e. 组织透化时间范围是0-30 min，初次实验建议设置6 min、12 min、18 min、24 min 等4 个组进行测试；
en: e. The tissue permeabilization time range is 0-30 min. For the initial experiment, it is recommended to set 4 groups for testing: 6 min, 12 min, 18 min, and 24 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 图二 . 透化时间测试（分钟）
en: Figure 2. Permeabilization time test (minutes)
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 1) 先在透化时间为24 min 的芯片添加150 μL 1X 透化试剂。在芯片的每个角加入一滴透化试剂（移液器挨近芯片加液，注意不要划伤组织），然后将其余透化试剂加到芯片中央，使所有液体融合，确保透化试剂覆盖全芯片；
en: 1) First, add 150 μL of 1X permeabilization reagent to the chip for the 24 min permeabilization time. Add one drop of permeabilization reagent to each corner of the chip (keep the pipette close to the chip when adding, taking care not to scratch the tissue), then add the remaining permeabilization reagent to the center of the chip to merge all the liquid, ensuring that the permeabilization reagent covers the entire chip;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 2) 将手持载具转移到PCR 适配器上，将封板膜（不要撕开）放置于载具上覆盖反应孔，盖上PCR 仪盖，37℃孵育；
en: 2) Transfer the handheld carrier to the PCR adapter, place the plate sealing film (do not peel off) over the carrier to cover the reaction wells, close the PCR instrument lid, and incubate at 37°C;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 3) 6 min 后，打开PCR 仪盖，拿开封板膜，在透化时间为18 min 的芯片添加150 μL 1X 透化试剂；
en: 3) After 6 min, open the PCR instrument lid, remove the plate sealing film, and add 150 μL of 1X permeabilization reagent to the chip with a permeabilization time of 18 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 4) 将封板膜重新放置于载具上，盖上PCR 仪盖，37℃孵育；
en: 4) Reapply the plate sealing film onto the carrier, close the PCR instrument lid, and incubate at 37°C;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 5) 重复以上步骤至透化时间最短的芯片开始孵育。
en: 5) Repeat the above steps until the chip with the shortest permeabilization time begins incubation.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: f. 将手持载具从PCR 仪中取出；
en: f. Remove the handheld carrier from the PCR instrument;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: g. 微微倾斜手持载具，倾斜角度小于20°，用移液器从芯片的一角吸掉透化试剂；
en: g. Slightly tilt the handheld carrier at an angle of less than 20°, and use a pipette to aspirate the permeabilization reagent from one corner of the chip;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: h. 加入Wash Buffer，用量为100 μL/ 芯片；
en: h. Add 100 μL/chip of Wash Buffer;
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: i. 微微倾斜手持载具，用移液器从芯片一角吸掉芯片表面溶液。
en: i. Hold the carrier at a slight angle, and use a pipette to aspirate the solution from the chip surface starting from one corner.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 透化时可提前参考表格3-2 配制RT QC Mix，用铝箔纸包裹避光，冰上放置，使用前室温平衡5 min，
en: For permeabilization, prepare the RT QC Mix in advance by referring to Table 3-2, wrap it in aluminum foil to protect it from light, place it on ice, and equilibrate at room temperature for 5 min before use.
source_manual: Stereo-seq_透化试剂套装（载体版）使用说明书-D

zh: 并将另一台PCR 仪温度调节至42℃，热盖温度为47℃，提前放置PCR 适配器平衡温度。
en: Set another PCR instrument to 42°C with a lid temperature of 47°C, and place the PCR adapter in advance to equilibrate the temperature.

zh: f. 加入Wash Buffer，用量为100 μL/ 芯片；

en: c. Gently add 100 μL of RT QC Mix into the chip from one corner of the reaction well, ensuring the RT QC Mix evenly covers the entire chip, and seal the carrier with adhesive film;

zh: Stereo-seq FFPE 转录组试剂套装是用于获取 FFPE（福尔马林固定石蜡包埋）样本组织切片全转录本的试剂套装。本试剂套装采用的 Stereo-seq 时空转录组技术，是一种基于 DNBSEQ 高通量测序技术开发的、具有高分辨大视场的原位全转录组信息捕获技术。利用带有空间坐标信息的“随机探针”对FFPE 样本中组织细胞内的Total RNA 分子进行原位捕获并进行cDNA 合成与连接，通过空间条形码（Coordinate ID，CID）还原回空间位置，实现单细胞分辨率全转录组空间表达图谱的构建。
en: The Stereo-seq FFPE Transcriptomics Reagent Kit is a reagent set designed for obtaining full transcriptomes from FFPE (Formalin-Fixed Paraffin-Embedded) tissue sections. The Stereo-seq spatial transcriptomics technology utilized in this kit is an in-situ full-transcriptome capture technology developed based on DNBSEQ high-throughput sequencing, featuring high resolution and a large field of view. By using "random probes" carrying spatial coordinate information, Total RNA molecules within tissue cells of FFPE samples are captured in situ, followed by cDNA synthesis and ligation. Spatial barcodes (Coordinate ID, CID) are then used to restore spatial positions, enabling the construction of single-cell resolution full-transcriptome spatial expression maps.
source_manual: Stereo-seqFFPE转录组试剂套装使用说明书-B

zh: 利用同一试剂盒套装，可根据研究需求选择同一张组织切片上进行 H&E 染色或细胞核染色，结合强大的分析工具，以单细胞级分辨率灵活开展多模态数据分析。
en: Using the same kit, researchers can choose to perform H&E staining or nuclear staining on the same tissue section according to their research needs. Combined with powerful analytical tools, this allows for flexible multi-modal data analysis at single-cell resolution.
source_manual: Stereo-seqFFPE转录组试剂套装使用说明书-B

zh: 本试剂套装中提供的所有试剂都经过严格的质量控制和功能验证，最大程度上保证了文库制备的稳定性和重复性。
en: All reagents provided in this kit have undergone rigorous quality control and functional validation, ensuring the stability and reproducibility of library preparation to the greatest extent.
source_manual: Stereo-seqFFPE转录组试剂套装使用说明书-B

zh: 使用本产品构建的文库可使用DNBSEQ测序平台进行测序。详情请参考《Stereo-seq 16 Barcode 建库试剂盒 V1.0 使用说明书》 。

zh: Stereo-seq植物新鲜样本包埋操作指南第一章  包埋流程
en: Stereo-seq Fresh Plant Sample Embedding Operation Guide, Chapter 1: Embedding Workflow
source_manual: Stereo-seq植物新鲜样本包埋操作指南

zh: 从含有相同序号上标的品牌中任选其一。
en: Choose any one from the brands with the same numbered superscript.
source_manual: Stereo-seq植物新鲜样本包埋操作指南

zh: (1) 准备干冰，置于冰盒中待用；OCT建议保存在4℃，若保存在常温，使用前可倒插于冰上预冷；
en: (1) Prepare dry ice and place it in an ice box for later use; it is recommended to store OCT at 4°C. If it is stored at room temperature, it can be placed upside down on ice to pre-cool before use.
source_manual: Stereo-seq植物新鲜样本包埋操作指南

zh: (2) 取出真空干燥器，拿掉隔板（如有），在真空干燥器底部加入碎冰；
en: (2) Take out the vacuum desiccator, remove the partition (if any), and add crushed ice to the bottom of the vacuum desiccator.
source_manual: Stereo-seq植物新鲜样本包埋操作指南

zh: (3) 准备培养皿，挤入约容积2/3体积的OCT，提前10-30 min置于真空干燥器中的冰上预冷；
en: (3) Prepare a Petri dish, squeeze in OCT to about 2/3 of its volume, and place it on the ice in the vacuum desiccator 10-30 minutes in advance to pre-cool.
source_manual: Stereo-seq植物新鲜样本包埋操作指南

zh: (4) 在PVC包埋盒上标记包埋的材料、时间和操作人，然后在包埋盒中挤入约2/3体积的OCT，置于真空干燥器中的冰上预冷（如图1）；OCT使用后继续倒插在冰上预冷；
en: (4) Mark the embedded material, time, and operator on the PVC embedding cassette, then squeeze OCT into the cassette to about 2/3 of its volume, and place it on ice in a vacuum desiccator for pre-cooling (as shown in Figure 1); keep the OCT inverted on ice for continued pre-cooling after use;
source_manual: Stereo-seq植物新鲜样本包埋操作指南

zh: （5) 用75%酒精喷洗镊子尖部和剪刀，用无尘纸擦干；
en: (5) Spray the tips of the tweezers and scissors with 75% ethanol, and wipe them dry with lint-free paper;
source_manual: Stereo-seq植物新鲜样本包埋操作指南

zh: （6) 取植物材料，用剪刀剪下想要测试的部位（如材料有灰尘农药残留等，先用ddH2O清洗干净并擦干），并将材料剪切成便于包埋的尺寸：
en: (6) Take the plant material, cut off the part to be tested with scissors (if the material has dust or pesticide residues, wash it clean with ddH2O first and wipe dry), and cut the material into a size convenient for embedding:
source_manual: Stereo-seq植物新鲜样本包埋操作指南

zh: 以拟南芥（Arabidopsis）为例⸺叶片：以横切面为例，可将一片拟南芥叶子沿垂直于主叶脉方向剪成宽度约0.5 cm的小条，尽量控制叶片宽度短于包埋盒长边，若叶片过大可按需求修剪，一个包埋盒大约可包埋7-9条修剪好的叶片（参考图2）；花序：拟南芥花序可以直接包埋，根据花序大小，一个包埋盒大约可以包埋尚未露白的花序约3-5个（参考图2）；* 其他材料可参考上述方法自行剪切。
en: Taking *Arabidopsis* as an example—Leaves: For cross-sections, a leaf can be cut into strips approximately 0.5 cm wide, perpendicular to the main vein. Try to keep the leaf width shorter than the long side of the embedding cassette; if the leaf is too large, it can be trimmed as needed. One embedding cassette can hold approximately 7-9 trimmed leaf strips (refer to Figure 2); Inflorescences: *Arabidopsis* inflorescences can be embedded directly. Depending on the size of the inflorescences, one embedding cassette can hold approximately 3-5 inflorescences that have not yet shown white buds (refer to Figure 2); * For other materials, refer to the above methods to cut them.
source_manual: Stereo-seq植物新鲜样本包埋操作指南

zh: （7) 用镊子轻轻夹起剪切好的植物活体材料，尽快放入预冷的OCT的培养皿中；
en: (7) Gently pick up the cut live plant material with forceps and place it as soon as possible into a petri dish containing pre-cooled OCT.
source_manual: Stereo-seq植物新鲜样本包埋操作指南

zh: (8) 盖上真空干燥器的盖子，开启真空泵，真空抽滤10 min（根据真空干燥器的承压情况选择真空压力值，本操作使用0.06 Mpa）；
en: (8) Close the lid of the vacuum desiccator, turn on the vacuum pump, and perform vacuum infiltration for 10 min (select the vacuum pressure value based on the pressure capacity of the vacuum desiccator; this procedure uses 0.06 MPa).
source_manual: Stereo-seq植物新鲜样本包埋操作指南

zh: (9) 梯度降压：缓慢旋转气阀放气，使压力调整至约0.04 Mpa，保持10 min，再次调整气阀，使压力调整至约0.02 Mpa，保持10 min，最后完全打开气阀，使压力归零，保持10 min；
en: (9) Stepwise depressurization: slowly rotate the air valve to release air, adjust the pressure to approximately 0.04 MPa, hold for 10 min, readjust the air valve, adjust the pressure to approximately 0.02 MPa, hold for 10 min, and finally fully open the air valve to bring the pressure to zero, hold for 10 min;
source_manual: Stereo-seq植物新鲜样本包埋操作指南

zh: （10) 进行包埋：从培养皿中取出植物材料，调整材料的方向放入含有预冷OCT的包埋盒中：
en: (10) Perform embedding: remove the plant material from the petri dish, adjust the orientation of the material, and place it into an embedding mold containing pre-chilled OCT:
source_manual: Stereo-seq植物新鲜样本包埋操作指南

zh: 以拟南芥（Arabidopsis）为例⸺（如图2）叶片：将叶片条竖起，横切面正对包埋盒的底面，将叶片条沿着包埋盒的一边竖直排列在OCT中，用镊子将叶片条轻轻往下压，使叶片横切面尽量贴到包埋盒底面，注意尽量保持叶片条垂直于包埋盒底面，不要倾斜；花序：用镊子将花序轻轻下压，尽量使花序以侧面方向贴到包埋盒底面，并用镊子轻轻压每朵小花，使它们尽量贴到包埋盒底面；
en: Taking *Arabidopsis* as an example—(Figure 2) Leaves: set the leaf strips upright, with the cross-section facing the bottom of the embedding mold, arrange the leaf strips vertically along one side of the embedding mold in the OCT, and use forceps to gently press the leaf strips down, so that the leaf cross-sections are as flush as possible with the bottom of the embedding mold; note: try to keep the leaf strips perpendicular to the bottom of the embedding mold and do not tilt them; Inflorescence: use forceps to gently press the inflorescence down, trying to keep the inflorescence flush with the bottom of the embedding mold in a side-facing orientation, and use forceps to gently press each small flower, so that they are as flush as possible with the bottom of the embedding mold;
source_manual: Stereo-seq植物新鲜样本包埋操作指南

zh: Stereo-seq植物新鲜样本包埋操作指南第一章  包埋流程
en: Stereo-seq Fresh Plant Sample Embedding Operation Guide Chapter 1: Embedding Process
source_manual: Stereo-seq植物新鲜样本包埋操作指南

zh: （11) 材料埋好后，快速转移包埋盒到干冰上，水平放置直到OCT完全凝固（如图3）；
en: (11) After embedding the material, quickly transfer the embedding cassette to dry ice and place it horizontally until the OCT is completely solidified (as shown in Figure 3);
source_manual: Stereo-seq植物新鲜样本包埋操作指南

zh: • OCT凝固后将呈现白色不透明状态；• 保持包埋盒水平放置，否则材料会在OCT凝固前发生位置变化；
en: • The OCT will appear opaque white once solidified; • Keep the embedding cassette horizontal, otherwise the material will shift position before the OCT solidifies;
source_manual: Stereo-seq植物新鲜样本包埋操作指南

zh: （12) 将凝固的材料放入自封袋封好，标记包埋的组织类型、时间等，保存在-80℃冰箱或在冰冻切片机中进行切片。
en: (12) Place the solidified material into a self-sealing bag, seal it well, label it with the tissue type, date, and other relevant information, and store it in a -80°C freezer or proceed to sectioning in a cryostat.
source_manual: Stereo-seq植物新鲜样本包埋操作指南

zh: • 如果没有干冰，可以在-80℃冰箱中进行OCT冷冻凝固。不推荐液氮速冻或液氮+异戊烷速冻，冰冻速度太快极大可能导致材料在切片时破碎。• 冻存的组织块应尽快进行后续试验。
en: • If dry ice is unavailable, OCT embedding and freezing can be performed in a -80°C freezer. Liquid nitrogen snap-freezing or liquid nitrogen + isopentane snap-freezing is not recommended, as the freezing rate is too fast, which is highly likely to cause the material to fracture during sectioning. • Frozen tissue blocks should be used for subsequent experiments as soon as possible.
source_manual: Stereo-seq植物新鲜样本包埋操作指南

zh: 从含有相同序号上标的品牌中任选其一。

zh: (1) 取出真空干燥器，拿掉隔板（如有），在真空干燥器底部加入碎冰；

source_manual: Stereo-seq植物新鲜样本包埋操作指南

zh: (2) 取PVC包埋盒，在包埋盒上标记材料名称、时间和操作人，加入OCT，冰上预冷；

source_manual: Stereo-seq植物新鲜样本包埋操作指南

zh: (3) 弃掉液体，用镊子轻轻夹出材料，吸干材料表面液体，将材料剪切成适合包埋的尺寸（参照「方法一，2.操作步骤⑥，Page 06」），放入包埋盒中；
en: (3) Discard the liquid, gently remove the material using forceps, blot dry the surface liquid, cut the material into an appropriate size for embedding (refer to "Method 1, 2. Operation Steps ⑥, Page 06"), and place it into the embedding mold.
source_manual: Stereo-seq植物新鲜样本包埋操作指南

zh: (4) 调整材料的方向（参照「方法一, 2.操作步骤10)，Page 06」），由于叶片经固定后，非常软绵，无法以垂直于包埋盒底面的方向保持竖立，因此可以将一片叶片条平铺于包埋盒底面，再向上叠加叶片条，直至和包埋盒等深。这种包埋方法可以将叶片的横切面垂直于包埋盒某一侧的侧壁，并使横切面贴在侧壁上，以方便后续切片；
en: (4) Adjust the orientation of the material (refer to "Method 1, 2. Operation Step 10), Page 06"). Since the leaf tissue becomes very soft after fixation and cannot stand upright perpendicular to the bottom of the embedding mold, one leaf strip can be placed flat on the bottom, and then additional leaf strips can be stacked on top until the mold is filled to the required depth. This embedding method allows the cross-section of the leaf to be positioned perpendicular to a side wall of the mold, with the cross-section adhering to the side wall, to facilitate subsequent sectioning.

zh: (5) 材料埋好后，将包埋盒水平放置到真空干燥器的冰上，盖上真空干燥器的盖子，开启真空泵，真空抽滤10 min（根据真空干燥器的承压情况选择真空压力值，本操作使用0.06 Mpa）；
en: (5) After the material is embedded, place the embedding cassette horizontally on ice in a vacuum desiccator, cover the desiccator, turn on the vacuum pump, and perform vacuum filtration for 10 min (choose the vacuum pressure according to the pressure tolerance of the vacuum desiccator; 0.06 MPa was used in this operation);
source_manual: Stereo-seq植物新鲜样本包埋操作指南

zh: (6) 将包埋盒水平放置于有盖容器中，盖上盖子，于4℃放置过夜。
en: (6) Place the embedding cassette horizontally in a container with a lid, close the lid, and leave it at 4°C overnight.
source_manual: Stereo-seq植物新鲜样本包埋操作指南

zh: • 固定后的植物材料非常软绵，用镊子夹取时要非常注意不要弄坏；• 固定后的材料修剪大小时，要十分轻柔，需要耐心操作。
en: • The fixed plant material is very soft and delicate; be extremely careful not to damage it when handling with tweezers; • When trimming the fixed material to size, be very gentle and proceed with patience.

zh: (1) 准备干冰，置于冰盒中待用；

source_manual: Stereo-seq植物新鲜样本包埋操作指南

zh: (4) 快速转移含有植物材料的包埋盒到干冰盒中，水平放置直到OCT完全凝固；

source_manual: Stereo-seq植物新鲜样本包埋操作指南

zh: (5) 将包埋好的材料放入自封袋封好，标记包埋的材料、时间等，保存在-80℃冰箱中或在冰冻切片机中切片。
en: (5) Place the embedded material into a self-sealing bag, seal it, label it with the material information and time, and store it in an -80°C freezer or proceed with sectioning in a cryostat.
source_manual: Stereo-seq植物新鲜样本包埋操作指南

zh: STOmics时空组学技术具有超大视场和亚细胞分辨率两大特色，用户可在单细胞尺度上分析完整的组织切片。一般情况下，我们会用高倍显微镜获取高分辨率的组织细胞图像，并在后续的分析中，将基因表达数据配准到高分辨率组织图像上，联合做组织和单细胞维度的数据挖掘和分析。本手册提供了显微镜成像系统建议、一般的成像指南、图像初步评估和分析等内容，旨在指导用户对显微镜的硬件参数及成像效果进行评估，以辅助确认其是否可以用于STOmics时空组学实验的拍照环节。此外，本手册还介绍了华大自研的图像评估和图像处理软件⸺StereoMap，以及适合使用SAW进行图像自动化分析的图像示例。
en: STOmics spatiotemporal omics technology features two main characteristics: an ultra-large field of view and subcellular resolution, allowing users to analyze complete tissue sections at the single-cell scale. Generally, we use high-magnification microscopes to obtain high-resolution images of tissue cells, and in subsequent analysis, we register the gene expression data to the high-resolution tissue images to conduct joint data mining and analysis at both tissue and single-cell dimensions. This manual provides recommendations for microscope imaging systems, general imaging guidelines, and preliminary image assessment and analysis, aimed at guiding users to evaluate the hardware parameters and imaging quality of their microscopes to assist in confirming whether they can be used for the imaging step of STOmics spatiotemporal omics experiments. In addition, this manual also introduces BGI's self-developed image assessment and image processing software—StereoMap, as well as examples of images suitable for automated image analysis using SAW.
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 根据实际的应用和需求，选择对应的 STOmics 技术，参考技术说明书，若有成像需求，建议参考此手册，对显微镜硬件参数和功能进行初步评估。初步评估通过后，在进行 Stereo-seq 芯片载体成像时，首先通过显微镜本地软件判断成像效果是否满足需求，同时借助 StereoMap 软件的“Tools”模块对 Track 线等成像情况进行评估。Track 线等评估通过后，可自动化进行后续的配准、分割等分析。当评估不通过时，也可以通过 StereoMap 进行手动配准等图像处理分析，并接入 SAW 进行后续的分析。
en: Select the appropriate STOmics technology based on actual applications and requirements, and refer to the technical manual. If imaging is required, it is recommended to refer to this manual to conduct a preliminary evaluation of the microscope's hardware parameters and functionality. Once the preliminary evaluation is passed, when performing Stereo-seq chip slide imaging, first determine if the imaging quality meets the requirements using the microscope's local software, while also using the 'Tools' module of the StereoMap software to evaluate the imaging of the Track lines, etc. Once the evaluation of the Track lines and other features is passed, subsequent registration, segmentation, and other analyses can be performed automatically. If the evaluation fails, you can also perform manual registration and other image processing analyses using StereoMap, and then proceed with subsequent analysis in SAW.

zh: 当需要将可视化基因表达数据与组织图像联合分析时，须确保组织图像的分辨率与 Stereo-seq 技术的分辨率（500 nm）相匹配。图像分辨率取决于三个主要参数：物镜分辨率（由数值孔径（NA）决定）、物镜放大倍率和相机像素大小。最佳图像分辨率会根据目标（组织/细胞/其他标记物）的大小、染色特征的对比度以及所需的细节水平而有所不同。为了获得最佳分辨率，建议遵循显微镜厂商推荐的成像设置。
en: When joint analysis of visualized gene expression data and tissue images is required, ensure that the resolution of the tissue images matches the resolution of the Stereo-seq technology (500 nm). Image resolution depends on three main parameters: objective lens resolution (determined by numerical aperture (NA)), objective magnification, and camera pixel size. The optimal image resolution varies depending on the size of the target (tissue/cell/other markers), the contrast of staining features, and the level of detail required. To achieve optimal resolution, it is recommended to follow the imaging settings recommended by the microscope manufacturer.
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

Images within the suggested resolution ranges are ideal; however, if downstream analysis of Stereo-seq data has lower detail requirements, lower-resolution images can also be analyzed with the assistance of SAW and StereoMap software. Beyond the example imaging systems provided in Table 1, any equivalent imaging system can be used as an alternative based on user requirements and application scenarios.

zh: 对于 STOmics 实验中的拍照场景，建议使用放大倍率为 10 倍且数值孔径为 0.3 的空气物镜进行图像采集。如果使用更高的放大倍率物镜（≥20倍）或更高的数值孔径（≥1.0），请考虑以下事项：
en: For imaging scenarios in STOmics experiments, it is recommended to use an air objective with a magnification of 10x and a numerical aperture of 0.3 for image acquisition. If using an objective with a higher magnification (≥20x) or a higher numerical aperture (≥1.0), please consider the following:
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: · 焦深  （DF）  将变小。焦深是在一个图像平面内焦点出现的样本厚度。目标 NA  越高，DF  越低。这将导致存在一定厚度的样本对焦难度增加，成像不清晰。
en: · The Depth of Focus (DF) will decrease. The depth of focus is the thickness of the sample that appears in focus within an image plane. The higher the objective NA, the lower the DF. This results in increased difficulty in focusing on samples with a certain thickness, leading to blurred imaging.
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: · FOV 将变小，要获取包含整个组织切片的图像，需要采集和拼接更多的 FOV。这增加了拼接错误的可能性，从而导致相应基因表达数据的配准错误。
en: · The FOV will become smaller, requiring more FOVs to be acquired and stitched to obtain an image containing the entire tissue slice. This increases the possibility of stitching errors, thereby leading to registration errors in the corresponding gene expression data.
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: · 生成的图像将很大，文件大小通常 > 3 GB，并且可能达到 100 GB （大芯片等） 。处理这些图像需要一台具有适当内存资源和专用软件的计算机来上传、可视化图像并将图像导出为 BigTIFF。处理大文件所需的时间可能很长，以分钟来计。
en: · The generated images will be very large, typically with file sizes > 3 GB, and may reach 100 GB (e.g., for large chips). Processing these images requires a computer with appropriate memory resources and specialized software to upload, visualize the images, and export them as BigTIFF. The time required to process large files can be very long, often measured in minutes.
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 其中需要注意的是，目前 STOmics 配套的软件仅兼容 10X 镜下产出的图像，如果需要对其他倍数物镜产出的图像进行自动化配套分析，请将图像转为对应 10X 镜下的图像分辨率。（假设 10X 是满足情况的，比如 40X，则将图像缩小4*4倍再输入到软件中）
en: It should be noted that the current software suite for STOmics is only compatible with images produced using a 10X objective lens. If automated analysis is required for images produced with other objective magnifications, please convert the images to the resolution corresponding to a 10X objective lens. (Assuming 10X satisfies the requirements, for example, with 40X, downsample the image by a factor of 4x4 before inputting it into the software.)
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 以上是对成像系统各关键参数做了详细的描述和建议，实际情况下，最终的成像效果是否满足需求取决于成像系统的整体设计。以下列出一般情况下的成像系统需求。
en: The above provides a detailed description and recommendations for the key parameters of the imaging system. In practice, whether the final imaging results meet requirements depends on the overall design of the imaging system. The requirements for an imaging system under general conditions are listed below.
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 相比其他技术，Stereo-seq 技术可达到亚细胞分辨率。因此，如果有空间单细胞分辨率分析的需求，不仅需要组织细胞成像清晰，还需要确保芯片上标记物（Track线）成像也清晰。基于此需求，STOmics 通常建议图像的像素大小在0.3‒0.75 μm之间。
en: Compared to other technologies, Stereo-seq technology can achieve subcellular resolution. Therefore, if there is a requirement for spatial single-cell resolution analysis, it is necessary not only to have clear tissue and cell imaging, but also to ensure that the markers (Track lines) on the chip are clearly imaged. Based on this requirement, STOmics usually recommends an image pixel size of 0.3‒0.75 μm.
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 当进行单细胞水平分析时，图像处理的结果需要达到与之匹配的精度，以小鼠脑为例（鼠脑细胞直径约10 μm），需确保拼接误差 <5 μm ； 如不符合，通常是载物台运动偏差较大导致，请联系显微镜制造商的工程师进行调试 ；  也可导出 FOV 图像，使用第三方软件重新拼接 （如 FIJI、ImageJ） ；
en: When conducting single-cell level analysis, image processing results must achieve matching precision. Taking mouse brain as an example (where cell diameter is about 10 μm), it is necessary to ensure a stitching error of <5 μm; if this is not met, it is usually caused by large stage movement deviation, in which case please contact the microscope manufacturer's engineer for calibration. Alternatively, you can export FOV images and use third-party software for restitching (such as FIJI or ImageJ).
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 拼接后的图像在每个FOV交界处可能出现亮度不均（拼接痕迹）的情况，荧光成像下，可以从样本荧光信号弱、样本本身自发荧光较强或载物台平坦度差等方面排查原因；
en: Stitched images may exhibit uneven brightness (stitching artifacts) at each FOV interface. In fluorescence imaging, this can be troubleshooted by examining factors such as weak sample fluorescence signal, strong sample autofluorescence, or poor stage flatness.
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 除透化时间摸索成像外， 2） 中情况可通过显微镜的背景平衡功能进行改善；可在空白区域执行背景平衡操作但需注意，背景区域通常存在 Track 线，不可在视野中看到 Track 线 （可稍微离焦） ，否则可能导致最终成像出现双 Track 线情况，将影响后续分析；  这个是 Stereo-seq 芯片成像需要特别注意的，建议采用固定模板做背景平衡校正；
en: Apart from imaging for permeabilization time optimization, the situation in 2) can be improved using the microscope's background balancing function. Background balancing can be performed in a blank area, but note that track lines usually exist in the background area; these track lines must not be visible in the field of view (the image can be slightly out of focus), otherwise it may lead to double track lines in the final image, which will affect subsequent analysis. This is something that requires special attention in Stereo-seq chip imaging; it is recommended to use a fixed template for background balancing correction.
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 当需要对样本进行多种荧光染色时，需要核实不同荧光通道之间是否存在窜色，否则可能会影响单细胞的识别，请联系显微镜制造商的工程师协助调试。单通道多次拍照的情况下，需要确认多次拍照的图像间是否存在偏移，若存在异常，可使用第三方软件  （如 FIJI、ImageJ 等）  进行校准；
en: When multiple fluorescence stainings are required for a sample, it is necessary to verify whether there is bleed-through between different fluorescence channels; otherwise, it may affect single-cell identification. Please contact the microscope manufacturer's engineer for assistance with adjustments. In cases of multi-shot imaging in a single channel, it is necessary to confirm whether there is an offset between the images taken multiple times. If any abnormality exists, you can use third-party software (such as FIJI, ImageJ, etc.) for calibration.
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 对于明场成像，需要注意选择空白区域执行白平衡来调整相机的色彩平衡，若发现色彩与预期有明显差距，请联系显微镜制造商的工程师进行调试；
en: For bright-field imaging, be sure to select a blank area to perform white balance to adjust the camera's color balance. If you find a significant discrepancy between the color and what is expected, please contact the microscope manufacturer's engineer for adjustment.
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 荧光成像时，尽量避免过曝，可通过图像像素统计情况（如：直方图）来判断，刚好不过曝情况为：直方图曲率适中不贴边，此外，直方图横坐标最大值处仅有微小突起（如下图）；明场成像时，亮度参数适中，增益调至最低，曝光适当调整。
en: When performing fluorescence imaging, try to avoid overexposure, which can be assessed using image pixel statistics (e.g., a histogram). The ideal state of being just below overexposure is: the histogram has a moderate curvature without touching the edges; additionally, there is only a tiny protrusion at the maximum value on the histogram's horizontal axis (as shown in the figure below). For bright-field imaging, keep the brightness parameter moderate, adjust the gain to the lowest setting, and adjust the exposure appropriately.
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 荧光成像时，手动定焦成像过程中会有参数的调整，先对 Track 线进行对焦，可以拉高增益（Gain）和灯光强度，Track 线选点之后，对组织对焦时，将增益降到最低，选择图像上占据较大面积，又较亮的区域  （如下图红色框内区域）  ，调节曝光时间  （不超过 500 ms）  和灯光强度  （在 500 ms 曝光不能满足需求时增大光强）使该区域刚好不过曝。最后以组织区域的曝光参数为准进行成像；
en: When performing fluorescence imaging, there will be parameter adjustments during the manual focusing process. First, focus on the Track line; you may increase the Gain and light intensity. After selecting points on the Track line, when focusing on the tissue, set the Gain to the minimum. Select a region on the image that occupies a relatively large area and is brighter (as shown in the red box in the figure below), and adjust the exposure time (not exceeding 500 ms) and light intensity (increase light intensity if 500 ms exposure is insufficient) so that the region is just not overexposed. Finally, perform imaging based on the exposure parameters of the tissue region;
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 荧光成像时，由于激光长时间照射会导致荧光淬灭，为确保最佳成像效果，建议从封片到拍照，时长控制在30 min 以内（参考S1芯片）。
en: When performing fluorescence imaging, prolonged laser exposure can lead to fluorescence quenching. To ensure optimal imaging results, it is recommended to keep the time from mounting to imaging within 30 minutes (refer to the S1 chip).
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 来自荧光标记样品的各个通道图像可以单独打开或处理，最多可包含来自同一组织切片的六个文件。需要确保每张单色图像均以相同的放大倍数获取，具有相同的位深度、尺寸、方向和文件格式。若是单通道单独成像，需要确保通道之间的偏移满足分析需求。
en: Images of individual channels from fluorescently labeled samples can be opened or processed separately, with a maximum of six files from the same tissue section. Ensure that each monochrome image is acquired at the same magnification and has identical bit depth, dimensions, orientation, and file format. If imaging channels separately, ensure that the offset between channels meets analysis requirements.
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 当采集软件无法选择以其中一种兼容的格式类型保存或转换图像时，请使用第三方软件进行转换，例如FIJI/ImageJ。

zh: 根据不同的应用需求，对产出的图像进行即时的评估，可帮助拍图人员进行决策是否重新拍图，如果无法通过拍图优化获得到更好的图像质量，也可对图像情况进行初步判断，以提前预判后续的分析方案。STOmics  组学技术应用场景多样，对图像要求也不尽相同，因此大部分情况下是以用户人工评估为主，从而调整拍图方案获得满足需求的图像，或者调整分析方案以达到应用需求。
en: Based on different application requirements, real-time assessment of the generated images can help imaging personnel decide whether to re-image. If better image quality cannot be achieved through imaging optimization, a preliminary judgment of the image condition can also be made to anticipate subsequent analysis strategies. STOmics omics technology has diverse application scenarios, and image requirements vary accordingly. Therefore, in most cases, manual user assessment is the primary method, allowing for adjustments to the imaging protocol to obtain images that meet requirements, or adjustments to the analysis protocol to achieve application needs.
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 为提升产品体验，STOmics 提供了 StereoMap 软件来辅助用户进行图像质量的评估，其中最重要的是对芯片标记线  （track 线）  的评估，此为后续自动化配准的硬性需求，将作为后续质控结果的评判标准之一。
en: To enhance the product experience, STOmics provides StereoMap software to assist users in image quality assessment. The most critical aspect of this is the evaluation of the chip marker lines (track lines), which is a hard requirement for subsequent automated registration and will serve as one of the criteria for evaluating downstream quality control results.
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 1.拍摄的组织和细胞清晰，且在聚焦范围内；
en: 1. The imaged tissues and cells are clear and in focus;
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 2.拍摄的芯片 Track 线清晰；
en: 2. The imaged chip Track lines are clear;
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 3.无拼接错误；
en: 3. No stitching errors;

zh: StereoMap 是时空组学线下图像处理软件，主要涉及图像处理小工具、图像手动调整模块  （配准、组织分割和细胞分割等）  和交互式可视化展示。其中小工具中的图像评估主要从图像上 Track 线和组织细胞形态两个信息的清晰情况对显微镜拍摄的图像进行初步评估，以辅助判断如何使用 StereoMap 和 SAW 进行后续数据分析和信息挖据。
en: StereoMap is an offline image processing software for spatial omics, mainly involving image processing tools, manual image adjustment modules (registration, tissue segmentation, cell segmentation, etc.), and interactive visualization. Among the tools, image evaluation mainly performs a preliminary assessment of microscopic images based on the clarity of two types of information: tracks and tissue/cell morphology, to assist in determining how to use StereoMap and SAW for subsequent data analysis and information mining.

zh: 3）Track点能检测的越多且准确越好，并在图像上以  1）  为最小单位分布均匀。

zh: 基于以上情况，设定Track线打分规则：
en: Based on the above, the scoring rules for Track lines are set as follows:
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 在通过 track 点检测，筛选，计算出 scale 和 rotation 参数后，给出由图像 track 点推导出来的 track 点模板，与 QC 检点模型检出的 track 点计算误差（<5pixel），求出满足需求的点数占图像理论的模板点数的比例，以及由满足点围绕的最大外接图形面积占图像面积的比例，构成如下两个指标：
en: After performing track point detection, filtering, and calculating the scale and rotation parameters, a track point template derived from the image track points is provided. The error between this template and the track points detected by the QC inspection model is calculated (<5 pixels). Two indicators are then formed: the ratio of the points meeting the requirements to the theoretical template points in the image, and the ratio of the maximum circumscribed area enclosed by these satisfied points to the total image area.
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: TemplateValidArea ： 误差在 5 pixels 以内的推导模板点数，所能构成的包围面积占整体图像面积的比例。如图3 中，黄色区域包围的像素面积与整张图像的像素面积的比值：  460718882 pixels/604856088 pixels=0.76
en: TemplateValidArea: The ratio of the area enclosed by the derived template points (with an error within 5 pixels) to the total image area. As shown in Figure 3, the ratio of the pixel area enclosed by the yellow region to the total pixel area of the image is: 460718882 pixels / 604856088 pixels = 0.76.
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: TemplateRecall ： 误差在 5 pixels 以内的推导模板点数占理论上芯片对应图像所拥有的模板点数的比例。如图 3中，黄色点阵中的 Track 点数与整张图像的模板点数的比值：  2636/4760=0.55
en: TemplateRecall: The ratio of the number of inferred template points with an error within 5 pixels to the theoretical number of template points that the corresponding chip image should have. As shown in Figure 3, the ratio of the number of Track points in the yellow dot matrix to the total number of template points in the entire image is: 2636/4760=0.55
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 取两个比值中的最大值，并将最大值线性映射为百分制分数。Tack 线 QC 状态为成功，即说明算法可以通过图像 Track 点正确推导出模板，预配准成功。
en: Take the maximum of the two ratios and linearly map the maximum value to a percentage-based score. A successful QC status for the Track line indicates that the algorithm can correctly infer the template from the Track points in the image, signifying successful pre-alignment.
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 在多通道荧光染色成像过程中，如果使用的是单通道多次成像方式，不同荧光图像间可能存在偏移，StereoMap 软件运用相似性校准算法辅助评估多通道荧光图像整体偏移量。由于多通道图像获取的是组织不同的信息，相似度无法保证，这部分仅作为偏移评估打分，不做校准操作，也不作为 QC 内容。在使用 StereoMap 查看数据结果时，请人工确认实际情况是否满足后续分析需求，若不满足，请使用第三方工具校准后，再使用StereoMap 和 SAW 进行后续分析。
en: In the multi-channel fluorescence staining imaging process, if a single-channel multi-imaging method is used, there may be offsets between different fluorescence images. StereoMap software uses a similarity calibration algorithm to assist in assessing the overall offset of multi-channel fluorescence images. Since multi-channel images acquire different information from the tissue, similarity cannot be guaranteed; therefore, this part only serves as an offset assessment score, does not perform calibration operations, and is not included as QC content. When viewing data results using StereoMap, please manually confirm whether the actual situation meets the requirements for subsequent analysis. If it does not, please use a third-party tool for calibration before using StereoMap and SAW for subsequent analysis.
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

en: In most cases, Track lines can only be observed by adjusting the contrast in non-tissue areas. On fluorescence images, Track lines appear as dark lines due to their lower brightness. In bright-field mode, they appear as white lines.

zh: Track 线是排布在芯片上的直线，且一般与芯片边缘平行。对焦不清晰会导致 Track 无法检测成功。芯片放置倾斜也会导致检测准确性降低。若出现拼接错误，Track 也可看到清晰错位。
en: Track lines are straight lines arranged on the chip and are generally parallel to the chip edges. Improper focusing can lead to failure in Track detection. Tilted placement of the chip also reduces detection accuracy. If stitching errors occur, clear misalignments in the Tracks can be observed.

zh: 适当的曝光可以提供良好的亮度和对比度。图像像素值范围 （0-255，8 bit） 且整体致亮度值分布合理，高段值仅有小突起。
en: Proper exposure provides good brightness and contrast. The image pixel value range is (0-255, 8-bit) and the overall brightness distribution is reasonable, with only small spikes at the high-end values.
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 曝光不足的图像具有低亮感（低像素值）和低对比度（低图像动态范围），这会导致细节丢失和分辨率受损。像素强度直亮度值方图跨越整个像素值范围的下四分之一（0-60）。
en: Underexposed images have low perceived brightness (low pixel values) and low contrast (low image dynamic range), which leads to loss of detail and impaired resolution. The pixel intensity histogram spans the lower quarter (0-60) of the entire pixel value range.
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 曝光过度的图像表现部分区域具有高亮度，饱和像素和低对比度，导致数据丢失和分辨率受损。像素强度直方图在高值段 （255） 被截断，表明部分像素已饱和。
en: Overexposed images exhibit high brightness in some areas, saturated pixels, and low contrast, resulting in data loss and impaired resolution. The pixel intensity histogram is truncated at the high-end range (255), indicating that some pixels are saturated.
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 曝光参数会直接影响成像质量，直方图一般会在显微镜软件上呈现，可供参考（下图展示）。由于参数设置不合适导致的图像异常是不可修复的，且 Track 线和组织所需的参数有差异，请参考成像指南进

zh: 曝光不足的图像具有低亮度（像素值）和低对比度（范围），这会导致颜色不准确、细节丢失和分辨率受损。像素值分布跨越整个像素值范围的下三分之一      （  0-90）。

zh: 将多个 FOV 拼接成大图像时，需要通过后续的特征配准来纠正由于载物台运动偏移导致的相邻 FOV 之间的拼接错误。拼接正常的效果如上图所示，Track 线无错位，细胞无错位无重影（红色箭头区域比较）。
en: When stitching multiple FOVs into a large image, subsequent feature registration is required to correct stitching errors between adjacent FOVs caused by stage motion offsets. The result of successful stitching is shown in the image above, where the track lines are aligned without displacement, and the cells are aligned without ghosting (compare the areas indicated by red arrows).
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 当仅靠载物台坐标而不进行特征配准（或特征不明显）将多个 FOV 拼接成大图像时，相邻 FOV 之间的边界（红色箭头）可能出现组织/细胞错位。
en: When stitching multiple FOVs into a large image relying solely on stage coordinates without feature registration (or when features are indistinct), tissue/cell misalignment may occur at the boundaries between adjacent FOVs (indicated by red arrows).
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 合格图像不合格图像
en: Qualified images and unqualified images
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 明场情况下，在空白区域执行白平衡，获得具有良好色调和对比度的图像，可以准确反映染色样本情况等信息。
en: In bright-field conditions, performing white balance on a blank area yields an image with good color tone and contrast, which can accurately reflect information such as the condition of the stained sample.
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 当不执行白平衡时，图像将出现错误颜色，未矫正的颜色和对比度将对组织结构识别和注释产生误导。
en: When white balance is not performed, the images will exhibit incorrect colors, and the uncorrected color and contrast will be misleading for tissue structure identification and annotation.
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 将多个 FOV 拼接成大图像时应用背景平衡可以校正由于视场不均匀而导致的伪影。正确对准和设置照明路径也可以减少阴影伪影。左侧图像具有相同的视场并进行了适当的背景平衡。
en: Applying background balancing when stitching multiple FOVs into a large image can correct artifacts caused by field non-uniformity. Correct alignment and setup of the illumination path can also reduce shading artifacts. The image on the left has identical fields of view and has been properly background-balanced.
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 当视场不均匀时，在未进行校正的情况下拼接多个视场时，可能会出现阴影伪影（拼接痕迹）。
en: When the field of view is non-uniform, shading artifacts (stitching seams) may appear when stitching multiple fields together without correction.
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: 背景平衡的模板不应该存在 Track 线，建议使用固定的校正模板。当模板出现 Track 线时 ，获取的图像会出现双 Track 线，如上图所示，原图调节对比度后，白色线为真实Track 线（如图白色箭头所示），黑色线为假 Track 线（如图黑色箭头所示），图像信息异常，同时后续分析也无法进行。
en: Background-balanced templates should not contain Track lines; it is recommended to use fixed calibration templates. When a Track line appears in the template, the acquired image will show double Track lines, as shown in the figure above. After adjusting the contrast of the original image, the white line is the real Track line (as indicated by the white arrow in the figure), and the black line is the false Track line (as indicated by the black arrow in the figure). The image information is abnormal, and subsequent analysis cannot be performed.
source_manual: Stereo-seq空间多组学技术成像指南

zh: a.  从Stereo-seq 载体配件包中取出夹具和垫圈；

zh: c.  用手指微调垫圈边缘位置，使垫圈与夹具更紧密地契合；

source_manual: Stereo-seq芯片载体及配件使用说明书

zh: d.  使用空气罐尽可能地吹去表面的杂质或碎屑；
en: d. Use a can of compressed air to blow away any surface impurities or debris as much as possible;
source_manual: Stereo-seq芯片载体及配件使用说明书

zh: e.   拿起Stereo-seq 芯片载体，芯片面朝下，将芯片载体标签朝夹具的长边卡扣方向；
en: e. Pick up the Stereo-seq chip slide, chip face down, with the chip slide label facing towards the long side clip of the fixture;
source_manual: Stereo-seq芯片载体及配件使用说明书

en: h. Press along both sides of the fixture cartridge to ensure the fixture and chip slide are securely assembled together;

zh: i.  最后检查组装好的夹具和芯片载体，确保位置正确。

zh: g.  先将芯片载体卡进夹具下方4 个卡扣。双手中指支撑夹具的正面，左手拇指放在tab 1 和tab 2 之间，右手拇指放在tab 3 和tab 4 之间，拇指匀力向下按压芯片载体，直至听到“咔”的一声。双手食指用力向下按压夹具顶部边缘，将载体卡进夹具上方4 个卡扣;
en: g. First, snap the chip slide into the 4 clips at the bottom of the fixture. Support the front of the fixture with the middle fingers of both hands, place the left thumb between tab 1 and tab 2, and the right thumb between tab 3 and tab 4. Apply even downward pressure on the chip slide with both thumbs until a "click" sound is heard. Firmly press down on the top edge of the fixture with both index fingers to snap the carrier into the 4 clips at the top of the fixture;
source_manual: Stereo-seq芯片载体及配件使用说明书

zh: f.  芯片对准垫圈孔位，避免夹具和垫圈接触芯片表面；

en: • This product is intended for research use only and is not for clinical diagnostic use. Please read this manual carefully before use.
source_manual: Stereo-seq芯片载体及配件使用说明书

zh: • 实验前请熟悉需使用的各种仪器的注意事项并掌握其操作方法。
en: • Before the experiment, please familiarize yourself with the precautions for the various instruments to be used and master their operating procedures.
source_manual: Stereo-seq芯片载体及配件使用说明书

zh: • 本说明书提供的实验流程是通用的，实际操作中可根据具体的实验设计、样本特征、测序应用和设备进行实验流程、反应参数的调整，以优化性能和效率。
en: • The experimental protocols provided in this manual are general. In actual operation, the protocols and reaction parameters may be adjusted based on specific experimental designs, sample characteristics, sequencing applications, and equipment to optimize performance and efficiency.
source_manual: Stereo-seq芯片载体及配件使用说明书

zh: • 推荐使用前将各试剂组分提前取出，将酶类组分瞬时离心后置于冰上备用，并将其他组分置于室温解冻。解冻后轻柔地上下颠倒数次使其充分混匀，瞬时离心后置于冰上备用。
en: • It is recommended to remove all reagent components in advance before use. Briefly centrifuge the enzyme components and place them on ice. Thaw the remaining components at room temperature. After thawing, gently invert the tubes several times to mix thoroughly, then briefly centrifuge and place them on ice until ready for use.
source_manual: Stereo-seq芯片载体及配件使用说明书

zh: • 为避免样本交叉污染，推荐使用带滤芯的吸头，吸取不同样本时请更换吸头。
en: • To prevent sample cross-contamination, it is recommended to use filtered pipette tips and to change tips between different samples.
source_manual: Stereo-seq芯片载体及配件使用说明书

zh: • 推荐把PCR 仪温度预热至反应温度。
en: • It is recommended to preheat the PCR instrument to the reaction temperature.
source_manual: Stereo-seq芯片载体及配件使用说明书

zh: • 应避免皮肤和眼睛直接接触样本及试剂，切勿吞咽样本及试剂，一旦发生意外请立即用大量清水冲洗并及时就医。
en: • Avoid direct contact of samples and reagents with skin and eyes. Do not swallow samples or reagents. In case of accidental contact, rinse immediately with plenty of water and seek medical attention promptly.
source_manual: Stereo-seq芯片载体及配件使用说明书

zh: • 所有样本和各种废弃物均应按相关法规规定处理。
en: • All samples and various wastes should be disposed of in accordance with relevant regulations.
source_manual: Stereo-seq芯片载体及配件使用说明书

zh: a.  将夹具翻转过来，用力按压夹具上方卡带，使芯片载体从夹具中脱离。用大拇指稍微挡住载体背面，避免载体弹出；
en: a. Invert the fixture and press firmly on the cartridge above it to release the chip slide from the fixture. Slightly cover the back of the carrier with your thumb to prevent it from popping out;

zh: Stereo-seq芯片载体装于真空密封的铝袋中，冷链运输。
en: Stereo-seq chip slides are vacuum-sealed in aluminum bags and shipped via cold chain.
source_manual: STOG00002-Stereo-seq芯片载体保存操作指南

zh: 若发现冷链箱温度异常，可要求物流方现场打印温度实时监控记录表；签收后也可联系当地科研合作代表，以查询相关记录。

zh: 请及时确认铝袋是否完好并处于真空密封状态，随后立即将未开封的芯片载体转移至-25℃~-15℃的条件下储存。 若转移时间较长，建议使用控温容器运输。
en: Please promptly verify that the aluminum bag is intact and vacuum-sealed, then immediately transfer the unopened chip slide to storage at -25°C to -15°C. If the transfer time is extended, it is recommended to use a temperature-controlled container for transport.
source_manual: STOG00002-Stereo-seq芯片载体保存操作指南

zh: 未开封的情况下，产品可在-25℃~-15℃保存至标签上的有效期。

zh: 将未使用的Stereo-seq芯片载体放入玻片盒，随后放回原装铝袋中。往铝袋中放入干燥剂，尽量挤出袋内空气并重新密封。

zh: 再次确认铝袋是否完好并处于密封状态，随后立即将铝袋储存在-25℃~-15℃。未真空密封的芯片不可放置超过两周，开封后请尽快使用。
en: Reconfirm that the aluminum foil bag is intact and properly sealed, then immediately store it at -25°C to -15°C. Chips that are not vacuum-sealed must not be stored for more than two weeks; please use them as soon as possible after opening.

source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

zh: ①Stereo-seq 芯片（ 0.5 cm * 0.5 cm）：组织尺寸不应超过 0.45 cm × 0.45 cm × 2 cm；组织切片 / 芯片面积不应超过 80%。
en: (1) Stereo-seq chip (0.5 cm × 0.5 cm): The tissue size should not exceed 0.45 cm × 0.45 cm × 2 cm; the ratio of the tissue slice area to the chip area should not exceed 80%.
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

zh: ②Stereo-seq 芯片（ 1 cm * 1 cm）：组织尺寸不应超过 0.9 cm × 0.9 cm × 2 cm，组织切片 / 芯片面积不应超过 80%。
en: ② Stereo-seq chip (1 cm × 1 cm): Tissue size should not exceed 0.9 cm × 0.9 cm × 2 cm; the tissue slice/chip area ratio should not exceed 80%.
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

zh: ③Stereo-seq 芯片（ 1 cm * 2 cm）：组织尺寸不应超过 0.9 cm × 1.8 cm × 0.7 cm；
en: ③ Stereo-seq chip (1 cm × 2 cm): Tissue size should not exceed 0.9 cm × 1.8 cm × 0.7 cm;
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

zh: ④Stereo-seq 芯片（ 2 cm * 2 cm）：组织尺寸不应超过 1.8 cm × 1.8 cm × 0.7 cm；
en: ④ Stereo-seq chip (2 cm × 2 cm): Tissue size should not exceed 1.8 cm × 1.8 cm × 0.7 cm;
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

zh: ⑤Stereo-seq 芯片（ 2 cm * 3 cm）：组织尺寸不应超过 1.8 cm × 2.7 cm × 0.7 cm；
en: ⑤ Stereo-seq chip (2 cm * 3 cm): Tissue size should not exceed 1.8 cm × 2.7 cm × 0.7 cm;
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

zh: 组织切片 / 芯片面积不应超过 80%。
en: The tissue section/chip area should not exceed 80%.
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

zh: 也支持对冻存组织进行包埋处理后开展实验。但冻存组织可能存在碎裂、挤压变形等情况，所以接收样本后除了确认RNA 完整性，还应特别注意组织形态，确认组织形态符合要求、可以顺利完成贴片后再进行下游实验。
en: Experiments can also be conducted on frozen tissue after embedding. However, frozen tissue may be prone to fragmentation or compression-induced deformation, so upon receiving samples, in addition to verifying RNA integrity, special attention must be paid to tissue morphology. Ensure the tissue morphology meets the requirements and that mounting can be successfully completed before proceeding with downstream experiments.
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

en: Spatiotemporal Experiment FF Sample Preparation User Guide Chapter 1: Preparation Workflow

zh: 时空转录组FF、时空转录组FF 兼容mIF 应用、时空转录组大尺寸芯片：适用于常见动物物种的时空转录组研究，包括但不限于人、猴、鼠等样本，详情可参考《Stereo-seq 试剂套装推荐样本》。
en: Spatiotemporal Transcriptomics FF, Spatiotemporal Transcriptomics FF compatible with mIF application, and Spatiotemporal Transcriptomics large-format chip: Suitable for spatiotemporal transcriptomics research on common animal species, including but not limited to samples from humans, monkeys, and mice. For details, please refer to the "Stereo-seq Reagent Kit Recommended Samples".
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

zh: 为保证样本质量，降低实验风险，建议切取 10-20 片 10 μm 厚的组织片，存放至–20℃下预冷的 1.5 mL EP 管中，然后进行Total RNA 的提取和质量检测。
en: To ensure sample quality and reduce experimental risk, it is recommended to collect 10–20 tissue sections, each 10 μm thick, store them in 1.5 mL EP tubes pre-cooled at –20°C, and then proceed with total RNA extraction and quality control.
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

zh: 时空蛋白转录组Stereo-CITE：适用于人和小鼠样本的多重蛋白和全转录组共同检测。
en: Stereo-CITE: Suitable for simultaneous detection of multiplex proteins and the whole transcriptome in human and mouse samples.
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

zh: 若您使用的是时空转录组 FF（含兼容 mIF）≥ V1.3、时空蛋白转录组 Stereo-CITE ≥ V1.1，建议只对 RIN ≥ 4 的组织样本进行后续实验操作，否则建议只对 RIN ≥ 7 的组织样本进行后续实验操作。
en: If you are using Stereo-seq FF (including mIF-compatible) ≥ V1.3 or Stereo-CITE ≥ V1.1, it is recommended to proceed with tissue samples having a RIN ≥ 4; otherwise, it is recommended to proceed only with tissue samples having a RIN ≥ 7.
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

zh: 若您使用的是时空转录组 FF 大尺寸芯片≥ V1.3，建议只对 RIN ≥ 6 的组织样本进行后续实验操作，否则建议只对 RIN ≥ 7 的组织样本进行后续实验操作。
en: If you are using Stereo-seq FF Large-format chip ≥ V1.3, it is recommended to proceed with tissue samples having a RIN ≥ 6; otherwise, it is recommended to proceed only with tissue samples having a RIN ≥ 7.
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南
