zh: a1. 提前准备一泡沫箱碎冰并将OCT 放在冰上预冷10 min；
en: a1. Prepare a foam box of crushed ice in advance and place the OCT on the ice to pre-chill for 10 min;
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

zh: a2. 根据组织大小提前准备两个合适大小的金属包埋盒A 和B
en: a2. Based on the tissue size, prepare two appropriately sized metal embedding cassettes A and B in advance.
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

zh: a5. 准备一泡沫箱干冰；
en: a5. Prepare a foam box of dry ice;
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

zh: a6. 准备具有平整面的金属块，金属块面积需大于金属包埋盒A，用于平放金属包埋盒；
en: a6. Prepare a metal block with a flat surface; the area of the metal block must be larger than the metal embedding cassette A, for laying the metal embedding cassette flat;
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

zh: a3. 提前将预冷好的OCT 填充金属包埋盒A 的2/3 左右，并放置在冰上预冷10 min 以上（可使用注射器吸弃产生的气泡）；
en: a3. Fill about 2/3 of the metal embedding cassette A with pre-cooled OCT in advance, and place it on ice to pre-cool for at least 10 minutes (a syringe can be used to aspirate any generated air bubbles);
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

zh: a4. 在平皿中加满OCT，提前预冷10 min（可使用注射器吸弃产生的气泡）；
en: a4. Fill a Petri dish with OCT and pre-cool for 10 minutes in advance (a syringe can be used to aspirate any generated air bubbles);
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

zh: a7. 将金属块平整面向上放置到干冰中，预冷5 min 以上；
en: a7. Place the metal block into the dry ice with the flat side facing up, and pre-cool for at least 5 minutes;
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

zh: a8. 将金属包埋盒B 放置于干冰中预冷5 min 以上。
en: a8. Place the metal embedding cassette B into the dry ice and pre-cool for at least 5 minutes.
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

zh: b.  新鲜组织离体30 min 内，用无菌无纺布或无尘纸擦干组织表面液体，以避免在组织表面形成冰块，影响后续包埋切片；
en: b. Within 30 minutes of fresh tissue excision, wipe the liquid from the tissue surface using sterile non-woven fabric or dust-free paper to prevent the formation of ice crystals on the surface, which could affect subsequent embedding and sectioning;
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

zh: 第二章  样本包埋时空实验FF 样本准备操作指南
en: Chapter 2 Spatiotemporal Embedding Experiment: FF Sample Preparation Operation Guide
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

zh: c.  将组织放入在冰上预冷的OCT 中，在不产生气泡的前提下用药匙使组织被OCT 包裹（可使用注射器吸弃产生的气泡）；
en: c. Place the tissue into pre-chilled OCT on ice, and use a spatula to ensure the tissue is covered by OCT without creating air bubbles (a syringe can be used to aspirate any air bubbles that form);
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

zh: d.  将组织的拟切面朝下，放入冰上预冷的金属包埋盒A 中，（根据组织大小选择金属包埋盒A 的尺寸）使组织接触到金属包埋盒A 的底部。在不产生气泡的前提下用预冷的 OCT 填满金属包埋盒A，直至将组织完全覆盖（可使用注射器吸弃产生的气泡）；
en: d. Place the intended sectioning surface of the tissue facing downwards into the pre-chilled metal embedding mold A (select the size of the metal embedding mold A according to the tissue size) so that the tissue touches the bottom of the metal embedding mold A. Fill the metal embedding mold A with pre-chilled OCT without creating air bubbles until the tissue is completely covered (a syringe can be used to aspirate any air bubbles that form);
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

zh: e.  将装有组织的金属包埋盒A，水平放置在干冰预冷的金属块上；
en: e. Place the metal embedding mold A containing the tissue horizontally onto a metal block pre-chilled with dry ice;
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

zh: f.  先将预冷的钢尺放在金属包埋盒A 的长高边上( 防止组织被压变形)，然后将金属包埋盒B 开口向上，轻轻加盖于装有组织块的金属包埋盒A 的上方，并在其开口中放置碎干冰，使干冰尽可能充分覆盖金属包埋盒表 ；
en: f. First, place a pre-cooled steel ruler on the long edge of metal embedding cassette A (to prevent the tissue from being deformed by pressure), then gently cover metal embedding cassette A, which contains the tissue block, with metal embedding cassette B with its opening facing upward, and place crushed dry ice into the opening of cassette B, ensuring the dry ice covers the surface of the metal embedding cassette as completely as possible;
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

zh: 时空实验FF 样本准备操作指南
en: Operating Guide for Spacetime Experiment FF Sample Preparation
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

zh: g.  冷冻5 min 后，移去金属包埋盒B和钢尺，检查OCT 是否完全凝固且变成白色不透明状, 若未完全冷冻好，则重复f；
en: g. After freezing for 5 min, remove the metal embedding cassette B and the steel ruler, and check whether the OCT is completely solidified and has turned white and opaque. If it is not completely frozen, repeat step f;
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

zh: h.  如果组织块完全凝固并变成白色不透明状，用手轻掰金属包埋盒A 两侧，即可使OCT 包埋组织块从金属包埋盒A中脱模；
en: h. If the tissue block is completely solidified and has turned white and opaque, gently bend the sides of the metal embedding cassette A by hand to demold the OCT-embedded tissue block from the metal embedding cassette A;
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

zh: i.  检查包埋块底部是否被完全覆盖, 如未完全覆盖，则将组织块放置在金属块上，底部向上，在表面涂上少量OCT，待OCT 完全凝固且不透明，在包埋块切面位置做好标记。
en: i. Check if the bottom of the embedding block is completely covered; if not, place the tissue block on a metal block with the bottom facing up, apply a small amount of OCT to the surface, wait until the OCT has completely solidified and become opaque, and mark the sectioning orientation on the embedding block.
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

zh: 第三章  样本的保存和运输时空实验FF 样本准备操作指南
en: Chapter 3: Sample Preservation and Transportation - Spatial-Temporal Experiment FF Sample Preparation Operation Guide

zh: 将组织包埋块使用锡纸包裹，并做好标记放入自封袋，在自封袋上做好记录，放入−80℃冰箱长期保存。如需邮寄，可选干冰邮寄。
en: Wrap the tissue embedding block with aluminum foil, label it, and place it into a self-sealing bag. Record the information on the self-sealing bag and store it long-term in a -80°C freezer. If shipping is required, it can be shipped with dry ice.
source_manual: STOG00010-时空实验FF样本准备操作指南

en: This manual is applicable to the Stereo-seq Permeabilization Reagent Kit V1.1 (Carrier version).
source_manual: STOG01012-时空转录组FFV1.3透化测试操作说明书

zh: STOmics Stereo-seq 透化试剂套装 V1.1（载体版）是用于摸索新鲜冷冻(Fresh Frozen, FF) 样本最佳透化时间的预实验试剂套装，FF 样本要求参考《时空实验FF样本准备操作指南》。本试剂套装采用的 Stereo-seq 时空转录组技术，是一种基于 DNBSEQ 高通量测序技术开发的、具有高分辨大视场的原位全转录组信息捕获技术。 Stereo-seq 芯片 P（透化测试芯片）上载有核苷酸捕获探针，与组织切片结合后通过探针原位抓取组织内的 mRNA 分子，再利用带有荧光标记的核苷酸进行 cDNA 合成。研究人员通过荧光显微成像可以快速判断特定组织的最佳透化时间。
en: The STOmics Stereo-seq Permeabilization Reagent Kit V1.1 (Carrier version) is a pre-experiment reagent kit used to explore the optimal permeabilization time for Fresh Frozen (FF) samples. For FF sample requirements, please refer to the "Spatio-Temporal Experiment FF Sample Preparation Operation Guide". The Stereo-seq spatiotemporal transcriptomics technology used in this reagent kit is an in situ whole-transcriptome information capture technology developed based on DNBSEQ high-throughput sequencing technology, featuring high resolution and a large field of view. Stereo-seq Chip P (permeabilization test chip) is loaded with nucleotide capture probes that, upon binding to tissue sections, capture mRNA molecules within the tissue in situ, followed by cDNA synthesis using fluorescently labeled nucleotides. Researchers can quickly determine the optimal permeabilization time for specific tissues via fluorescence microscopy imaging.
source_manual: STOG01012-时空转录组FFV1.3透化测试操作说明书

zh: 此试剂盒套装可结合 H&E 染色，研究人员可以更清晰地观察到组织形态学信息，在时空病理研究与应用中更准确地判断组织分型及获取特定组织区域的表达信息，针对选定区域进行下游差异分析和富集分析。
en: This reagent kit can be combined with H&E staining, allowing researchers to observe histological information more clearly. In spatiotemporal pathology research and applications, this enables more accurate determination of tissue types and acquisition of expression information for specific tissue regions, facilitating downstream differential analysis and enrichment analysis on the selected regions.
source_manual: STOG01012-时空转录组FFV1.3透化测试操作说明书

zh: 如需在同一个载体的不同芯片上贴2 个不同组织的切片，建议将两个组织都修好片后，先对一个组织切片，使用热贴方式贴片，将载体放至PCR 适配器上37℃等待贴下一个组织，等待时间控制在5 min 以内；然后换另外一个组织切片，使用热贴方式贴片，快速将载体置于PCR 适配器上37℃孵育5 min。
en: If it is necessary to mount sections of 2 different tissues on different chips of the same carrier, it is recommended that after both tissues are trimmed, you first section one tissue, mount it using the thermal mounting method, place the carrier on the PCR adapter at 37°C while waiting to mount the next tissue, and control the waiting time to within 5 minutes; then switch to the other tissue section, mount it using the thermal mounting method, and quickly place the carrier on the PCR adapter to incubate at 37°C for 5 minutes.
source_manual: STOG01012-时空转录组FFV1.3透化测试操作说明书

zh: 3）立即拿起芯片载体，用指腹放在载体背面加温几秒钟，直至切片贴合；
en: 3) Immediately pick up the chip slide and warm the back of the carrier with your fingertip for a few seconds until the section adheres;
source_manual: STOG01012-时空转录组FFV1.3透化测试操作说明书

zh: 4）重复上述操作，直至所有切片贴片完成，建议组织切片贴片控制在5 min 内；
en: 4) Repeat the above steps until all sections are mounted; it is recommended to complete the tissue section mounting within 5 minutes;
source_manual: STOG01012-时空转录组FFV1.3透化测试操作说明书

zh: 5）快速将载体置于PCR 适配器上37℃孵育5 min，无需盖PCR 热盖。
en: 5) Quickly place the carrier on the PCR adapter and incubate at 37°C for 5 minutes; it is not necessary to cover with the PCR thermal lid.
source_manual: STOG01012-时空转录组FFV1.3透化测试操作说明书

zh: 1)  将载体芯片正面朝上置于切片机中，预冷1-6 min；
en: 1) Place the carrier chip front side up into the cryostat and pre-cool for 1-6 min;
source_manual: STOG01012-时空转录组FFV1.3透化测试操作说明书

zh: 2）进行冷冻切片，然后用预冷的毛刷轻轻拨动切片周围的OCT 使切片铺平。用镊子和毛刷将切片小心覆盖在芯片正中央并铺平，注意毛刷不要触碰到组织。尽量一次贴片成功，确保组织切片完整，无褶皱；
en: 2) Perform cryosectioning, then use a pre-cooled brush to gently manipulate the OCT around the section to flatten it. Carefully use tweezers and the brush to place the section in the center of the chip and flatten it, ensuring the brush does not touch the tissue. Try to mount successfully in one attempt to ensure the tissue section is intact and free of wrinkles;
source_manual: STOG01012-时空转录组FFV1.3透化测试操作说明书

zh: 预冷时间不可过长，以免玻片表面产生水雾；预冷时间不可太短，以免玻片无法达到预冷温度。
en: The pre-cooling time must not be too long to prevent condensation on the slide surface, nor too short to ensure the slide reaches the required pre-cooling temperature.
source_manual: STOG01012-时空转录组FFV1.3透化测试操作说明书

zh: 进行冷贴时需控制好每张切片贴片时间，间隔时间太长，组织贴片会皱缩。
en: When performing cold mounting, control the mounting time for each section; if the interval is too long, the tissue section will wrinkle.
source_manual: STOG01012-时空转录组FFV1.3透化测试操作说明书

zh: （可选暂停点）将孵育好的芯片载体放于玻片盒或者50 mL 离心管，然后将其放入可密封的塑料袋中，同时放入干燥剂包，尽可能多地挤出空气并将塑料袋密封。用干冰快速转移到−80℃冰箱，最长可于−80℃保存一个月。
en: (Optional pause point) Place the incubated chip slide into a slide box or a 50 mL centrifuge tube, then place it into a sealable plastic bag along with a desiccant pack. Squeeze out as much air as possible and seal the bag. Transfer rapidly using dry ice to a −80°C freezer, where it can be stored for up to one month.
source_manual: STOG01012-时空转录组FFV1.3透化测试操作说明书

zh: 继续实验时，使用干冰将玻片盒或者50 mL 离心管转移，取出贴有组织的芯片载体，快速置于PCR 适配器上37℃孵育5 min。
en: To continue the experiment, transfer the slide box or 50 mL centrifuge tube using dry ice, retrieve the chip slide with the tissue attached, and quickly place it onto the PCR adapter to incubate at 37°C for 5 minutes.
source_manual: STOG01012-时空转录组FFV1.3透化测试操作说明书

zh: 1）连续切取组织切片，将切片移到切片台右侧靠近边缘处，然后用预冷的毛刷轻轻拨动切片周围的OCT 使切片铺平，每张切片放置间隔距离大于载体宽度；
en: 1) Continuously cut tissue sections, move the sections to the edge on the right side of the cryostat stage, then use a pre-cooled brush to gently manipulate the OCT around the sections to flatten them, ensuring the spacing between each section is greater than the width of the carrier;
source_manual: STOG01012-时空转录组FFV1.3透化测试操作说明书

zh: 2）拿起载体的一边，使芯片正面朝下，对准切片；
en: 2) Pick up the carrier by one side, orient the chip face down, and align it with the section;
source_manual: STOG01012-时空转录组FFV1.3透化测试操作说明书

zh: 3）轻轻一压，肉眼可见切片已经吸附到芯片表面；
en: 3) Gently press down; the section will be visibly adhered to the chip surface;
source_manual: STOG01012-时空转录组FFV1.3透化测试操作说明书

zh: 4）重复 2）-3）步骤操作，直至全部组织切片吸附到芯片表面（贴片时间控制在1 min 以内）；
en: 4) Repeat steps 2)-3) until all tissue sections are adhered to the chip surface (control the mounting time to within 1 min);
source_manual: STOG01012-时空转录组FFV1.3透化测试操作说明书

zh: 5）将芯片正面朝上，快速将载体置于提前平衡温度的PCR 适配器上，37℃孵育5 min，无需盖PCR 热盖。
en: 5) Place the chip face up, quickly place the carrier onto the pre-equilibrated PCR adapter, incubate at 37°C for 5 min, and there is no need to close the PCR thermal lid.
source_manual: STOG01012-时空转录组FFV1.3透化测试操作说明书

zh: Stereo-seq 兼容H&E 染色的产品方案包含H&E 染色工作流程，透化测试环节增加了H&E 染色工作流程，包含组织固定与伊红染色、苏木素及返蓝染色、H&E 封片剂封片的操作，目的是需要在组织透化测试之前进行H&E 染色以获得更准确的透化时间，具体操作步骤参考附录A。如后续不需要使用Stereo-seq 兼容H&E 染色的产品方案，可以直接进行下面的步骤a。
en: The product scheme for Stereo-seq compatible with H&E staining includes an H&E staining workflow. An H&E staining workflow has been added to the tissue permeabilization test stage, which includes operations for tissue fixation and eosin staining, hematoxylin and bluing, and mounting with H&E mounting medium. The purpose is to perform H&E staining before the tissue permeabilization test to obtain a more accurate permeabilization time; refer to Appendix A for specific operational steps. If you do not need to use the Stereo-seq compatible H&E staining product scheme subsequently, you may proceed directly to step a below.
source_manual: STOG01012-时空转录组FFV1.3透化测试操作说明书

source_manual: STOG01012-时空转录组FFV1.3透化测试操作说明书

zh: 所有芯片，固定 30 min（固定时间最长不超过1 hr）；

en: b. After fixation is complete, transfer the slide box or 50 mL centrifuge tube to a fume hood;
source_manual: STOG01012-时空转录组FFV1.3透化测试操作说明书

en: c. Remove the carrier from the slide box or 50 mL centrifuge tube, and use lint-free paper to blot dry the back of the slide and around the chip
source_manual: STOG01012-时空转录组FFV1.3透化测试操作说明书

en: of excess methanol, ensuring no residual liquid;

en: This operation manual is applicable to the Stereo-seq Transcriptomics Kit V1.3 (Slide Version).
source_manual: STOG01013-时空转录组FFV1.3转录组实验操作说明书

zh: STOmics Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装 V1.3（载体版）是用于构建新鲜冷冻样本的组织切片全转录本 3' 端文库的试剂套装。本试剂套装采用的 Stereo-seq 时空转录组技术，是一种基于 DNBSEQ 高通量测序技术开发的、具有高分辨大视场特点的原位全转录组信息捕获技术。Stereo-seq 芯片 T（时空 poly-T 芯片）上载有具有空间坐标信息的捕获探针，与组织切片结合后通过探针原位抓取组织内的 mRNA 分子并进行 cDNA 合成。研究人员通过 DNBSEQ 测序和 STOmics 配套的可视化分析工具，可获取特定样本超高分辨率下的空间转录组信息。
en: The STOmics Stereo-seq Transcriptomics Kit V1.3 (Slide Version) is a reagent kit used for constructing whole-transcriptome 3' end libraries from tissue sections of fresh-frozen samples. The Stereo-seq spatial transcriptomics technology utilized in this kit is an in situ whole-transcriptome information capture technology characterized by high resolution and a large field of view, developed based on DNBSEQ high-throughput sequencing technology. The Stereo-seq Chip T (spatial poly-T chip) is loaded with capture probes containing spatial coordinate information. After binding to tissue sections, the probes capture mRNA molecules within the tissue in situ and perform cDNA synthesis. By utilizing DNBSEQ sequencing and STOmics' supporting visualization analysis tools, researchers can obtain spatial transcriptomics information of specific samples at ultra-high resolution.
source_manual: STOG01013-时空转录组FFV1.3转录组实验操作说明书

zh: 此试剂盒套装可结合 H&E 染色，研究人员可以更清晰地观察到组织形态学信息，在时空病理研究与应用中更准确地判断组织分型及获取特定组织区域的表达信息，针对选定区域进行下游差异分析和富集分析。
en: This kit can be combined with H&E staining, allowing researchers to observe tissue morphological information more clearly. It enables more accurate determination of tissue classification and acquisition of expression information for specific tissue regions in spatiotemporal pathology research and applications, facilitating downstream differential analysis and enrichment analysis for selected regions.
source_manual: STOG01013-时空转录组FFV1.3转录组实验操作说明书

zh: 本试剂套装中提供的所有试剂都经过严格的质量控制和功能验证，最大程度上保证了文库制备的稳定性和重复性。
en: All reagents provided in this kit have undergone rigorous quality control and functional validation to maximize the stability and reproducibility of library preparation.
source_manual: STOG01013-时空转录组FFV1.3转录组实验操作说明书

zh: 如果 QC 失败，请仔细检查图像清晰度，调整拍照方法进行二次拍照以确保可以获得清晰的组织及 Track 线图像。若二次拍照 QC 仍失败，可以继续实验，实验结束可联系 FAS 帮助排查问题，或借助StereoMap 手动图像处理。
en: If QC fails, please carefully check the image clarity and adjust the imaging method to retake the photos to ensure that clear images of the tissue and Track lines can be obtained. If the QC still fails after the second attempt, you may continue the experiment. Upon completion of the experiment, you may contact the FAS for assistance in troubleshooting, or perform manual image processing using StereoMap.
source_manual: STOG01013-时空转录组FFV1.3转录组实验操作说明书

zh: 获得的 ssDNA 染色图需要Track 线质控通过才能自动化进行后续的数据分析（如,自动配准）。

zh: i.	对焦策略：将视野移至芯片空白区域，微调亮度/ 曝光和焦距，直至芯片上的 Track 线清晰，在芯片不同的空白区域（建议在芯片四个角）建立 3-5 个建模点；将视野移至组织区域，调整亮度/ 曝光和焦距，直至组织和细胞呈清晰状态且不过曝，选择组织中较关注的区域，设置建模点（建议组织区域内每平方厘米选择 3-5 个建模点，如果组织起伏较大，可以酌情增加建模点）；
en: i. Focusing strategy: Move the field of view to an empty area of the chip, and fine-tune the brightness/exposure and focus until the Track lines on the chip are clear. Establish 3-5 modeling points in different empty areas of the chip (it is recommended to use the four corners of the chip). Move the field of view to the tissue area, and adjust the brightness/exposure and focus until the tissue and cells are clear and not overexposed. Select areas of interest within the tissue and set modeling points (it is recommended to select 3-5 modeling points per square centimeter within the tissue area; if the tissue surface is uneven, the number of modeling points can be increased as appropriate).
source_manual: STOG01013-时空转录组FFV1.3转录组实验操作说明书

zh: j.	最终成像：完成建模后，将增益调至最小，随即进行扫描；拍照完成后，保存整个文件夹；
en: j. Final imaging: After completing the modeling, adjust the gain to the minimum, and then proceed with scanning. After the image capture is complete, save the entire folder.

zh: 3)  将离心管保持在磁力架上，加入 600 μL 80% 乙醇漂洗（新鲜配制并平衡至室温的 80% 乙醇）。通过旋转磁力架上的离心管来漂洗磁珠。静置 30 s，小心吸取并丢弃上清。移液器吸头应在远离磁力架的管壁上操作，请勿吸打、搅动磁珠；

Wash the beads by rotating the centrifuge tube on the magnetic rack. Let it stand for 30 s, then carefully aspirate and discard the supernatant. source_manual: STOG01013-时空转录组FFV1.3转录组实验操作说明书

en: for 1 min;

en: f. Add the Bluing Buffer (containing 5% RI) dropwise onto the chip, at a volume of 100 μL/chip. First, add one drop of the solution to each corner of the chip, then add the remaining solution to the center of the chip, allowing all the solution to merge and ensuring that the solution evenly covers the entire chip; adjust the room temperature incubation time according to the brand of Bluing Buffer selected;

en: i. Transfer the chip to a space in the clean area. Hold the carrier with one hand and an air canister with the other. Position the air nozzle 2-3 cm away from one corner of the chip, and blow dry the chip rapidly at an angle of approximately 30°. Ensure the surface of the slide and the liquid in the gap between the chip and the slide are dried. Lint-free paper can be used to wipe off any liquid around the chip;
source_manual: STOG01013-时空转录组FFV1.3转录组实验操作说明书

en: gradually lower the coverslip onto the chip until it completely covers the chip. Once the H&E Mounting Medium has infiltrated the entire chip, immediately arrange for imaging.

en: Please ensure there is no residual liquid in the gap between the chip and the slide; otherwise, it may cause the eosin to bleed after adding H&E Mounting Medium.
source_manual: STOG01013-时空转录组FFV1.3转录组实验操作说明书

zh: 滴加 H&E Mounting Medium 以后，建议立刻封片。
en: It is recommended to seal the slide immediately after adding the H&E Mounting Medium.

zh: 请保证盖玻片使用前干净无灰尘，可使用酒精擦拭盖玻片表面或者使用空气罐吹干净。
en: Please ensure the coverslip is clean and dust-free before use; you can wipe the coverslip surface with alcohol or blow it clean using an air duster.

zh: a.	 在显微镜控制软件中新建文件夹，以芯片号命名，也可适当注明其他相关信息；
en: a. Create a new folder in the microscope control software, named with the chip number; other relevant information may also be noted as appropriate;

en: Place the slide gently on the stage, keeping it as parallel to the stage as possible.

en: Turn on the fluorescence microscope and select the episcopic brightfield (color camera) mode.

zh: 文件夹名称只使用字母、数字、下划线，禁止使用空格等特殊字符。
en: Use only letters, numbers, and underscores for folder names; spaces and other special characters are prohibited.
source_manual: STOG01013-时空转录组FFV1.3转录组实验操作说明书

en: Example: B00249A1
source_manual: STOG01013-时空转录组FFV1.3转录组实验操作说明书

zh: e.	 确定组织位置：选择 4X 物镜，将视野移动至芯片上的组织区域，调整亮度和曝光，
en: e. Determine tissue location: Select the 4X objective lens, move the field of view to the tissue area on the chip, and adjust the brightness and exposure,
source_manual: STOG01013-时空转录组FFV1.3转录组实验操作说明书

zh: 调节焦距，直至视野内组织和细胞呈清晰状态；
en: Adjust the focus until the tissue and cells in the field of view are clearly visible;
source_manual: STOG01013-时空转录组FFV1.3转录组实验操作说明书

en: f. Scan map: Select the chip area, ensuring the chip is completely within the selected area and that the area is slightly larger than the chip; scan the map under a 4X objective lens to determine the official scanning area;
source_manual: STOG01013-时空转录组FFV1.3转录组实验操作说明书

zh: g.	 调整显微镜倍数：将物镜调整至 10X，进一步调整框选区域，需确保芯片四个角
en: g. Adjust microscope magnification: Adjust the objective lens to 10X and further refine the selected area, ensuring the four corners of the chip
source_manual: STOG01013-时空转录组FFV1.3转录组实验操作说明书

zh: 在框选范围内，并尽量与芯片边缘重合；
en: are within the selected area and aligned as closely as possible with the chip edges;
source_manual: STOG01013-时空转录组FFV1.3转录组实验操作说明书

zh: h.	 焦面确定：调节焦距，直至视野内组织和细胞呈清晰状态；
en: h. Focal plane determination: Adjust the focus until the tissues and cells in the field of view are clearly visible;
source_manual: STOG01013-时空转录组FFV1.3转录组实验操作说明书

zh: i.	白平衡：判断组织区域颜色是否正确，如果有问题，选择无组织区域和干净无杂质的区域，进行白平衡校正；
en: i. White balance: Determine if the color of the tissue area is correct; if there is an issue, select a tissue-free, clean, and debris-free area to perform white balance correction;
source_manual: STOG01013-时空转录组FFV1.3转录组实验操作说明书

zh: j.	背景平衡：将视野移至芯片空白区域，进行背景平衡。选择无组织区域和干净无杂质的区域，调整细准焦螺旋/ 鼠标滚轮进行散焦（z 轴浮动±200 以内），如果先前选择的区域中有小杂质，散焦后应该几乎不可见，区域内的 Track 线也不可见，最后选择“背景平衡”；
en: j. Background balance: Move the field of view to a blank area of the chip to perform background balance. Select a tissue-free, clean, and debris-free area, and adjust the fine focus knob/mouse wheel to defocus (within ±200 on the z-axis). If there are small impurities in the previously selected area, they should be almost invisible after defocusing, and the Track lines within the area should also be invisible. Finally, select "Background balance";
source_manual: STOG01013-时空转录组FFV1.3转录组实验操作说明书

zh: 要求芯片边缘水平角度小于15°，芯片位置chip T 手柄始终在右侧。
en: The horizontal angle of the chip edge is required to be less than 15°, and the handle of chip position T must always be on the right side.

en: If the microscope does not have a scanning map function, skip this step directly.
source_manual: STOG01013-时空转录组FFV1.3转录组实验操作说明书

zh: k.	 再次定焦：调节焦距，直至视野内组织和细胞呈清晰状态；
en: k. Refocusing: Adjust the focus until the tissues and cells within the field of view are clearly visible;
source_manual: STOG01013-时空转录组FFV1.3转录组实验操作说明书

zh: l.	对焦策略：将视野移至芯片空白区域，视情况微调亮度/ 曝光和焦距，直至芯片上的 Track 线清晰，在芯片不同的空白区域（建议在芯片四个角）建立 3-5 个建模点；将视野移至组织区域，视情况微调亮度/ 曝光和焦距，直至组织和细胞呈清晰状态且不过曝，选择组织中较关注的区域，设置建模点（建议组织区域内每平方厘米选择 3-5 个建模点，如果组织起伏较大，可以酌情增加建模点）；对于仅支持自动对焦策略的显微镜无需考虑本策略；
en: l. Focusing strategy: Move the field of view to a blank area of the chip, fine-tune the brightness/exposure and focus as needed until the Track lines on the chip are clear, and establish 3-5 modeling points in different blank areas of the chip (recommended at the four corners of the chip); move the field of view to the tissue area, fine-tune the brightness/exposure and focus as needed until the tissues and cells are clearly visible and not overexposed, select areas of interest within the tissue, and set modeling points (it is recommended to select 3-5 modeling points per square centimeter in the tissue area; if the tissue surface is highly uneven, the number of modeling points can be increased as appropriate); this strategy does not need to be considered for microscopes that only support automatic focusing strategies;

en: This instruction manual is suitable for the Stereo-seq Permeabilization Kit V1.1 (Slide-based).

zh: STOmics Stereo-seq 透化试剂套装 V1.1（载体版）是用于摸索新鲜冷冻(Fresh Frozen, FF) 样本最佳透化时间的预实验试剂套装，FF 样本要求参考《时空实验FF样本准备操作指南》。本试剂套装采用的 Stereo-seq 时空转录组技术，是一种基于 DNBSEQ 高通量测序技术开发的、具有高分辨大视场的原位全转录组信息捕获技术。 Stereo-seq 芯片 P（透化测试芯片）上载有核苷酸捕获探针，与组织切片结合后通过探针原位抓取组织内的 mRNA 分子，再利用带有荧光标记的核苷酸进行 cDNA 合成。研究人员通过荧光显微成像可以快速判断特定组织的最佳透化时间。
en: The STOmics Stereo-seq Permeabilization Kit V1.1 (Slide-based) is a pre-experiment kit designed for optimizing the permeabilization time for Fresh Frozen (FF) samples. For FF sample requirements, please refer to the "Spatial Experiment FF Sample Preparation Guidelines." The Stereo-seq spatial transcriptomics technology utilized in this kit is an in situ whole-transcriptome information capture technology featuring high resolution and a large field of view, developed based on DNBSEQ high-throughput sequencing technology. Stereo-seq Chip P (permeabilization test chip) is loaded with nucleotide capture probes. After binding with tissue sections, these probes capture mRNA molecules within the tissue in situ, followed by cDNA synthesis using fluorescently labeled nucleotides. Researchers can quickly determine the optimal permeabilization time for a specific tissue through fluorescence microscopy imaging.
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: 若同时将蛋白检测技术融入标准 Stereo-seq 透化测试实验流程中，还可以快速判断兼容蛋白组的特定组织的最佳透化时间。
en: Incorporating protein detection technology into the standard Stereo-seq permeabilization test experimental workflow also allows for the rapid determination of the optimal permeabilization time for specific tissues compatible with proteomics.
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: 打开后，请检查玻片盒中的所有的 Stereo-seq 芯片载体是否正确定位在插槽中，载体上的芯片是否正面朝上。芯片的正面为亮光面，正面含有用于 mRNA 捕获的探针。请勿触碰到芯片表面。
en: After opening, please check whether all the Stereo-seq chip slides in the slide box are correctly positioned in the slots, and whether the chips on the carriers are facing upward. The front side of the chip is the shiny side, which contains probes for mRNA capture. Do not touch the chip surface.
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: c.	清洗后用气瓶吹干芯片四周及表面，再用无尘纸吸干载玻片背面和周围多余的液体；
en: c. After cleaning, blow-dry the perimeter and surface of the chip with compressed air, then use a lint-free wipe to absorb any excess liquid on the back of the slide and around it;
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: d.	当芯片表面无杂质、无明显痕迹、无任何液体残留、无波纹状纹理，即可准备贴片；
en: d. When the chip surface is free of impurities, obvious marks, any liquid residue, or ripple-like textures, it is ready for tissue section attachment;
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: e.	预冷甲醇：在玻片盒或 50 mL 离心管中加入足量甲醇，确保甲醇足够浸没所有芯片（可将一张普通载玻片放入容器中，查看甲醇的体积是否足够）。扣紧盖子，提前放入切片机中（− 20℃）预冷 5-30 min；
en: e. Pre-cool methanol: Add sufficient methanol to a slide box or 50 mL centrifuge tube, ensuring that the methanol is enough to submerge all chips (you can place a regular slide into the container to verify if the methanol volume is sufficient). Secure the lid tightly, and place it in the cryostat (−20°C) in advance to pre-cool for 5-30 min;
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: f.	将组织包埋块固定至冻头上，修片；
en: f. Mount the tissue embedding block onto the chuck and trim;
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: g.	组织贴片有两种操作方式可选：热贴（A）和冷贴（B）。根据需求选择切片厚度，通常为10 μm。
en: g. There are two optional methods for tissue mounting: hot mounting (A) and cold mounting (B). Select the section thickness according to requirements, typically 10 μm.
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

en: 3.3. Chip Processing and Tissue Mounting

zh: 有关组织切片到 Stereo-seq 芯片载体上的演示视频，请参阅以下链接或扫描二维码：https://www.stomics.tech/resources/Videos
en: For a demonstration video on loading tissue sections onto the Stereo-seq chip slide, please refer to the following link or scan the QR code: https://www.stomics.tech/resources/Videos
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

en: Spatiotemporal Transcriptomics FF V1.3 mIF-compatible Permeabilization Test Operation Manual
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: 如需在同一个载体的不同芯片上贴2 个不同组织的切片，建议将两个组织都修好片后，先对一个组织切片，使用热贴方式贴片，将载体放至PCR 适配器上37℃等待贴下一个组织，等待时间控制在5 min 以内；然后换另外一个组织切片，使用热贴方式贴片，快速将载体置于PCR 适配器上37℃孵育5 min。
en: If you need to attach sections from two different tissues onto different chips on the same carrier, it is recommended to trim both tissues first. Then, attach the first tissue section using the heat-attachment method and place the carrier on a PCR adapter at 37°C while waiting to attach the next tissue (the waiting time should be within 5 minutes). Next, take the other tissue section, attach it using the heat-attachment method, and quickly place the carrier on the PCR adapter to incubate at 37°C for 5 minutes.
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: 3）立即拿起芯片载体，用指腹放在载体背面加温几秒钟，直至切片贴合；
en: 3) Immediately pick up the chip slide and use your fingertip to warm the back of the carrier for a few seconds until the section is adhered;
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: 4）重复上述操作，直至所有切片贴片完成，建议组织切片贴片控制在5 min 内；
en: 4) Repeat the above operations until all sections are attached. It is recommended that the attachment of tissue sections be controlled within 5 minutes;
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: 5）快速将载体置于PCR 适配器上37℃孵育5 min，无需盖PCR 热盖。
en: 5) Quickly place the carrier onto the PCR adapter and incubate at 37°C for 5 min, without engaging the PCR thermal lid.
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: 1)  将载体芯片正面朝上置于切片机中，预冷1-6 min；
en: 1) Place the carrier chip into the cryostat with the front side facing up, and pre-cool for 1-6 min;
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: 2）进行冷冻切片，然后用预冷的毛刷轻轻拨动切片周围的OCT 使切片铺平。用镊子和毛刷将切片小心覆盖在芯片正中央并铺平，注意毛刷不要触碰到组织。尽量一次贴片成功，确保组织切片完整，无褶皱；
en: 2) Perform cryosectioning, then use a pre-cooled brush to gently move the OCT around the section to flatten it. Use forceps and a brush to carefully place the section in the center of the chip and flatten it; be careful not to let the brush touch the tissue. Try to achieve successful mounting in one go to ensure the tissue section is complete and free of wrinkles;
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: 预冷时间不可过长，以免玻片表面产生水雾；预冷时间不可太短，以免玻片无法达到预冷温度。
en: The pre-cooling time should not be too long to avoid condensation on the slide surface, and it should not be too short to ensure the slide reaches the required pre-cooling temperature.
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: 进行冷贴时需控制好每张切片贴片时间，间隔时间太长，组织贴片会皱缩。
en: When performing cold mounting, control the mounting time for each section; if the interval is too long, the tissue section will wrinkle or shrink.
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: （可选暂停点）将孵育好的芯片载体放于玻片盒或者50 mL 离心管，然后将其放入可密封的塑料袋中，同时放入干燥剂包，尽可能多地挤出空气并将塑料袋密封。用干冰快速转移到−80℃冰箱，最长可于−80℃保存21 天。
en: (Optional pause point) Place the incubated chip slide into a slide box or 50 mL centrifuge tube, then place it into a resealable plastic bag with a desiccant packet, squeeze out as much air as possible, and seal the bag. Rapidly transfer it on dry ice to a −80°C freezer, where it can be stored for up to 21 days.
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: 继续实验时，使用干冰将玻片盒或者50 mL 离心管转移，取出贴有组织的芯片载体，快速置于PCR 适配器上37℃孵育5 min。
en: To continue the experiment, use dry ice to transfer the slide box or 50 mL centrifuge tube, remove the chip slide with the tissue attached, and rapidly place it on a PCR adapter to incubate at 37°C for 5 min.
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: 1）连续切取组织切片，将切片移到切片台右侧靠近边缘处，然后用预冷的毛刷轻轻拨动切片周围的OCT 使切片铺平，每张切片放置间隔距离大于载体宽度；
en: 1) Continuously cut tissue sections and move them to the edge on the right side of the sectioning stage. Gently use a pre-cooled brush to stir the OCT around the sections to flatten them, ensuring a spacing greater than the carrier width between each section;
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: 2）拿起载体的一边，使芯片正面朝下，对准切片；
en: 2) Pick up one side of the carrier, position the chip face down, and align it with the section;
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: 3）轻轻一压，肉眼可见切片已经吸附到芯片表面；
en: 3) Press gently; the section is visibly adhered to the chip surface.
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: 4）重复 2）-3）步骤操作，直至全部组织切片吸附到芯片表面（贴片时间控制在1 min 以内）；
en: 4) Repeat steps 2)-3) until all tissue sections are adhered to the chip surface (ensure mounting time is within 1 min);
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: 5）将芯片正面朝上，快速将载体置于提前平衡温度的PCR 适配器上，37℃孵育5 min，无需盖PCR 热盖。
en: 5) Place the chip front side up, quickly place the carrier on the pre-equilibrated PCR adapter, and incubate at 37°C for 5 min without closing the PCR thermal lid.
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

en: Avoid contact between the carrier and the front of the chip.

en: a. Immediately after incubation, place the chip slide into methanol pre-cooled to −20°C, ensuring that the methanol submerges
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: 所有芯片，固定 30 min；
en: all chips on the carrier, and fix for 30 minutes;
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: b.	 组织固定期间，参考表格 3-1 制备封闭以及模拟抗体孵育步骤需要的封闭液（需
en: b. During tissue fixation, refer to Table 3-1 to prepare the blocking buffer required for the blocking and mock antibody incubation steps (need
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: 制备4 片组织的用量），涡旋混匀并瞬时离心，置于冰上备用；
en: to prepare enough for 4 tissue slides), vortex to mix and centrifuge briefly, then place on ice for later use;
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: c.	 固定结束后，将玻片盒或 50 mL 离心管转移至通风橱中；
en: c. After fixation is complete, transfer the slide box or 50 mL centrifuge tube to a fume hood;
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: d.	 将载体从玻片盒或 50 mL 离心管中取出，用无尘纸擦去载玻片背面和芯片周围
en: d. Remove the carrier from the slide box or 50 mL centrifuge tube, and use lint-free paper to wipe the back of the glass slide and the area around the chip
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: 多余的甲醇，确保无液体残留；
en: to remove excess methanol, ensuring no liquid residue remains;
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: e.	  将载体竖立放在载玻片染色架上，置于通风橱中晾干4-6 min，让甲醇充分挥发；
en: e. Place the carrier upright on a slide staining rack, and put it in a fume hood to air-dry for 4-6 min, allowing the methanol to fully evaporate;
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: f.	甲醇挥发完全后，肉眼可见组织变白，将载体转移至实验桌上，再按照附录《Stereo-seq 芯片载体及配件使用说明书》组装方法组合成手持载具，确保夹具 8 个卡扣扣紧并且载体两侧贴紧夹具两侧 。
en: f. After the methanol has completely evaporated, the tissue is visibly white to the naked eye. Transfer the carrier to the laboratory bench, then assemble it into a handheld carrier following the assembly method in the appendix "Stereo-seq Chip Slide and Accessories User Manual", ensuring that the 8 buckles of the jig are secured and both sides of the carrier are tightly fitted against the sides of the jig.

zh: a.	 封闭和模拟一抗孵育：将已配制好的封闭液滴加到组织表面，用量为 150 μL/ 芯片，将封板膜（不要撕开，包含白底）放置于载具上覆盖反应孔，室温孵育65 min；
en: a. Blocking and mock primary antibody incubation: Add the prepared blocking solution to the tissue surface at 150 μL/chip. Place the sealing film (do not tear it, includes the white backing) on the carrier to cover the reaction wells, and incubate at room temperature for 65 min;
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: b.	 一抗孵育等待期间，参考表格3-2 配制模拟二抗孵育液，涡旋混匀后瞬时离心，放于冰盒上备用；
en: b. During the primary antibody incubation waiting period, prepare the mock secondary antibody incubation solution according to Table 3-2. Vortex to mix, spin down briefly, and place on an ice block for later use;
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: c.	 拿开含白底的封板膜并放置在实验台上备用，用移液器在芯片一角吸弃封闭液，保持芯片组织湿润；
en: c. Remove the sealing film with the white backing and place it on the lab bench for later use. Use a pipette to aspirate the blocking solution from a corner of the chip, keeping the chip tissue moist;
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: d.	 往芯片加入0.1X SSC 溶液，用量为 200 μL/ 芯片，室温孵育 1 min；
en: d. Add 200 μL of 0.1X SSC solution to the chip, and incubate at room temperature for 1 min;
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: e.	 微微倾斜手持载具，倾斜角度小于 20°，用移液器在芯片一角吸弃  0.1X SSC 溶液，保持芯片组织湿润；
en: e. Slightly tilt the handheld carrier at an angle of less than 20°, use a pipette to aspirate the 0.1X SSC solution from one corner of the chip, and keep the chip tissue moist;
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: f.	重复步骤 d.-e. 一次 ;
en: f. Repeat steps d.-e. once;
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: g.	 模拟二抗孵育：往芯片加入模拟二抗孵育液，用量为 150 μL/ 芯片，将封板膜（不要撕开，包含白底）放置于载具上覆盖反应孔，室温避光孵育 15 min；
en: g. Simulation of secondary antibody incubation: Add 150 μL/chip of the simulated secondary antibody incubation solution to the chip. Place the sealing film (do not tear it open, and keep the white backing included) on the carrier to cover the reaction wells, and incubate at room temperature in the dark for 15 minutes;
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

zh: h.	 拿开含白底的封板膜并放置于实验台备用，用移液器在芯片一角吸弃二抗孵育液，保持芯片组织湿润；
en: h. Remove the sealing film with the white backing and place it on the laboratory bench for later use. Aspirate and discard the secondary antibody incubation solution from a corner of the chip using a pipette, keeping the chip tissue moist;
source_manual: STOG01017-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF透化测试操作说明书

en: i. Add 200 μL/chip of 0.1X SSC solution to the chip, and incubate at room temperature for 1 minute;

zh: j.	微微倾斜手持载具，倾斜角度小于 20°，用移液器在芯片一角吸弃0.1X SSC 溶液，
en: j. Slightly tilt the hand-held carrier at an angle of less than 20°, and use a pipette to aspirate and discard the 0.1X SSC solution at one corner of the chip,

en: keeping the tissue on the chip moist;

zh: 1) 将手持载具转移到PCR 适配器上，先在透化时间为 24 min 的芯片添加150 μL 1X 透化试剂工作液。在芯片的每个角加入一滴透化试剂（移液器挨近芯片加液，注意不要划伤组织），然后将其余透化试剂加到芯片中央，使所有液体融合，确保透化试剂覆盖全芯片；

Add one drop of permeabilization reagent to each corner of the chip (keep the pipette close to the chip when adding the liquid, taking care not to scratch the tissue), then add the remaining permeabilization reagent to the center of the chip, allowing all the liquid to merge and ensuring the permeabilization reagent covers the entire chip;

source_manual: STOG01018-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF转录组实验操作说明书

zh: STOmics Stereo-seq 转录组试剂套装 V1.3（载体版）是用于构建新鲜冷冻样本的组织切片全转录本 3' 端文库的试剂套装。本试剂套装采用的 Stereo-seq 时空转录组技术，是一种基于 DNBSEQ 高通量测序技术开发的、具有高分辨大视场特点的原位全转录组信息捕获技术。Stereo-seq 芯片 T（时空 poly-T 芯片）上载有具有空间坐标信息的捕获探针，与组织切片结合后通过探针原位抓取组织内的 mRNA 分子并进行 cDNA 合成。研究人员通过 DNBSEQ 测序和 STOmics 配套的可视化分析工具，可获取特定样本超高分辨率下的空间转录组信息。
en: The STOmics Stereo-seq Transcriptomics Kit V1.3 (Slide version) is a reagent kit for constructing whole-transcriptome 3' end libraries from tissue sections of fresh-frozen samples. The Stereo-seq spatiotemporal transcriptomics technology employed by this kit is an *in situ* whole-transcriptome information capture technology characterized by high resolution and a large field of view, developed based on DNBSEQ high-throughput sequencing technology. The Stereo-seq chip T (spatiotemporal poly-T chip) is loaded with capture probes containing spatial coordinate information; upon binding to tissue sections, these probes capture mRNA molecules within the tissue *in situ* and facilitate cDNA synthesis. By using DNBSEQ sequencing and the accompanying STOmics visualization analysis tools, researchers can obtain spatial transcriptomic information for specific samples at ultra-high resolution.
source_manual: STOG01018-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF转录组实验操作说明书

zh: 此试剂盒套装可结合多重免疫荧光（mIF）染色，研究人员可以实现在同一张组织切片上获得多个蛋白的免疫荧光照片和全转录组信息。 在不影响转录组捕获的前提下，额外获得的蛋白检测信息，能与基因表达数据相整合，更深入、更完整地评估宝贵的样本，解析复杂的病理或生理过程。检测的目标蛋白数量取决于抗体选择和成像配置，目前可支持DAPI+ 多达3 个IF 靶标的检测。
en: This kit can be combined with multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF) staining, enabling researchers to obtain immunofluorescence images of multiple proteins and whole-transcriptome information from the same tissue section. Without affecting transcriptomic capture, the additional protein detection information can be integrated with gene expression data, allowing for a deeper and more comprehensive evaluation of valuable samples and the analysis of complex pathological or physiological processes. The number of target proteins that can be detected depends on antibody selection and imaging configuration; it currently supports the detection of DAPI + up to 3 IF targets.
source_manual: STOG01018-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF转录组实验操作说明书

en: All reagents included in this kit have undergone rigorous quality control and functional validation, ensuring maximum stability and reproducibility for library preparation.

zh: 常规多重免疫荧光（mIF）技术通过使用不同种属来源的一抗识别不同的靶标，并通过不同荧光标记的二抗来检测相应的一抗，从而实现多个靶标的空间定位。抗体的选择对于mIF 实验的成功至关重要，因为它们的性能直接影响到数据的质量。抗体的选择遵循常规mIF 的选择原则，需要考虑加入抗体的宿主来源、特异性、种属反应性等。我们建议首先在感兴趣组织切片上进行抗体滴定后，选择最合适的抗体浓度进行mIF 预实验，再进行STOmics 多重免疫荧光（mIF）与空间转录组共检测实验。
en: Conventional multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF) technology achieves spatial localization of multiple targets by using primary antibodies from different species to recognize distinct targets and detecting the corresponding primary antibodies with differently fluorescently labeled secondary antibodies. Antibody selection is critical to the success of mIF experiments, as their performance directly affects data quality. Antibody selection follows conventional mIF principles, requiring consideration of the host species, specificity, and cross-reactivity of the antibodies. We recommend first performing antibody titration on the tissue sections of interest to determine the optimal antibody concentration for mIF pilot experiments, and then proceeding with the STOmics multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF) and spatial transcriptomics co-detection experiment.
source_manual: STOG01018-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF转录组实验操作说明书

zh: 抗体最佳浓度选择原则为，在保持荧光信号最佳的同时，最大程度减少背景染色。以NeuN 抗体（abcam，ab104224）滴定示例数据为例，如图一所示，根据荧光信号选择荧光强度不显著减低的最低浓度，应选择1：1000 作为最佳抗体稀释浓度，用于后续mIF 预实验以及正式实验。
en: The principle for selecting the optimal antibody concentration is to minimize background staining while maintaining optimal fluorescence signals. Taking the titration example data for the NeuN antibody (Abcam, ab104224) as an example, as shown in Figure 1, the lowest concentration at which fluorescence intensity does not significantly decrease should be selected based on the fluorescence signal. Therefore, 1:1000 should be selected as the optimal antibody dilution concentration for subsequent mIF preliminary and formal experiments.

zh: a.	取芯片：从真空干燥铝箔袋中取出 Stereo-seq 芯片T 载体，记录芯片背面的编号；注意不要触碰芯片正面；
en: a. Remove the chip: Take the Stereo-seq chip T-carrier out of the vacuum-dried aluminum foil bag and record the number on the back of the chip; be careful not to touch the front of the chip.

zh: b.	将载体置于桌面上复温 1 min，观察芯片表面是否有杂质，如芯片上存在杂质，使用 100 μL Nuclease-Free Water 清洗 2 次，可参考图 a（或在含 40-50 mLNuclease-Free Water 的离心管中清洗 2 次，可参考图 b);
en: b. Place the carrier on the desktop to equilibrate to room temperature for 1 minute, and observe whether there are any impurities on the chip surface. If there are impurities on the chip, wash it twice using 100 μL of Nuclease-Free Water (refer to Figure a), or wash it twice in a centrifuge tube containing 40-50 mL of Nuclease-Free Water (refer to Figure b).
source_manual: STOG01018-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF转录组实验操作说明书

zh: c.	清洗后用气瓶吹干芯片四周及表面，再用无尘纸吸干载玻片背面和周围多余的液体；
en: c. After washing, use compressed gas to blow-dry the surrounding area and surface of the chip, then use lint-free paper to absorb excess liquid on the back of the slide and around it.
source_manual: STOG01018-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF转录组实验操作说明书

zh: d.	当芯片表面无杂质、无明显痕迹、无任何液体残留、无波纹状纹理，即可准备贴片；
en: Once the chip surface is free of impurities, visible marks, liquid residue, and ripple-like textures, it is ready for tissue mounting;
source_manual: STOG01018-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF转录组实验操作说明书

zh: e.	预冷甲醇：在玻片盒或 50 mL 离心管中加入足量甲醇，确保甲醇足够浸没所有芯片（可将一张普通载玻片放入容器中，查看甲醇的体积是否足够）。扣紧盖子，提前放入切片机中（−20℃）预冷 5-30 min；
en: Pre-cool methanol: Add sufficient methanol to a slide box or 50 mL centrifuge tube, ensuring that it is enough to submerge all chips (a standard glass slide can be placed in the container to check if the methanol volume is sufficient). Secure the lid tightly and place it in the cryostat (−20°C) to pre-cool for 5–30 minutes;
source_manual: STOG01018-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF转录组实验操作说明书

zh: 打开后，请检查玻片盒中的所有的 Stereo-seq 芯片载体是否正确定位在插槽中，载体上的芯片是否正面朝上。芯片的正面为亮光面，正面含有用于 mRNA 捕获的探针。请勿触碰到芯片表面。
en: After opening, please check that all Stereo-seq chip holders in the slide box are correctly positioned in the slots and that the chips on the holders are facing upwards. The front side of the chip is the shiny side and contains the probes for mRNA capture. Do not touch the surface of the chip.
source_manual: STOG01018-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF转录组实验操作说明书

en: f. Fix the tissue embedding block to the chuck, and trim;

en: There are two optional methods for tissue mounting: hot mounting (A) and cold mounting (B). Select the section thickness based on requirements, typically 10 μm.

en: Please store unused spatiotemporal chips sealed and dry at -25°C~8°C: you can place the chip back into its original slide storage box, then put it into an aluminum bag with desiccant and seal it for storage.
source_manual: STOG01018-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF转录组实验操作说明书

en: Spatio-temporal Transcriptomics FF V1.3 Compatible with mIF Transcriptomics Experiment Operation Manual
source_manual: STOG01018-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF转录组实验操作说明书

zh: 1）连续切取组织切片，将切片移到切片台右侧靠近边缘处，然后用预冷的毛刷轻轻拨动切片周围的 OCT 使切片铺平，每张切片放置间隔距离大于载体宽度；
en: 1) Continuously cut tissue sections and move them to the edge on the right side of the sectioning platform. Use a pre-cooled brush to gently stir the OCT around the sections to flatten them, ensuring the spacing between each section is greater than the width of the carrier.
source_manual: STOG01018-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF转录组实验操作说明书

zh: 2）拿起载体的一边，使芯片正面朝下，对准切片；
en: 2) Pick up one side of the carrier, position the chip face down, and align it with the section.
source_manual: STOG01018-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF转录组实验操作说明书

zh: 3）轻轻一压，肉眼可见切片已经吸附到芯片表面；
en: 3) Apply gentle pressure until it is visible to the naked eye that the section has adhered to the surface of the chip.
source_manual: STOG01018-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF转录组实验操作说明书

zh: 4）重复 2）-3）步骤操作，直至全部组织切片吸附到芯片表面（贴片时间控制在 1 min 以内）；
en: 4) Repeat steps 2)-3) until all tissue sections are attached to the chip surface (control the attachment time to within 1 min);
source_manual: STOG01018-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF转录组实验操作说明书

zh: 5）将芯片正面朝上，快速将载体置于提前平衡温度的  PCR  适配器上，37℃孵育5 min，无需盖 PCR 热盖。
en: 5) Place the chip face up, quickly position the carrier on a pre-equilibrated PCR adapter, and incubate at 37°C for 5 min without closing the PCR thermal lid.
source_manual: STOG01018-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF转录组实验操作说明书

zh: 1）将载体芯片正面朝上置于切片机中，预冷 1-6 min；
en: 1) Place the carrier chip, front side up, into the cryostat and pre-cool for 1-6 min;
source_manual: STOG01018-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF转录组实验操作说明书

zh: 2）进行冷冻切片，然后用预冷的毛刷轻轻拨动切片周围的 OCT 使切片铺平。用镊子和毛刷将切片小心覆盖在芯片正中央并铺平，注意毛刷不要触碰到组织。尽量一次贴片成功，确保组织切片完整，无褶皱；
en: 2) Perform cryosectioning, and then use a pre-cooled brush to gently move the OCT around the section to flatten it. Carefully place the section in the center of the chip using tweezers and a brush, and flatten it; be careful not to touch the tissue with the brush. Try to mount the section successfully on the first attempt, ensuring the tissue section is intact and free of folds;
source_manual: STOG01018-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF转录组实验操作说明书

zh: 3）立即拿起芯片载体，用指腹放在载体背面加温几秒钟，直至切片贴合；
en: 3) Immediately take out the chip slide and warm the back of the carrier with your fingertip for a few seconds until the section adheres;
source_manual: STOG01018-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF转录组实验操作说明书

zh: 4）重复上述操作，直至所有切片贴片完成，建议组织切片贴片控制在 5 min 内；
en: 4) Repeat the above steps until all sections are mounted; it is recommended to complete the section mounting within 5 minutes.
source_manual: STOG01018-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF转录组实验操作说明书

zh: 5）快速将载体置于 PCR 适配器上 37℃孵育 5 min，无需盖 PCR 热盖。
en: 5) Quickly place the carrier on a PCR adapter and incubate at 37°C for 5 minutes; do not engage the PCR thermal lid.
source_manual: STOG01018-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF转录组实验操作说明书

zh: 预冷时间不可过长，以免玻片表面产生水雾；预冷时间不可太短，以免玻片无法达到预冷温度。
en: Do not pre-cool for too long to avoid condensation on the slide surface; do not pre-cool for too short a time, otherwise the slide may not reach the required pre-cooling temperature.
source_manual: STOG01018-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF转录组实验操作说明书

zh: 进行冷贴时需控制好每张切片贴片时间，间隔时间太大，组织贴片会皱缩。
en: When performing cold mounting, the mounting time for each section must be strictly controlled; if the interval is too long, the tissue section will wrinkle.
source_manual: STOG01018-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF转录组实验操作说明书

zh: （可选暂停点）将孵育好的芯片载体放于玻片盒或者 50 mL 离心管，然后将其放入可密封的塑料袋中，同时放入干燥剂包，尽可能多地挤出空气并将袋密封。用干冰快速转移到− 80℃冰箱，最长可于− 80℃保存21 天。
en: (Optional pause point) Place the incubated chip slide into a slide box or 50 mL centrifuge tube, then put it into a sealable plastic bag with a desiccant pack, squeeze out as much air as possible, and seal the bag. Transfer rapidly using dry ice to a −80°C freezer; it can be stored at −80°C for up to 21 days.

en: When resuming the experiment, use dry ice to transfer the slide box or 50 mL centrifuge tube, remove the chip slide with the tissue attached, and rapidly place it on a PCR adapter to incubate at 37°C for 5 minutes.

en: FcR Blocking Reagent is used to block Fc receptors on the cell membrane surface; it can be purchased based on the species of the experimental tissue. No. 156604). However, if the primary antibody used on the mouse tissue is derived from a rat, it is recommended not to add the TruStain FcX™ PLUS (anti-mouse CD16/32) Antibody; that is, do not add FcR Blocking Reagent to the blocking buffer, and make up the total volume with Nuclease Free Water.

zh: 1)  将同一个cDNA 的3 管PCR 产物混合到一起（300 μL），与室温平衡好的磁珠按照 1 : 0.8 混合，震荡混匀，室温孵育 10 min；
en: 1) Mix the 3 tubes of PCR products from the same cDNA together (300 μL), mix with magnetic beads (equilibrated to room temperature) at a 1 : 0.8 ratio, vortex to mix, and incubate at room temperature for 10 min;
source_manual: STOG01018-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF转录组实验操作说明书

zh: 2)  瞬时离心后，将 PCR 管放在磁力架上静置 3 min，待液体澄清后去除上清；
en: 2) Briefly centrifuge, place the PCR tube on a magnetic rack, and let it stand for 3 min until the liquid is clear, then remove the supernatant;
source_manual: STOG01018-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF转录组实验操作说明书

zh: 3)  将离心管保持在磁力架上，加入 600 μL 80% 乙醇漂洗（新鲜配制并平衡至室温的 80% 乙醇）。通过旋转磁力架上的离心管来漂洗磁珠。静置 30 s，小心吸取并丢弃上清。移液器吸头应在远离磁力架的管壁上操作，请勿吸打、搅动磁珠；
en: 3) Keep the tube on the magnetic rack and add 600 μL of 80% ethanol to wash (freshly prepared 80% ethanol equilibrated to room temperature). Wash the beads by rotating the tube on the magnetic rack. Let stand for 30 s, then carefully aspirate and discard the supernatant. The pipette tip should be operated against the tube wall away from the magnetic rack; do not pipette up and down or disturb the beads;
source_manual: STOG01018-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF转录组实验操作说明书

zh: 5)  将离心管保持在磁力架上，打开盖子，室温风干5-8 min，直至磁珠表面无反光、无开裂；
en: 5) Keep the centrifuge tube on the magnetic rack, open the lid, and air-dry at room temperature for 5-8 min until the surface of the magnetic beads is non-reflective and free of cracks.
source_manual: STOG01018-时空转录组FFV1.3兼容mIF转录组实验操作说明书

zh: 6)  加 100 μL 的 TE Buffer 回溶，震荡混匀后室温静置 5 min，瞬时离心，磁力架静置 3-5 min，待液体澄清后将上清（~98 μL）转移到新的 1.5 mL 离心管中。
en: 6) Add 100 μL TE Buffer to resuspend, vortex to mix, incubate at room temperature for 5 min, briefly centrifuge, place on the magnetic rack for 3-5 min, and after the liquid clears, transfer the supernatant (~98 μL) to a new 1.5 mL centrifuge tube.

zh: 1. 取PCR Barcode Primer Mix 1 按照操作流程加入到文库1 中，取PCR Barcode PrimerMix 2 按照操作流程加入到文库2 中,........，取PCR Barcode Primer Mix 12 按照操作流程加入到文库12 中;

en: 2. Then, take equal volumes of PCR Barcode Primer Mix 13, 14, 15, and 16, and mix them to prepare a Mix (prepare at least 25 μL of the mixed PCR Barcode Primer Mix), then add it to library 13 according to the operating procedure.

zh: 示例：9 个文库需同时上样至同一条lane 中，其中1 个文库需要总数据量的30%，其余8 个文库的数据产出等分。此时需采取如下方案：预期产出等分的8 个文库分别使用PCR Barcode Mix 1~8, 数据量需30% 的单个文库不可使用单一的PCR Barcode Primer Mix，而需使用不重复且成组的PCR Barcode Mix 9 ~12 或 13 ~16。
en: Example: 9 libraries need to be loaded into the same lane simultaneously, where 1 library requires 30% of the total data volume, and the remaining 8 libraries require equal data output. In this case, the following scheme should be adopted: the 8 libraries expected to have equal output should use PCR Barcode Mix 1–8, respectively, while the single library requiring 30% data volume must not use a single PCR Barcode Primer Mix, but instead should use a non-repeating, grouped set of PCR Barcode Mix 9–12 or 13–16.

zh: 1）混匀 Qubit ssDNA Buﬀer 与 Qubit ssDNA Reagent，在避光管里以 199：1 的比例混合。
en: 1) Mix Qubit ssDNA Buffer and Qubit ssDNA Reagent in a light-protected tube at a ratio of 199:1.

zh: 2）漩涡振荡混匀后使用迷你离心机短暂离心 5 s，常温放置待用。
en: 2) Vortex to mix, then briefly centrifuge for 5 s in a mini centrifuge and keep at room temperature until ready to use.
source_manual: STOG01019-时空转录组FFV1.3（含兼容mIF）建库实验操作说明书

zh: b. 准备 2+N 个 Qubit 检测管，分别标注 S1（Qubit ssDNA standard#1 0ng/µL）、S2（Qubit ssDNA standard#2 20ng/µL）、D1（待测样本 ssDNA）、D2（待测样本 ssDNA）、D3（待测样本 ssDNA）等;
en: b. Prepare 2+N Qubit assay tubes, labeled S1 (Qubit ssDNA standard#1 0ng/µL), S2 (Qubit ssDNA standard#2 20ng/µL), D1 (ssDNA test sample), D2 (ssDNA test sample), D3 (ssDNA test sample), etc.;
source_manual: STOG01019-时空转录组FFV1.3（含兼容mIF）建库实验操作说明书

zh: c. 按照下表准备标准管及待测样本管:
en: c. Prepare the standard tubes and test sample tubes according to the table below:

zh: 每个样本 ssDNA 定量需要配置 200 µL Qubit Working Solution
en: Prepare 200 µL of Qubit Working Solution for each sample for ssDNA quantification.
source_manual: STOG01019-时空转录组FFV1.3（含兼容mIF）建库实验操作说明书

zh: 建立标准曲线另需 2 个 200 µL Qubit Working Solution
en: Two additional 200 µL aliquots of Qubit Working Solution are required to establish the standard curve.
source_manual: STOG01019-时空转录组FFV1.3（含兼容mIF）建库实验操作说明书

zh: d. 将准备好的样本管及标准液管漩涡振荡混匀，瞬时离心 5 s，避光孵育 2 min，孵育结束后，可进行下一步;
en: d. Vortex the prepared sample tubes and standard solution tubes to mix, centrifuge briefly for 5 s, and incubate for 2 min in the dark; after incubation, proceed to the next step;
source_manual: STOG01019-时空转录组FFV1.3（含兼容mIF）建库实验操作说明书

zh: e. 按照 Qubit 使用说明书，选择 ssDNA 检测通道，分别放入标准液 S1 和标准液 S2 建立标准曲线，曲线生成后把 S2 当成样品测定 1 次。此时，样本投入量选择 10 µL，单位 ng/µL;
en: e. Following the Qubit instruction manual, select the ssDNA detection channel, and insert standards S1 and S2 respectively to establish the standard curve. Once the curve is generated, measure S2 once as a sample. At this point, select a sample volume of 10 µL and the unit ng/µL;
source_manual: STOG01019-时空转录组FFV1.3（含兼容mIF）建库实验操作说明书

zh: f. 放入待测样本管，样品投入量选择 2 µL，单位 ng/µL，测量并记录测量出的数值。
en: f. Place the test sample tube into the instrument, select a sample input volume of 2 µL, set the unit to ng/µL, then measure and record the resulting value.
source_manual: STOG01019-时空转录组FFV1.3（含兼容mIF）建库实验操作说明书

zh: 当测定值在 19.9-20 ng/µL 时，则认为此次的标准曲线为合格，可以用来检测样品。
en: When the measured value is between 19.9 and 20 ng/µL, the standard curve is considered qualified and can be used for testing samples.
source_manual: STOG01019-时空转录组FFV1.3（含兼容mIF）建库实验操作说明书

zh: 若不在这个范围，再次混匀后重新建立标准曲;
en: If it is not within this range, re-mix the sample and re-establish the standard curve.
source_manual: STOG01019-时空转录组FFV1.3（含兼容mIF）建库实验操作说明书

zh: S2 在合格范围内才可使用该标准曲线；否则重新配制标准品;
en: The standard curve can only be used if S2 is within the acceptable range; otherwise, re-prepare the standard.

zh: STOmics Stereo-seq 透化试剂套装（1 cm*2 cm/2 cm*2 cm/2 cm*3 cm）是用于摸索新鲜冷冻（Fresh Frozen, FF）样本最佳透化时间的预实验试剂套装。本试剂套装采用的Stereo-seq时空转录组技术，是一种基于DNBSEQ高通量测序技术开发的、具有高分辨大视场的原位全转录组信息捕获技术。Stereo-seq芯片P（透化测试芯片）上载有核苷酸捕获探针，与组织切片结合后通过探针原位抓取组织内的mRNA 分子，再利用带有荧光标记的核苷酸进行cDNA 合成。研究人员通过荧光显微成像可以快速判断特定组织的最佳透化时间。
en: The STOmics Stereo-seq Permeabilization Reagent Kit (1 cm*2 cm / 2 cm*2 cm / 2 cm*3 cm) is a pre-experimental reagent kit used to determine the optimal permeabilization time for Fresh Frozen (FF) samples. The Stereo-seq spatiotemporal transcriptomic technology utilized in this kit is an *in situ* whole-transcriptome information capture technology with a high-resolution, large field of view, developed based on DNBSEQ high-throughput sequencing technology. Stereo-seq Chip P (permeabilization test chip) is loaded with nucleotide capture probes, which, upon binding with tissue sections, capture mRNA molecules within the tissue *in situ*. Subsequently, fluorescently labeled nucleotides are utilized for cDNA synthesis. Researchers can rapidly determine the optimal permeabilization time for specific tissues through fluorescence microscopy imaging.
source_manual: STOG01021-时空转录组FFV1.3大尺寸芯片(≤2cmx3cm)透化测试操作说明书

zh: 此试剂盒套装可结合H&E 染色，研究人员可以更清晰地观察到组织形态学信息，在时空病理研究与应用中更准确地判断组织分型及获取特定组织区域的表达信息，针对选定区域进行下游差异分析和富集分析。
en: This reagent kit can be combined with H&E staining, allowing researchers to observe tissue morphological information more clearly. This enables more accurate determination of tissue typing and acquisition of expression information for specific tissue regions in spatiotemporal pathology research and applications, facilitating downstream differential analysis and enrichment analysis for the selected regions.
source_manual: STOG01021-时空转录组FFV1.3大尺寸芯片(≤2cmx3cm)透化测试操作说明书

zh: Stereo-seq 大芯片装于真空密封的铝箔袋中，冷链运输。收到产品后，请及时确认铝箔袋是否完好并处于真空密封状态，随后须立即将未开封的Stereo-seq 芯片T/P储存在2℃~8℃。若拆袋后未使用，参照《Stereo-seq 大芯片保存操作指南》- 重新封装操作指引将大芯片正确放入芯片盒并与干燥剂一起重新密封。再次确认铝箔袋是否完好并处于密封状态，随后立即将铝箔袋储存在2℃~8℃。未真空密封的芯片不可放置超过两周，开封后请尽快使用。
en: Stereo-seq large chips are packed in vacuum-sealed aluminum foil bags and transported via cold chain. Upon receiving the product, please promptly confirm whether the aluminum foil bag is intact and in a vacuum-sealed state, then immediately store the unopened Stereo-seq T/P chips at 2°C to 8°C. If the bag has been opened but the chips remain unused, refer to the "Stereo-seq Large Chip Storage Guide" - re-packaging instructions to correctly place the large chip into the chip box and re-seal it with the desiccant. Verify again that the aluminum foil bag is intact and sealed, then immediately store the aluminum foil bag at 2°C to 8°C. Chips that are not vacuum-sealed should not be stored for more than two weeks, and please use them as soon as possible after opening.
source_manual: STOG01021-时空转录组FFV1.3大尺寸芯片(≤2cmx3cm)透化测试操作说明书

en: As shown in Figure 1, with permeabilization times of 6 and 18 minutes, the tissue exhibited uneven brightness in the same cortical region, indicating insufficient permeabilization. At 24 minutes, details were clear, the signal was uniform, and brightness was at its maximum. The signal at 12 minutes was weaker than that at 24 minutes. Therefore, the optimal permeabilization time is 24 minutes.
